description: 1962年から続く、青森県弘前市の秋を象徴する「弘前城菊と紅葉まつり」。その中で、2020年からはじまった新しい展示企画が「花」と「芸術」をキーワードに、ねぷたやりんごといった弘前ならではのシンボルと文化を融合させたフラワーアートです。2020年は新型コロナウイルスの感染急拡大を受け中止となりましたが、その想いを引き継ぎ、今年は更に大きな作品制作に取り組みました。2021年のテーマは「枯木龍吟（こぼくりょうぎん）」。復活やさらなる発展へという想いが込められています。メイン作品となる「昇天華龍」は、全長１００ｍを超える大きさで、弘前のねぷた組師とフラワーアーティストの競演により制作されました。美しい弘前の紅葉と、様々な分野のアーティストと弘前市民の共作による作品群をご覧ください。

title: 【Hirosaki Castle Chrysanthemum and Autumn Leaves Festival】FLOWER ART 2021
description: The Hirosaki Castle Chrysanthemum and Autumn Leaves Festival, which has been held since 1962, symbolizes autumn in Hirosaki City, Aomori Prefecture. Among the events, a new exhibition project started in 2020, combining the keywords 'flowers' and 'art', fusing Hirosaki's unique symbols and culture such as nebuta and apples into flower art. The event was canceled in 2020 due to the rapid spread of COVID-19, but this year, we have taken on the challenge of creating even larger works, carrying on that spirit. The theme for 2021 is 'Koboku Ryogin', which embodies the desire for revival and further development. The main work, 'Shotenka Ryuu', is a giant dragon over 100 meters long, created in collaboration with Hirosaki's nebuta craftsmen and flower artists. Enjoy the beautiful autumn leaves of Hirosaki and the collaborative works of various artists and Hirosaki citizens.

title: 【弘前城菊と紅葉まつり】～その先を、照らす。
description: 1962年から続く、青森県弘前の秋を象徴する「弘前城菊と紅葉まつり」。まつりの開催を4日後に控えた2020年10月19日、新型コロナウイルスの感染急拡大を受けその中止が決定されました。弘前四大まつりである、春のさくらまつり、夏のねぷたまつりに続く見送りです。秋のまつり・弘前城菊と紅葉まつりでは「継往開来／その先を、照らす。」をテーマに、弘前の歴史と文化から明るい未来を描いたメッセージを込めて、その準備が進められてきました。花から、人と人とをつなぐ。まつりは中止となりましたが、2020年の弘前の秋には、花と紅葉により豊かに彩られた弘前公園、未来へ向けた新たな挑戦、そこに関わる人々の姿がありました。動画をご覧になった方が少しでも元気に。弘前からのエールが、より多くの人に届きますように。

title: HIROSAKI CASTLE CHRYSANTHEMUM AND AUTUMN FOLIAGE FESTIVAL ～Lighting Up the Future.
description: Started in 1962, HIROSAKI CASTLE CHRYSANTHEMUM AND AUTUMN FOLIAGE FESTIVAL is an annual event that symbolizes the autumn of Hirosaki City, Aomori Pref. On October 19, 2020, four days before the Festival, the annual event was cancelled on account of the rapid spread of Covid-19. It was the third cancellation, after the spring cherry festival and the summer Nebuta festival, out of the four festivals of Hirosaki. The HIROSAKI CASTLE CHRYSANTHEMUM AND AUTUMN FOLIAGE FESTIVAL was meant to welcome the arrival of the season under the theme of “Lighting Up the Future.” It was to introduce the city’s history and traditions, and show the way to a brighter future. People Connected with Each Other under the Flowers. Although the festival was cancelled, the autumn of Hirosaki in 2020 saw the red and gold leaves and flowers in Hirosaki Park, and people involved in the event’s making with new challenges for the future. We send this video message to cheer you up, hoping that the greeting from Hirosaki reaches as many people as possible.

title: 旧弘前偕行社　紹介VTR
description: 旧弘前偕行社は、ルネサンス風様式を基調とした建物で、木造平屋建で簡明な洋風建築ですが、規模が大きく要所に配された華やかな細部意匠が特徴です。正面中央上部の屋根窓、軒廻りの持ち送り板、窓廻りの飾り枠や上部に付けた櫛形あるいは三角形の破風飾りなど、豊かな装飾を備えています。玄関廻りは、ポーチに鋳鉄柱を用い、車寄せの妻飾りとして唐草模様と陸軍第８師団に因んだ「蜂」のレリーフが印象的です。館内の大多数の窓ガラスは、気泡が入ったり波を打っておりレトロな雰囲気です。このほか、各部屋の漆喰天井の繊細な中心飾りは当時のままで、暖炉は外国製タイル（一部は欠損）が張られ洗練された意匠を配しています。旧弘前偕行社は、東北地方に残る陸軍関係施設の代表的遺構で陸軍省営繕組織による建築意匠の展開が示され、津軽を代表する棟梁が建築したことなど建築的な観点からも保存価値の高い建物です。終戦後、地域医療・福祉分野の先駆者であった故鳴海康仲氏の創設理念に基づき、弘前厚生学院の現校舎として次世代を担う人材育成を行う教育施設となって今もなお大切に活用されています。

title: Old Hirosaki Kaiko-sha Introduction VTR
description: The Old Hirosaki Kaiko-sha is a building based on Renaissance-style architecture, characterized by its large scale and the lavish details that are strategically placed throughout its simple wooden one-story structure. It features rich decorations such as the roof window at the center of the front, the supporting boards around the eaves, decorative frames around the windows, and the comb-shaped or triangular gable ornaments at the top. The entrance area is impressive with cast iron columns used in the porch and a relief of a 'bee' inspired by the 8th Army Division as a decorative element for the carport. Most of the window glass inside has bubbles and waves, giving it a retro atmosphere. Additionally, the delicate central decorations of the plaster ceilings in each room remain as they were at the time, and the fireplace is adorned with foreign tiles (some of which are missing) featuring sophisticated designs. The Old Hirosaki Kaiko-sha is a representative structure of military-related facilities remaining in the Tohoku region, demonstrating the architectural design developed by the Army Ministry's construction organization, and is a building of high preservation value from an architectural perspective, built by a master carpenter representing Tsugaru. After the war, based on the founding philosophy of the late Yasunaka Narumi, a pioneer in regional medical and welfare fields, it has been repurposed as the current campus of Hirosaki Kousei Gakuin, an educational facility that continues to nurture the next generation.

title: 弘前城石垣修理工事告知PR動画
description: 弘前市では、弘前城本丸東面の石垣修理工事に伴い、天守を約70ｍ本丸の内側へと曳屋する工事を平成27年に実施します。そのため、平成26年の秋頃には天守下の内濠を埋め立て、工事のための仮設基礎を設置する予定です。実際の天守の曳屋は、平成27年の夏頃を予定していますが、内濠の水面に映る天守と桜、水面に浮かぶ花筏といった、下乗橋からのおなじみの光景は、平成26年のさくらまつりを最後にしばらく見ることができません。石垣修理工事には約10年間を要し、曳屋した天守を元の位置に戻すまでにも5年以上かかると見込まれています。石垣修理は、史跡弘前城跡を保護し、後世に継承するため、避けて通ることのできない事業です。何卒、皆さまのご理解とご協力をお願いします。平成26年の春には、ぜひ多くの皆さまに弘前公園にお越し頂き、お城と桜を楽しんで頂ければと思います。

title: Hirosaki Castle Stone Wall Repair Work Announcement PR Video
description: In Hirosaki City, due to the stone wall repair work on the east side of the main keep of Hirosaki Castle, a construction to move the main keep about 70 meters inside the main enclosure will be carried out in 2015. Therefore, around autumn 2014, it is planned to fill in the inner moat under the main keep and set up a temporary foundation for the construction. The actual moving of the main keep is scheduled for the summer of 2015, but the familiar scenery of the main keep and cherry blossoms reflected on the surface of the inner moat, as well as the flower rafts floating on the water, will not be seen for a while after the cherry blossom festival in 2014. The stone wall repair work is expected to take about 10 years, and it is estimated that it will take more than 5 years to return the moved main keep to its original position. The stone wall repair is an unavoidable project to protect the historic site of Hirosaki Castle ruins and pass it on to future generations. We kindly ask for your understanding and cooperation. In the spring of 2014, we hope many of you will come to Hirosaki Park to enjoy the castle and cherry blossoms.

与論島に“光”を見に行く【観光】＝光を見る、と書く。では、“光”とは何か？与論島にはどんな“光”があるのだろう？珊瑚礁が作り上げた風景、史跡、食べ物、アクティビティ...観光映像を撮影するために与論島を訪れたドキュメンタリー映像作家・粂田剛が島中を歩き回りながら、さまざまな島の魅力に触れていく。そして、粂田が最終的に見つけた“光”とは、与論島で生きる“人”だった―――和歌山大学館工学部の木川剛志教授と共に、事前打ち合わせとしてZOOMで初回打ち合わせの際に、この与論島に光を見に行くというテーマが考えられていて、密着とキュメントを2名ほど想定され、その他島の人との出会いを中心に、徒歩で島を巡りながら撮影を進めるというドキュメンタリー作家ならではの手法で与論ファクトリーに臨むことになりました。合計、53名。島外の人5名。粂田監督が実際に取材し撮影した人数です。打ち合わせ時からできたら50名くらいは撮りたいなとおっしゃっていていましたが、1週間の日程で目標を達成されました。密着ドキュメンタリーには、2名男女が選ばれた。島人の高橋さんと、移住者の原さんに白羽の矢が当たり、当初予定していた「与論島に住んでいる人」の地域との関わり方や、与論島に魅了される人の眼差しにフォーカスした撮影が行なわれた。

title: Yoron Tourism Record Have you met the light in Yoron?
description:
Title: Yoron Tourism Record Have you met the light in Yoron? Director: Tsuyoshi Kumeda

Filming Locations: Throughout the town (Akazaki Beach, MEEDAFY’S YUI HOSTEL and COFFEE, Jinjya Shrine, etc.)

Going to Yoron Island to see the 'light'. What does 'light' mean? What kind of 'light' is there on Yoron Island? The documentary filmmaker Tsuyoshi Kumeda, who visited Yoron Island to shoot tourism videos, walked around the island and encountered various attractions of the island. Ultimately, the 'light' that Kumeda found was the 'people' living on Yoron Island. Together with Professor Tsuyoshi Kikawa from Wakayama University, the theme of going to see the light on Yoron Island was considered during the initial Zoom meeting for pre-arrangements, and it was planned to focus on two individuals for close documentation, while also meeting other islanders and filming while walking around the island, a method unique to documentary filmmakers. In total, 53 people were filmed, including 5 from outside the island. The number of people Kumeda interviewed and filmed was achieved within a week, aiming for about 50 people from the beginning. Two individuals were selected for the close documentary: Takahashi, a local islander, and Hara, a migrant, focusing on their relationship with the community and the perspectives of those captivated by Yoron Island.

description:
作品名：私のわいたんDAYS ヨロン島
監督：景山 直恵
撮影編集：小川浩之
楽曲提供：アキラノスケ
ボーカル： yasuha

作品秘話
「ワイタンデー」＝「すごい！」「やばい！」などの感情を表す与論の方言を使用したタイトルで、作品の中で高校生たちがしきりに「やばい！やばい！」と思わず口に出していた感動の言葉を、島人に教えてもらった事をきっかけでタイトルにも採用しました。島外高校生が与論島の高校生と島を巡る旅「与論島の高校生が普段よく行く場所や、おすすめのポイントに連れて行ってもらう。ふたりがエモいと思う場所なども紹介。自分たちの暮らしや普段思うことの違いや共通点、これからのことやお互いの悩みなど、島外の高校生と与論島の高校生のリアルを語りながら与論島を案内する。」という企画内容を基に、事前に撮影許可を取得し、撮影に挑みました。
　景山監督は、元々グラフィックデザイナーであり、デザインコンサルを主な生業にされていますが、監督としては初の取り組みで、映像作家の小川氏とは仕事を依頼する側として繋がりがあり、お二人の感性を合わせた作品作りとなりました。

title: My Waitan Days: Yoron Island
description:
Title: My Waitan Days: Yoron Island
Director: Naoe Kageyama
Cinematography and Editing: Hiroyuki Ogawa
Music Provided by: Akiranosuke
Vocal: yasuha

Behind the Work
The title 'Waitan Days' uses a Yoron dialect that expresses emotions like 'amazing!' or 'incredible!' and was inspired by the emotional words 'yabai! yabai!' that high school students repeatedly exclaimed in the work, which they learned from the islanders. The project is based on a journey where high school students from outside the island are guided by Yoron Island high school students to places they often visit and recommend. It introduces places that both find emotional, discusses the differences and commonalities in their lives and thoughts, their future, and their worries, while guiding the island. The filming was conducted after obtaining permission in advance. Director Kageyama, originally a graphic designer and primarily a design consultant, took on this project for the first time as a director, collaborating with filmmaker Ogawa, with whom he had a working relationship as a client, resulting in a fusion of their sensibilities in the creation of this work.

title: 予期せぬ出会い～Unexpected Encounter～
description:
作品名：「Unexpected Encounter～予期せぬ出会い～」　

監督―― 宮田 耕輔
映像――反保シュウジ
写真――Eito Mars

撮影場所：
ウドノスビーチ・寺崎漁港・鳩の池・大金久海岸・サトウキビ畑・アジニッチェー神社・味咲・居酒屋やす　など

撮影秘話：
人に会いに行く島。
　宮田組一行は、3泊4日のスケジュールで初日の午後与論島に到着し、ゲストハウスKAIを拠点に撮影場所は実際に島を巡りながら、人の温かさに触れる旅を想定した企画を元に、「与論の人に出会う旅の中で、物書きの宮田氏が与論で感じ綴られた言葉と、Eito Mars氏が切り取った与論島の美しい情景、その旅の様子とまた別の視線で捉えた反保氏の映像がMIXされて作り出される観光映像」を制作するという内容で撮影を進めていきました。
　宮田組はレンタカーで島を巡りながら、ウドノスビーチで与論島産みずレモンを栽培している島人から、観光客があまり知らない夕日スポットを教えてもらって撮影したり、粂田監督の撮影にも協力を頂いていた肥田みちよさんが行っているテントサウナを体験したり、朝日のシーンを撮影に訪れた鳩の池では、三線と法螺貝で観光客をもてなす島人に出会うなど、与論の人の出会いが繋がりながら、撮影がすすめられました。その島の人との出会いの体験を元に、実際に宮田監督が紡いだ文章が作品内で使用されるテロップに流れ、その心象風景を納めたスチールカメラの写真と実写が映し出される映像作品として仕上がりました。

title: Unexpected Encounter～予期せぬ出会い～
description:
Title: "Unexpected Encounter～予期せぬ出会い～"

Director: Kousuke Miyata
Visual: Shuji Hanbo
Photography: Eito Mars

Filming Locations:
Udonos Beach, Terasaki Fishing Port, Hato Pond, Okkinuku Coast, Sugarcane Fields, Ajinichie Shrine, Ajisaki, Izakaya Yasu, etc.

Filming Anecdote:
A journey to meet people on the island.
The Miyata crew arrived on Yoron Island on the afternoon of the first day with a 3-night, 4-day schedule, using Guest House KAI as a base. The filming locations were planned to be explored while experiencing the warmth of the people. The project aimed to create a tourism video that mixes the words written by writer Miyata, who felt and expressed his experiences on Yoron, the beautiful scenery of Yoron Island captured by Eito Mars, and the footage taken from a different perspective by Shuji Hanbo. The crew traveled around the island by rental car, capturing moments such as meeting islanders cultivating Yoron Island's water lemons at Udonos Beach, discovering sunset spots unknown to tourists, experiencing a tent sauna run by Michiyo Hida, who also assisted in the filming of Director Kumeda, and encountering islanders welcoming tourists with sanshin and conch shells at Hato Pond during a sunrise shoot. The filming progressed as connections with the people of Yoron were made. Based on these experiences, the text woven by Director Miyata was used in the subtitles of the work, culminating in a video piece that showcases both still photographs and live-action footage of the imagined landscapes.

About 2 hours by ferry from Motobu Port in northern Okinawa lies Yoron Island, a 'tropical paradise' boasting beautiful blue seas.

Yoron Island features the stunning YORON BLUE sea and various marine leisure activities to enjoy. In addition to the sea, the island offers history, local culture, delicious food, and unforgettable encounters with the island's people, creating lasting travel memories. Whether with friends, as a couple, or with family, the beautiful sea and kind people of this island are always waiting for you.

The greenery of Yanbaru in Okinawa and the beautiful blue sea of Yoron Island. The two different charms spread across the sea are connected by a ferry, delivering a unique tourism experience.

title: ♭ヨロン
description: 監督 楠の目に映った与論島の人と文化をライター村上美香が詩に落とし込み、CM音楽プロデューサー福島節の作った楽曲を与論島民の竹下千帆さんに歌ってもらい、与論島にはじめて訪れた旅人役 福島真希の心の変化を描いた作品です。本作は楠が与論島で体験した「おかえりなさい文化」を主軸に企画しました。実際に「おかえりなさい文化」という言葉などありませんが、与論島民の根底には「わざわざ遠い島まで来てくれてありがとう」という来島者への感謝や敬意が込められており、それが来島者を「おかえりなさい」という言葉として迎え入れる理由だと聞きました。場所ではなく人に会いに行く観光地なんだ、と気付かされた与論島ならではの温度感を描写した作品です。

title: ♭Yoron
description: This work depicts the changes in the heart of the traveler, played by Maki Fukushima, who visited Yoron Island for the first time, with the culture and people of Yoron Island reflected through the eyes of director Kenta Kusunoki, and the song created by music producer Setsu Fukushima sung by Chihiro Takeshita, a resident of Yoron Island. The project was centered around the 'Welcome Back Culture' that Kusunoki experienced on Yoron Island. Although the term 'Welcome Back Culture' does not actually exist, it is said that the essence of the Yoron Islanders is filled with gratitude and respect for visitors who have come all the way to the distant island, which is the reason they welcome visitors with the words 'Welcome Back.' This work captures the unique warmth of Yoron Island, which made me realize that it is a tourist destination to meet people rather than places.

Blooming period: Late March to early April

title: Kumamoto Prefecture Minami Aso Village Furusato Tax Return Gift PR Movie 15 seconds version
description: From the world's number one caldera village, to you. Minami Aso Village in Kumamoto Prefecture. A peaceful rural village located on the southern slope of the Aso caldera, which boasts one of the largest sizes in the world. It has a group of spring water, including the Shirakawa water source, which has been selected as one of Japan's top 100 famous waters by the Ministry of the Environment, providing rich benefits to the lives of the villagers as a 'hometown of water.' It is very rare for people to live within a caldera and for a railway to run there, making it a tourist destination known as the 'world's number one caldera village.' description: 南阿蘇・下野地区にある「南阿蘇・宮崎製茶」は、昭和27年に創業した老舗の製茶工場。その三代目、宮崎さん。先代から受け継いだ3ヘクタールの茶畑で、玉緑茶・粉末緑茶、ほうじ茶を作っています。さらに平成23年には、村内で唯一となる紅茶の製造も開始しました。宮崎製茶工場自慢のお茶は、すべて宮崎さん自らがほぼお一人で作っています。茶葉の刈り取りから乾燥、発酵など、完成までのいくつもの工程がありますが、苦労もなんのその。楽しみながらお茶づくりに励んでいます。「宮崎製茶工場」宮崎さんが作る自慢のお茶、是非一度ご賞味ください。

description: Minami-Aso, Shimono area 'Minami-Aso Miyazaki Tea' is a long-established tea factory founded in 1952. The third generation, Mr. Miyazaki, produces gyokuro, powdered green tea, and hojicha in a 3-hectare tea field inherited from his predecessor. In addition, in 2011, he started producing black tea, the only one in the village. All of the tea that Miyazaki Tea Factory is proud of is made almost entirely by Mr. Miyazaki himself. There are many processes from harvesting tea leaves to drying and fermentation, but despite the hardships, he enjoys making tea. Please try the proud tea made by Mr. Miyazaki at 'Miyazaki Tea Factory' at least once.

description: Introducing the sake of Minami-Aso Village, created with the belief that good sake cannot be made without good water and rice. Minami-Aso Village in Kumamoto Prefecture, known as the 'Land of Water,' is blessed with high-quality water that has been selected as one of Japan's 100 Famous Waters. The sake made from this mineral-rich spring water and sake rice grown without pesticides or fertilizers during the cultivation period offers a smooth drinking experience and rich aroma. The variety of sake available, including junmai sake, rice shochu, crisp dry types, and those with moderate sweetness, is unique to Kumamoto, where delicious rice and water abound. The water that springs from the Shirakawa Water Source and other spring groups nourishes the rice fields and farms of Minami-Aso Village, allowing delicious rice, vegetables, and fruits to grow. The water from the Shirakawa Water Source is delivered in its original deliciousness as moderately mineralized soft water through non-heating processing.

description: The fresh cheese bun 1592 is a fresh cheese bun filled with a heartfelt commitment to the selection of ingredients. The raw material for the cheese filling is ASOMILK from Abe Farm. description: 世界最大級のカルデラが広がる熊本・阿蘇。そこには脈々と流れるミネラル豊富な湧水があり、そしてその全てを吸収してすくすくと育った栄養たっぷりのお米が育ちます。昼夜の寒暖差が激しい阿蘇の気候と、澄んだ空気、清らかな湧水によって、旨味をギュッと蓄えたお米になり、甘みは格別です。南阿蘇村では、農薬・除草剤などを最大限に減らす為に優しいアイガモ農法を取り入れ、またJAS有機認定の優しい肥料のみを使用するなど、安心・安全面でもこだわり抜いたお米作りも盛んです。全国的に人気が高い「コシヒカリ」も南阿蘇村産のお米の中ではとても人気で、一粒一粒を噛むごとにモチモチした触感とお米本来の甘さが感じられます。この「コシヒカリ」は炊きたてはもちろんですが、冷めても美味しく食べられるので、お弁当に入れるご飯としても非常におすすめのお米です。農家の優しい愛情が感じられる旨味たっぷりのお米を、ぜひ一度ご賞味ください。

title: Kumamoto Prefecture Minami-Aso Village Furusato Tax Return Gift PR Movie 'Minami-Aso Rice' Edition
description: Kumamoto and Aso, where the world's largest caldera spreads. There is mineral-rich spring water flowing through it, and the nutritious rice that has absorbed all of it grows vigorously. The climate of Aso, with its significant temperature difference between day and night, clear air, and pure spring water, creates rice that is packed with flavor and has exceptional sweetness. In Minami-Aso Village, they adopt a gentle duck farming method to minimize the use of pesticides and herbicides, and they are also actively engaged in rice cultivation that is committed to safety and security by using only gentle fertilizers certified by JAS organic. The nationally popular 'Koshihikari' is also very popular among the rice produced in Minami-Aso Village, and with each grain you chew, you can feel the chewy texture and the inherent sweetness of the rice. This 'Koshihikari' is delicious not only when freshly cooked but also when cooled, making it highly recommended for inclusion in bento boxes. Please enjoy the flavorful rice that reflects the gentle love of the farmers.

title: 新阿蘇大橋 開通直前企画『復興への光の架け橋』
description: 2021年3月7日、熊本地震で崩落した阿蘇大橋が「新阿蘇大橋」として生まれ変わり、ついに開通します。 その直前企画として、新阿蘇大橋とその展望所のライトアップ『復興への光の架け橋』が実施されました。こちらはその記録動画です。 新阿蘇大橋が「熊本と阿蘇をつなぐ架け橋」「復興した未来へとつながる架け橋」「人と人とをつなぐ架け橋」のシンボルになればという願いが込められています。 ＜復興への光の架け橋＞ 期間：2021年1月15日(金)～2月21日(日) 18:00～ 内容：新阿蘇大橋と数鹿流崩之碑展望所の装飾 企画：新阿蘇大橋活性化協議会 協力：立野わかもん会 ※実施に際して、新阿蘇大橋施工業者の方にもご協力いただいています。ありがとうございます。 撮影・編集 Hub.craft

title: New Aso Bridge Opening Just Before Project 'Bridge of Light to Reconstruction'
description: On March 7, 2021, the Aso Bridge, which collapsed due to the Kumamoto earthquake, will be reborn as the 'New Aso Bridge' and will finally open. As a pre-opening project, the lighting up of the New Aso Bridge and its observation point, 'Bridge of Light to Reconstruction', was carried out. This is a recorded video of that event. It is hoped that the New Aso Bridge will become a symbol of 'a bridge connecting Kumamoto and Aso', 'a bridge leading to a reconstructed future', and 'a bridge connecting people'. <Bridge of Light to Reconstruction> Period: January 15, 2021 (Friday) to February 21, 2021 (Sunday) from 18:00 Content: Decoration of the New Aso Bridge and the Kazurakuryu Collapse Monument Observation Point Planning: New Aso Bridge Activation Council Cooperation: Tateno Wakamon Association *We would like to thank the contractors of the New Aso Bridge for their cooperation in this implementation. Shooting and editing by Hub.craft.

title: 2020年10月3日 国道57号（現道）開通
description:
国道57号線 立野区間 （通称:立野キャニオンロード）

遥か昔、健磐龍命が蹴破り阿蘇を拓いた伝説が残る立野峡谷。その壮大な景観を望みながら阿蘇へと続く国道57号線は、地元では“立野キャニオンロード”と呼ば親しまれてきました。
2016年熊本地震の大規模斜面崩落(数鹿流くずれ)により寸断されていたが、約4年半の時を経て2020年10月3日に開通します。

title: Opening of National Route 57 (Current Road) on October 3, 2020
description:
National Route 57 Line, the Tateyano section (commonly known as Tateyano Canyon Road)

Long ago, there is a legend that the deity Kenbanryu no Mikoto broke through and developed Aso in the Tateyano Gorge. The National Route 57 line, which continues to Aso while overlooking its magnificent scenery, has been affectionately called 'Tateyano Canyon Road' by locals. It was cut off due to a large-scale landslide (Suzukaryu collapse) caused by the Kumamoto earthquake in 2016, but it will open on October 3, 2020, after about four and a half years.

title: 【南阿蘇】レンタサイクルに乗ろう！絶景ロードを走って白川水源までver.
description: 【レンタサイクルに乗ろう！絶景ロードを走って白川水源までver.】南阿蘇の一番人気のアクティビティ、レンタサイクルの動画をご紹介！快適な電動アシスト付自転車にまたがり、雄大な阿蘇の大パノラマを感じながら白川水源まで。観光案内所スタッフのオススメコース、一本道の田園風景を走る「絶景ロード」や南阿蘇鉄道沿線沿いを走る「トレインロード」など地元に住むコーディネーターだからそこ知る南阿蘇を満喫できるスペシャルコースとなっています。車の通りも少ない田舎道を選び、なるべく安全なコース設定となっています。今回の目的地である「白川水源」は熊本を代表する南阿蘇湧水群の代名詞とも言える水源で一級河川白川の総水源。毎分60トンもの湧水が地底の砂とともに勢いよく湧き上がり、訪れる人々に大地の恵みを感じさせます。南阿蘇観光案内所ではe-sports bike（電動クロスバイク）、ママチャリ自転車(電動アシスト付)、子供用マウンテンバイク（※電動アシストなし）など様々な年齢に対応した自転車をご用意しております。南阿蘇に訪れた際は是非、ご利用ください。レンタサイクル料金などはみなみあそ観光局HPをご覧ください。

title: Let's Ride a Rental Bicycle in Minami Aso! Running on the Scenic Road to Shirakawa Springs ver.
description: This video introduces the most popular activity in Minami Aso, rental cycling! Hop on a comfortable electric assist bicycle and feel the magnificent panorama of Aso while heading to Shirakawa Springs. The recommended courses by the staff at the tourist information center include the 'Scenic Road' that runs through the picturesque rural landscape and the 'Train Road' along the Minami Aso Railway, making it a special course that allows you to fully enjoy Minami Aso, known by local coordinators. The course is set to be as safe as possible, choosing country roads with little traffic. The destination, 'Shirakawa Springs,' is a representative water source of Kumamoto, known as the symbol of the Minami Aso spring water group, and is the total water source of the first-class river Shirakawa. Every minute, 60 tons of spring water gushes up vigorously along with the underground sand, allowing visitors to feel the blessings of the earth. The Minami Aso Tourist Information Center offers various bicycles suitable for different ages, including e-sports bikes (electric cross bikes), mama-chari bicycles (with electric assist), and children's mountain bikes (without electric assist). If you visit Minami Aso, please make sure to use them. For rental bicycle fees and more, please check the Minami Aso Tourism Bureau website.

title: 東海大学農学部を卒業する皆さんへ～2020年 春～
description:
～東海大学農学部を卒業される皆様へ～

大学ご卒業おめでとうございます。

4年間の密度の濃い大学生活を経て、これから社会人としてそれぞれの道へと進むべく、皆様の心は今、期待や不安、そして覚悟でいっぱいかと存じます。

入学直後には熊本地震があり、皆様に大変な思いをさせてしまったことを申し訳なく思います。それでも若い皆さんが少しでも住んでくれて、またキャンパスが移った後も南阿蘇に関わってくれて、本当に嬉しかったです。

今回、残念ながら新型コロナの影響で卒業式も中止となり、別れを惜しむ時間も取れないまま見送ることとなってしまい、大変無念な気持ちでおります。そこで、皆様に向けたせめてものエールとして、南阿蘇村一同からお祝いと感謝の気持ちを込めたメッセージ動画をお届けします。南阿蘇村には皆様の居場所がいつでもあります。立派になった皆さんとまたお会いできる日を楽しみにしています。

夢に向かって元気に羽ばたく皆様のご多幸を心より祈念いたします。

title: To All Graduates of Tokai University Faculty of Agriculture - Spring 2020
description:
Congratulations on your graduation from university.

After four years of a dense university life, I believe your hearts are now filled with expectations, anxieties, and determination as you each embark on your respective paths as members of society.

I sincerely apologize for the difficulties you faced due to the Kumamoto earthquake shortly after your enrollment. Nevertheless, I was truly happy that you young people lived here even a little, and that you continued to be involved with Minami Aso after the campus moved.

Unfortunately, due to the impact of the new coronavirus, the graduation ceremony has been canceled, and we have had to send you off without the time to bid farewell, which is very regrettable. Therefore, as a small token of encouragement for you, we are delivering a message video filled with congratulations and gratitude from all of Minami Aso Village. There will always be a place for you in Minami Aso Village. We look forward to the day we can meet again with all of you who have become wonderful individuals.

I sincerely wish for your happiness as you energetically spread your wings toward your dreams.

description: 「南阿蘇ラブチェアー＆イルミネーション」公式HP ⇒ https://minamiaso.love/ 南阿蘇の冬のシンボル「南阿蘇スターライトイルミネーション」。第8回目は2019年11月16日（土）に点灯式を開催しました。当日はイルミネーションの点火に加えて、日中はラブチェアー作成ワークショップ、福岡消防音楽隊有志による演奏。夜には南阿蘇エリアの小中学生と作成した700個の灯篭も「ありがとう みなみあそ」のメッセージと共に点灯し、熱気球体験も開催しました。イルミネーションは2020年2月16日（日）まで、毎日午後5時～9時まで点灯いたします。

title: 8th Minami Aso Starlight Illumination Lighting Ceremony
description: Official HP of 'Minami Aso Love Chair & Illumination' ⇒ https://minamiaso.love/ The winter symbol of Minami Aso, 'Minami Aso Starlight Illumination'. The 8th event was held on November 16, 2019 (Saturday) with a lighting ceremony. In addition to the illumination lighting, there was a love chair creation workshop during the day, and a performance by members of the Fukuoka Fire Department Music Band. At night, 700 lanterns created by elementary and junior high school students in the Minami Aso area were lit with the message 'Thank you Minami Aso', and a hot air balloon experience was also held. The illumination will be lit every day from 5 PM to 9 PM until February 16, 2020 (Sunday).

description: 世界的に有名な飛驒高山と比べて、わずか一駅の距離にある飛騨古川は、静かに存在している場所です。同じく世界無形文化遺産である古川祭を持つ古川町は、観光客に彼らの穏やかな生活を邪魔されたくないようです。白壁土蔵の古い町並みがあるにもかかわらず、ここに住む人々は古い生業を続けています。

title: Documentary in the Countryside: Japan EP03 | A Mountain Town Refusing Check-in Tourists, Just One Stop from Takayama | Gifu Prefecture Hida Furukawa
description: Compared to the world-renowned Takayama, Hida Furukawa, just one stop away, is a quietly existing place. The town of Furukawa, which also has the world intangible cultural heritage of the Furukawa Festival, seems reluctant to be disturbed by tourists in their leisurely lives. Despite the charm of the old town with its white-walled storehouses, the locals continue their ancient livelihoods.

title: 福島，並不是你印象中的荒地！這裡有藝術，有回憶，有未來 | 福島縣耶麻郡西會津 | 在地紀錄片【鄉野中的日本】EP02
description: 福島、一個談之色變的地名。因勉強還能維持生活，使得人口老化問題遲遲不受到重視。直到2011東日本大震災敲響了警鐘，讓在地年輕人意識到變革勢在必行。

title: Fukushima, Not the Wasteland You Imagine! Here There is Art, Memories, and a Future | Nishiaizu, Yamagata Prefecture | Local Documentary [Japan in the Countryside] EP02
description: Fukushima, a name that evokes fear. Due to the ability to barely maintain a living, the issue of an aging population has long been overlooked. It wasn't until the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake sounded the alarm that local youth realized that change was imperative.

title: 在地紀錄片【鄉野中的日本】EP01 | 修驗道行者隱居深山打造完美治愈空間 | 奈良縣宇陀市深野
description: 今回の巡旅君が訪れたのは、奈良県宇陀市深野にある「笹百合庵」です。松林哲司先生は、特異な人生経験を持つ人物で、大学時代に一人で世界を旅し、ヒマラヤ山脈の神秘に魅了されながらも、大阪で商社を経営していました。その後、理想の精神世界を追求するために修験道の僧侶となり、深山の村にある百年の古民家を改造し、ここで修行し、ビジネスを行い、世界中の旅人を迎え入れています。彼が追い求めるものは、現代の都市生活に奔走する人々が体験する土地と居住空間の一体どのようなものでしょうか？

title: Documentary in the Countryside: Japan EP01 | 修験道行者が深山に隠れ家を作り出す完璧な癒しの空間 | 奈良県宇陀市深野
description: This time, the traveler visits 'Sasayuri-an' located in Fukano, Uda City, Nara Prefecture, founded by a practitioner of Shugendo, Mr. Tetsuji Matsubayashi. Mr. Matsubayashi is a person with a unique life experience, having traveled the world alone during his university days. Although he was captivated by the mystery and solemnity of the Himalayas, he eventually returned to his hometown to run a trading company in Osaka. Later, in pursuit of his ideal spiritual world, he became a Shugendo monk, transforming a century-old house in a mountain village to practice, conduct business, and host travelers from around the world. What kind of land and living space is he seeking, which he also hopes modern urban dwellers can experience?

title: 冬いく！冬うく！宇久島冬動画！
description: 冬は離島に行ってもやることがない？いやいや実は冬の宇久島こそ島の醍醐味を味わえるんですよ！寒い時期しか楽しめない島の魅力が目いっぱい詰まった冬動画をお届けします！

title: Winter is Coming! Winter Fun on Ukushima Island!
description: Is there nothing to do even if you go to an island in winter? No, actually, winter is when you can truly enjoy the charm of Ukushima Island! We deliver a winter video packed with the island's attractions that can only be enjoyed in the cold season!

title: 五島列島最北端「宇久島」　ショートフィルム『Present（仮）』
description: 『Gift（仮）』から二年後。宇久島に移住した成海は、満月の夜にだけ現れる隣人・松浦すずと出会う。竜宮城伝説や神島神社の神楽、かんころ餅など島の文化を織り込み、幻想と現実の境界を描き出します。配信などを通じて、国内外の観客に「宇久島という物語」を届ける作品です。

title: Goto Islands' Northernmost Point: Ukushima - Short Film 'Present (Tentative)'
description: 'Gift (Tentative)' two years later. Narumi, who moved to Ukushima, meets her neighbor, Matsuura Suzu, who only appears on full moon nights. The film weaves in the island's culture, including the legend of the Dragon Palace, the Kagura of Kamishima Shrine, and Kankoro mochi, depicting the boundary between fantasy and reality. It is a work that delivers 'the story of Ukushima' to audiences both domestically and internationally through distribution and other means.

title: 五島列島最北端「宇久島」　縦型ショートドラマ『Gift（仮）』
description: ネット社会に疲れ、心を閉ざした26歳の成海が、偶然たどり着いた宇久島で“見習いの閻魔”やアコウの巨樹と出会い、次第に自分を取り戻していく物語。長崎鼻遺跡や透明な海を背景に、島の自然や伝承をモチーフに描かれます。縦型映像で制作され、SNS世代に“宇久島を偶然見つける”体験を提供します。

title: Goto Islands' Northernmost Island 'Ukushima' Vertical Short Drama 'Gift (Tentative)'
description: A story about 26-year-old Narumi, who, tired of the online world and closing her heart, accidentally arrives at Ukushima, where she meets an 'apprentice Enma' and a giant Akou tree, gradually regaining herself. Set against the backdrop of the Nagasaki Nose ruins and transparent seas, it depicts the island's nature and traditions. Produced in a vertical format, it offers the SNS generation an experience of 'accidentally discovering Ukushima.'

title: Ukushima Tourism Video: Miu Shiota's Travel Log! Vol. 2
description: Miu Shiota, the Ukushima tourism ambassador, enjoys her summer vacation! A fresh trip to Ukushima, the northernmost island of the Goto Islands in Nagasaki Prefecture, visited privately. Enjoying the island's specialty, kankoro mochi, and the popular island champon while strolling past the old townscape. Detoxing without even realizing it. A trip that brings peace of mind! Whether alone, in a group, or with family! Let's go to Ukushima, filled with many charms different from bustling tourist spots!

title: Yoron Island Your own life, your own voyage.  4K(Francais)
description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

The title “Nichinichi kore Yoron” is an homage to the Zen phrase, “Nichinichi kore kojitsu” which means “Everyday is a good day so we appreciate every moment of our life and every moment is special. Live life just the way it is. “
We’ve learned how important it is to appreciate every moment of our life during the pandemic. 
Tourism is one of the sectors most affected by the COVID-19 pandemic. Yoron Island is no exception.
Every year, the island is suffers from severe typhoons which has an impact on the tourist economy. Yoron Island also survived the harsh realities of WWII. 
The theme of this film is to display the power and beauty of nature resilience as it accepts everything life throws at it.
We will tell the story of the strength and beauty of Yoron island through the use of personification.
We want to encourage the people of Yoron Island and other Islands suffering from depopulation.

title: ヨロン島 あなた自身の人生、あなた自身の航海。 4K(フランス語)
description:
ウェブサイト
https://etooto.jp/

タイトル「日々これよろん」は、禅の言葉「日々これ好日」に敬意を表したもので、「毎日が良い日であり、私たちの人生のすべての瞬間を感謝し、すべての瞬間が特別である。ありのままの人生を生きる。」という意味です。
私たちは、パンデミックの間に人生のすべての瞬間を大切にすることがどれほど重要であるかを学びました。
観光業はCOVID-19パンデミックの影響を最も受けたセクターの一つです。ヨロン島も例外ではありません。
毎年、島は観光経済に影響を与える厳しい台風に悩まされています。ヨロン島はまた、第二次世界大戦の厳しい現実を生き延びました。
この映画のテーマは、自然の力と美しさの回復力を示すことであり、自然は人生が投げかけるすべてを受け入れます。
私たちは、擬人法を用いてヨロン島の強さと美しさの物語を語ります。
私たちは、過疎化に苦しむヨロン島や他の島々の人々を励ましたいと考えています。

鞆の浦のことを地元では「鞆＝とも」と呼びます。
日本語で「友」「朋」「共」といった響きを持つこの名には、鞆の浦の人びとが大切にしてきた自然との共生、家族や友だちと支え合いながら生きてきた言霊が宿ります。

よろこびをもって日々をくりかえす鞆の浦の暮らしに触れてみましょう。

title: Celebrate Tomonoura Together -Japanese-【鞆の浦】
description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

In the local area, Tomonoura is referred to as 'Tomonoura = Tomo'.
This name, which resonates with the Japanese words for 'friend', 'companion', and 'together', embodies the spirit of coexistence with nature that the people of Tomonoura have cherished, as well as the bonds of support among family and friends.
Through this video 'Together in Time', we invite you to return to the gentle and peaceful moments that breathe life into the Japan Heritage recognized 'Tomonoura'.

In Chapter 3 'Celebrate Together', we introduce 10 festivals and rituals that bring the tranquil port town together in celebration.
Let’s experience the daily life of Tomonoura, where joy is repeated.

description: 「冬の田んぼアート２０２２」は、新型コロナウイルスの感染拡大を防止するため、やむを得ず、中止となりましたが、青森県では、田舎館村及びスノーアーティスト集団「It’s OK」の協力のもと制作したスノーアートの映像を公開します。スノーアートのテーマは「花時の日の出」です。「花時」とは、春にいろいろな花が咲き始める時期のことを指し、特に桜を指すことが多いそうです。そのように、桜が咲き始める頃までに新型コロナウイルス感染症が収束し、日の出のように未来が明るくなることを祈って制作しました。

title: Inakadate Village Winter Rice Field Art 2022 'Sunrise of Flower Time'
description: The 'Winter Rice Field Art 2022' has been unfortunately canceled to prevent the spread of the novel coronavirus. However, in Aomori Prefecture, a video of the snow art created in cooperation with Inakadate Village and the snow artist group 'It’s OK' will be released. The theme of the snow art is 'Sunrise of Flower Time.' 'Flower Time' refers to the time in spring when various flowers begin to bloom, often specifically referring to cherry blossoms. It was created with the hope that by the time the cherry blossoms begin to bloom, the COVID-19 pandemic will be over, and the future will be bright like the sunrise.

title: 2020 Zabon no Tsuki (Full Moon at Tanesashi Coast) Time-lapse

When I climbed to the tip where the beach daisies and eastern daisies grow, the full moon like a Zabon rose up. Shinpei Kusano 'Tanesashi Coast' 1973.

title: これが、青森県の本気のリンゴCMだ！「あおもりんご」CM
description: 青森県では、リンゴ試験場で約３００種、県内で約５０種のリンゴが栽培されており、日本一の生産量を誇ります。(そのうち、市場に出荷されているのは約４０種類程度) 本CMには本物の青森のリンゴ農家のみなさんが出演し、しりとりを繰り広げます。真冬の雪を溶かすような、素人とは思えない熱演を是非ご覧ください！さらに、CMの中にも登場する「リンゴのポスト」や「リンゴ型のつり革」、「リンゴ型のカーブミラー」、「リンゴ型の駅のホームの無線」など、街中の至るところにまでリンゴ愛があふれる青森県。この青森県の圧倒的なリンゴの種類の多さとあふれるリンゴ愛を知ってもらいたいとの思いから、今回のCMを制作いたしました。1月から3月にかけて、出荷量が最も多くなる青森県のリンゴ。スーパーで選ぶ際はぜひ、青森県産のリンゴをご賞味ください！

title: This is Aomori's Serious Apple Commercial! 'Aomorin' CM
description: In Aomori Prefecture, about 300 varieties of apples are cultivated at the Apple Research Station, and about 50 varieties are grown in the prefecture, boasting the highest production volume in Japan. (Of these, about 40 varieties are shipped to the market.) In this commercial, real Aomori apple farmers participate and engage in a game of shiritori. Please watch their impressive performances that melt the winter snow, which are hard to believe are from amateurs! Furthermore, Aomori is filled with love for apples, with apple-themed items such as 'apple post boxes', 'apple-shaped handrails', 'apple-shaped convex mirrors', and 'apple-shaped wireless stations' appearing throughout the city. This commercial was created to share the overwhelming variety of apples and the abundant love for apples in Aomori Prefecture. From January to March, Aomori apples have the highest shipping volume. When choosing apples at the supermarket, please enjoy Aomori-grown apples!

title: 漁師の一日　風間浦のアンコウ漁
description: 木村喜志雄さんが伝統的な「からばり」を使った唯一の漁師である青森県風間浦村のアンコウ漁。冬の津軽海峡での漁は厳しいですが、温泉や昔からの仲間たちが漁の疲れを癒してくれます。漁師の一日を通して、青森ならではの暮らしぶりを紹介します。

title: A Day in the Life of a Fisherman: Angler Fishing in Kazamaura
description: Kimura Kishiou is the only fisherman using the traditional 'karabari' in angler fishing in Kazamaura, Aomori Prefecture. Fishing in the Tsugaru Strait during winter is tough, but hot springs and old friends help relieve the fatigue of fishing. This introduces the unique lifestyle of Aomori through a fisherman's day.

title: DELISH AOMORI「津軽あかつきの会　古津軽伝承料理」vie
description: 弘前市石川地区。３０人ほどの「かっちゃ」が集まり、地域の伝承料理の復活と保存に取り組んでいるのが「津軽あかつきの会」です。使う食材のほとんどが地元産。雪に閉ざされる冬の季節には、発酵・乾燥・塩蔵といった伝承された技術を凝らした「古津軽伝承料理」でもてなしてくれます。訪れた人を温かく迎えてくれる「津軽あかつきの会」の雰囲気までお届けする、DELISH AOMORIのSpecial Movieです。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Tsugaru Akatsuki no Kai Ancient Tsugaru Traditional Cuisine'
description: In the Ishikawa district of Hirosaki City, about 30 'kaccha' gather to work on the revival and preservation of local traditional cuisine through the 'Tsugaru Akatsuki no Kai'. Most of the ingredients used are locally sourced. During the winter season, when snow covers the area, they welcome visitors with 'Ancient Tsugaru Traditional Cuisine' that incorporates traditional techniques such as fermentation, drying, and salting. This is a special movie from DELISH AOMORI that conveys the warm atmosphere of 'Tsugaru Akatsuki no Kai' that welcomes visitors.

title: DELISH AOMORI「風間浦村のあんこうのベーコン巻き」
description: The recipe video 'Delish Aomori' delivered by all of Aomori is finally at its last episode, the 12th. The final ingredient is the anko from Kazamaura Village. Kazamaura Village is very close to the fishing grounds for anko, and exceptionally fresh anko is landed. When you think of anko, the first thing that comes to mind is probably anko nabe (stew). The recipe introduced this time is 'Bacon-Wrapped Anko', which can be enjoyed deliciously in a Western style. The combination of the mild anko flesh and the umami and saltiness of the bacon is exquisite. We will also deliver the lively atmosphere of the Kazamaura Anko Appreciation Festival, which is held once a year in Kazamaura Village.

We have created a potage soup that deliciously captures the fruity sweetness that is unlike any other vegetable while enjoying the flavor of the carrot itself. Please give it a try.

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Fukaura Snow Carrot Potage'
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」の第１１弾。今回の食材は深浦町で栽培される「ふかうら雪人参」。野菜とは思えないほどフルーティーな甘みを活かしつつ、人参そのものの風味を美味しく味わえるポタージュスープに仕上げています。ぜひお試しください。「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。

title: DELISH AOMORI「津軽百年食堂　清おばあちゃん」
description: Kuroishi-shi no Konan Tetsudo Kuroishi Eki-mae ni mise o kakumeru 'Sugou Shokudo' wa Taisho jidai kara 4 dai ni watatte uketsugare, 'Tsugaru Hyakunen Shokudo' no 1 ten ni kazoeraremasu. Genzai no ten'nushi, Sugou Kiyo-san wa 87-sai to natta ima demo, chouri tantou to shite gen'eki de mise ni tachi tsuzukete iru obaachan desu. Mise to tomo ni hyakunen uketsugaru kawaranai aji to, dokoka natsukashisa o oboeru mise no fun'iki o tsutaeru, DELISH AOMORI ga otodoke suru Special Movie desu.

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Tsugaru Hyakunen Shokudo Kiyo Obaachan'
description: Located in front of Kuroishi Station on the Konan Railway in Kuroishi City, 'Sugou Shokudo' has been passed down for four generations since the Taisho era and is counted as one of the 'Tsugaru Hyakunen Shokudo'. The current owner, Kiyo Sugou, is an 87-year-old grandmother who still stands in the kitchen as the cook. This is a Special Movie brought to you by DELISH AOMORI that conveys the unchanging taste passed down for a hundred years along with the nostalgic atmosphere of the shop.

title: DELISH AOMORI「大間マグロのマグロカツ」
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」。第１０弾はあの有名食材、大間のマグロ。刺身で食べてももちろん最高に美味しいのは間違いないですが、カリッとサクサクの衣、中身はとろけるレアのカツに仕上げました。やっぱり大間のマグロは美味しいです！「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Tuna Cutlet from Oma'
description: This is a recipe video series 'DELISH AOMORI' brought to you by Aomori. The 10th installment features the famous ingredient, Oma tuna. It's undoubtedly delicious when eaten as sashimi, but we've made it into a crispy, crunchy cutlet with a melt-in-your-mouth rare inside. Oma tuna is truly delicious! 'DELISH AOMORI' will be released on the Aomori Facebook page.

title: DELISH AOMORI「八戸前沖さばの洋風味噌煮」
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」の第９弾。今回の食材は八戸前沖さば。さばの最も定番とも言える味噌煮を洋風にアレンジ。脂の乗ったさばの美味しさが詰まった一皿に仕上げました。いつもとはちょっと違った晩ごはんのおかずにどうぞ。 「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Western-style Miso Braised Hachinohe Mackerel'
description: This is the 9th installment of the recipe video 'DELISH AOMORI' brought to you by Marugoto Aomori. The ingredient this time is Hachinohe mackerel. We have arranged the classic miso braised mackerel in a Western style. This dish is packed with the deliciousness of fatty mackerel. Enjoy it as a slightly different side dish for dinner. 'DELISH AOMORI' will be released on the Marugoto Aomori Facebook page.

title: DELISH AOMORI「三沢の長芋アヒージョ」
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」。第８弾の食材は三沢市で栽培されている長芋。今回のレシピは長芋を皮ごと使ったアヒージョです。皮ごと調理することで、手にはかゆみが起きず、栄養もしっかり摂れます。「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Misa's Nagaimo Ajillo'
description: A recipe video delivered by all of Aomori, 'DELISH AOMORI'. The 8th ingredient is nagaimo grown in Misawa City. This recipe is ajillo using nagaimo with the skin on. title: 【Niijima・Shikinejima】Minpaku Gohan Shikine Taihei-kun de Kanpai
description: Since the start of shipping in 1990, over 30 years have passed for the aquaculture business in Niijima Village. We planned to create a video to let the residents of Niijima know more about it. (Background) Selling outside the island is difficult due to costs for customers, and it’s hard to sell whole fish. It’s clear that we need to create a cycle where we can ‘grow’, ‘cook’, and ‘eat’ within the island. We often hear the disappointing voice that ‘island fish are hard to get’. One solution to that voice is the stable supply of farmed sea bream, ‘Shikine Taihei-kun’. After updating the breeding environment over 30 years, we have developed a unique blended feed that realizes the delicious taste of sea bream with just the right amount of fat. When you think of sea bream, you might imagine the stylish and bright red ‘medetai’, but Shikine Taihei-kun is a rustic-colored ‘irodori tai’. Why not add some color to the sea bream that is so close to you? ‘Let’s grow together!’

title: 210602 NHK 首都圏ネットワーク ちかさとコレクション
description: 300年以上続く島の伝統食「くさや」をミライへ 島の暮らしを支えてきたキレイな海をミライへ 〜アルミ型洗濯バサミ #HOSSY を通じて海洋ゴミ問題を考える〜 【新島ミライプロジェクト】 新島では年間100トン以上という大量の海洋ゴミが流れ着き、ごみ処理はもちろん、島の美しい景観を損ねる大問題となっています。一方、魚の水揚げ量は年々減少し、漁業や水産加工業は今、苦境に立たされています。このまま海の環境が悪化していけば、海と共に生きてきた島の暮らしが立ち行かなくなるかもしれません。 そこで新島水産加工業協同組合は、海の恵みから生まれた伝統食「くさや」を受け継ぐ者として、海と共に生きる暮らしを未来へつないでいく活動を始めます。その第一弾として、アルミ製洗濯バサミ「HOSSY（ホッシー）」を新島のすべてのお宅へ配布（１家庭につき２０個）し、海を汚すプラゴミを少しでも減らしていくことを目指します。

title: 210602 NHK Shuto-ken Network Chikasato Collection
description: A traditional island food 'Kusaya' that has continued for over 300 years towards the future. A beautiful sea that has supported island life towards the future. - Considering the marine debris problem through aluminum clothespins #HOSSY - 【Niijima Mirai Project】 Niijima faces a significant problem with over 100 tons of marine debris washing ashore each year, affecting waste disposal and damaging the island's beautiful scenery. Meanwhile, the catch of fish has been decreasing year by year, putting the fishing and seafood processing industries in a difficult position. If the marine environment continues to deteriorate, the island's way of life, which has lived in harmony with the sea, may not be sustainable. Therefore, the Niijima Fisheries Processing Cooperative will begin activities to connect the way of life living with the sea to the future as inheritors of the traditional food 'Kusaya' born from the blessings of the sea. As the first step, they aim to distribute aluminum clothespins 'HOSSY' to all households in Niijima (20 per household) to reduce plastic waste that pollutes the sea.

description: 2021年春、東京の島　新島から島内全家庭のプラスティック洗濯バサミを、くさや型のアルミ製洗濯バサミ　”HOSSY" との交換を目指すプロジェクトです。紫外線で劣化し、すぐに壊れるプラスティック洗濯バサミを島のシンボルである”くさや型洗濯バサミ”に換えることにより、島の大切な産業である、くさやをより身近に感じてもらい、何より、もう壊れて捨てることのない洗濯バサミに交換することで、プラスティックのゴミを出さない生活へと変えていきたいと考えています。海から恵みをいただき発展してきた島だから、「今こそ自然環境に対し、何ができるか？」を島の人たち一人一人が考える機会の創出です。今後は、東京宝島の力もお借りし、同時に企業様の力もお借りしたいと願っております。もちろん私たちでもクラウドファンディングを行い、少しでも多くの方にコミットいただきたいと考えています。そして新島での取り組みを、東京諸島の全11島へ広げ、その先にこのアクションを日本の島々へ広めて行きたいと考えております。狙いは2つ。①日本の食文化への理解 “干物（くさや）”から、郷土への誇りを高めるとともに、②難しく考えがちな “環境問題”をユニークな取組みで、気づきの連鎖につなげたい。それは【新しい、でつながる島】だから。海と生きるまち。海の環境問題に正面から取り組む「エコアイランド構想」への環境アクションです。

title: 【新島ミライプロジェクト】210402 CX Live News it!
description: In spring 2021, this project aims to exchange plastic clothespins from all households on Niijima Island, Tokyo, for aluminum clothespins shaped like kusaya, called 'HOSSY'. By replacing plastic clothespins that deteriorate and break easily due to UV rays with the island's symbol, the kusaya-shaped clothespin, we hope to make the important industry of kusaya more familiar and, most importantly, to change to clothespins that will not break and be thrown away, leading to a lifestyle that does not produce plastic waste. Since the island has developed by receiving blessings from the sea, we want to create opportunities for each islander to think about 'What can we do for the natural environment now?'. In the future, we hope to borrow the power of Tokyo's treasure islands and also the strength of companies. Of course, we also plan to conduct crowdfunding ourselves to get as many people as possible to commit. We aim to expand our efforts in Niijima to all 11 islands of the Tokyo Islands and then spread this action to the islands of Japan. There are two aims: 1) To enhance understanding of Japanese food culture through 'dried fish (kusaya)' and pride in our hometown, and 2) To connect the often complex 'environmental issues' to a chain of awareness through unique initiatives. This is because it is a 'new island connected by new things'. A town that lives with the sea. It is an environmental action towards the 'Eco-Island Concept' that directly addresses marine environmental issues.

description: 〜 A place to work, a place to play. 新しい「なつかしい」をつくる島 〜 働き方、休み方を変える。例えば、週末を、あるいは一週間を、仕事とバケーションを両立させる「ワーケーション」。そんな生活のシフトチェンジに絶好の島があります。東京からジェット船で、３時間。古き良き時代の懐かしも品格のあるたたずまい。そこに息づく穏やかな暮らしに、新しい時代のワークスタイルが融合する島、式根島。すぐそばには、紺碧の海と青い空、２４時間フリーな温泉、緑豊かな大自然が待っています。仕事に、生活に、本当に必要な情報は何か。人生の大事な時間や価値を洗い直すには、いま島が必要です。そんな思いを共にする人たちと島が一緒になって、どんな新しい暮らし方や働き方がつくれるか。さぁ、住んでよし、働いてよしの式根島へ。東京と島のデュアルライフ、移住・定住、大歓迎。式根島式、未来づくりに、あなたもご参加を。

title: 【Shikinejima Island】 A Trip to Shikinejima Island
description: A place to work, a place to play. Creating a new 'nostalgic' island. Changing the way we work and take breaks. For example, balancing work and vacation with 'workation' on weekends or even for a week. There is an ideal island for such a shift in lifestyle. Just three hours by jet boat from Tokyo, it has a nostalgic charm of the good old days with a dignified presence. The island of Shikinejima, where a peaceful way of life coexists with a new era of work style. Right nearby, the deep blue sea and sky, 24-hour free hot springs, and lush nature await. What is truly necessary information for work and life? To reassess the important time and value of life, we need the island now. Together with people who share this sentiment, what new ways of living and working can we create? Come to Shikinejima, where living and working are both great. A dual life between Tokyo and the island, migration and settlement are very welcome. Join us in creating the future in the Shikinejima way.

title: STUNNING NAGOYA  A Unique and Exclusive Experience at Nagoya Castle
description: Nagoya has been the land of Samurais, giving it a rich history and unique cultural identity. Discover Nagoya's world-class meeting facilities, history, ancient traditions, and first-class dining, and be inspired by the cultural atmosphere of the city, in the heart of Japan.

title: 驚くべき名古屋 名古屋城でのユニークで特別な体験
description: 名古屋は侍の土地であり、豊かな歴史と独自の文化的アイデンティティを持っています。名古屋の世界クラスの会議施設、歴史、古代の伝統、そして一流のダイニングを発見し、日本の中心にあるこの街の文化的な雰囲気に触発されてください。

title: Spring in Nagoya
description: コロナ禍により観光渡航が途絶する中、早春の名古屋の美しさを感じていただきたく、春の精に誘われるイメージで動画を作成しました。乾杯のシーンでは、VYSA Tokai（在日ベトナム学生青年協会東海支部）のメンバーにご協力いただきました。

title: 名古屋の春
description: In the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic, when tourism has come to a halt, we created a video to convey the beauty of early spring in Nagoya, inspired by the spirit of spring. In the toast scene, we received cooperation from members of VYSA Tokai (Vietnamese Student Youth Association Tokai Branch).

title: 武將與喫茶文化
description: 名古屋と深い関係を持つ武将は古くから喫茶を好み、その影響を受けて江戸時代には平民も喫茶を楽しむようになりました。この精神文化は今でも受け継がれています。

title: Warlords and Tea Culture
description: Warlords with a deep connection to Nagoya have historically had a fondness for tea, and influenced by this, during the Edo period, common people also began to enjoy tea. This cultural spirit has been passed down to the present day.

title: 名古屋喫茶文化
description: 名古屋の喫茶店の朝食は、1杯の飲み物の価格で、他の特典も付いてきます。さらに、各店舗には独自の特色メニューがあり、さまざまな喫茶店を探索することができます。

title: Nagoya Coffee Culture
description: In Nagoya's coffee shops, breakfast is available at the price of just one drink, along with additional perks. Moreover, each shop has its own unique menu, so go explore different coffee shops!

title: 武将と喫茶文化
description: 名古屋ゆかりの武将たちのお茶を楽しむ文化は、江戸時代には庶民にまで広がりました。抹茶とお茶菓子で一服する習慣が、現代の喫茶店で一息つくというスピリッツにつながってるのでは！？といわれます。

title: Warlords and Tea Culture
description: The culture of enjoying tea associated with warlords from Nagoya spread to the common people during the Edo period. The custom of taking a break with matcha and tea sweets is said to connect to the spirit of taking a breather in modern tea shops.

title: 名古屋喫茶文化
description: 有名な「モーニング」は、ドリンク1杯の値段でおまけがついてくる。その他にも、お店ごとに特色のある喫茶メニューが豊富なので、喫茶店巡りを楽しんでみては？

title: Nagoya Coffee Culture
description: Famous for its 'morning' where you get a bonus with the price of a drink. Additionally, there are plenty of unique coffee shop menus at each store, so why not enjoy a coffee shop tour?

title: EEGANE! Come and Find, Your NAGOYA!  ~Shrines
description: NAGOYA convention & visitors bureau has produced a video promoting Nagoya to Filipinos living in Japan. The title is 'EEGANE! Come and Find, Your NAGOYA!' Megumi Marie Okada, a TV Aichi announcer born in Manila, Philippines, will be appointed to navigate the charm of Nagoya with two Filipinos living in Japan, Stephanie and Alisa. It was a video that conveys the charm of Nagoya with the theme of 'experience'. Please check it out!

title: 名古屋神社巡禮
description: 名古屋の神社を巡る旅は、その色とりどりの魅力に驚かされます。繁華な商業地区から静かで優雅な住宅街の隅々、のんびりとした農村から、到達するのに少し努力が必要な聖地まで、さまざまな場所がまるで日本全国を旅しているかのようです！変化に富んだ名古屋神社の旅は魅力に満ちており、出発したら止まらなくなること間違いなしです。

title: Nagoya Shrine Tour
description: Traveling around the shrines of Nagoya will amaze you with their vibrant and colorful nature. From bustling commercial areas to quiet and elegant corners of residential neighborhoods; from leisurely rural areas to sacred places that seem to require some effort to reach, various locations feel like a journey across Japan! The diverse Nagoya shrine tour is full of charm and will definitely keep you going once you set off!

title: Travel Around to Nagoya's Shrines
description: Japanese families have traditionally had a kamidana, or household Shinto altar, in their homes. Changes in lifestyles, such as the trend toward living in apartments, have led to the disappearance of these altars from many homes. However, when you venture outside, you will find many such shrines. We hope that you, coming from various parts of the world, will encounter deities in Nagoya, who always watch over us, in the belief that such an opportunity will bring you joy.

title: 名古屋の神社を巡る旅
description: 日本の家族は伝統的に家に神棚、または家庭用の神道の祭壇を持っていました。アパートに住む傾向など、ライフスタイルの変化により、これらの祭壇は多くの家庭から消えつつあります。しかし、外に出ると、そんな神社がたくさんあります。世界のさまざまな場所から来たあなたが、私たちを常に見守っている名古屋の神々に出会うことを願っています。このような機会があなたに喜びをもたらすと信じています。

title: 名古屋神社めぐり旅
description: Did you know that Aichi Prefecture has the most shrines and temples in Japan? In this area with many shrines and temples, there are over 700 'shrines' located in Nagoya city. Shrines are closely related to the history of the land, and you can enjoy various stories. How about exploring the 'shrines' in the city of Nagoya, in addition to tourist attractions and facilities?

title: Nagoya Shrine Tour
description: 愛知県は神社仏閣の数が日本一だということはご存じでしょうか？そんな神社仏閣の多いエリアにおいて、名古屋市内には700以上の「神社」が鎮座しています。神社はその土地の歴史に縁が強く、いろいろな物語を楽しむことができます。観光名所や施設以外に、名古屋の街中にある「神社」を巡ってみてはいかがでしょう。

description: 2021年1月17日に開催した「あなたの知らない名古屋オンラインツアー　名古屋城編」のアーカイブです。名古屋おもてなし武将隊の“徳川家康”、“前田慶次”、“加藤清正”、“踊舞”、“なつ”が、名古屋城の魅力を分かりやすくツアーガイドしています。ツアーでは、初心者向けの情報から玄人向けの情報に加え、今回のオンラインツアーのために特別に撮影した「藩主・将軍　着座目線」の映像をお楽しみいただくことができます。通常の一般観覧では立ち入ることができない「表書院上段之間」・「対面所上段之間」から、400年前の藩主や将軍しか見ることのできなかった景色をご堪能ください。

title: 【Archive】The Unknown Nagoya Online Tour: Nagoya Castle Edition
description: This is the archive of the 'Unknown Nagoya Online Tour: Nagoya Castle Edition' held on January 17, 2021. The Nagoya Hospitality Samurai Team, including 'Tokugawa Ieyasu', 'Maeda Keiji', 'Kato Kiyomasa', 'Odori Mai', and 'Natsu', guides you through the attractions of Nagoya Castle in an easy-to-understand manner. The tour offers information for beginners as well as advanced insights, and you can enjoy special footage shot specifically for this online tour, featuring the 'Lord and Shogun's Eye-Level View'. Experience the scenery that only the lords and shoguns of 400 years ago could see from the 'Upper Room of the Omote Shoin' and 'Upper Room of the Taimeisho', which are normally inaccessible to the public.

title: 南海電鉄 鋼索線：新型高野山ケーブルカー運行開始！！
description:
2019年3月1日、4代目となる新型高野山ケーブルカーが運行を開始します。新型高野山ケーブルカーのコンセプトは「期待感」 「癒し・調和」 「安全・安心」。

「期待感」
客車部分はスイスのキャビンメーカーが手掛け、欧州風の流線型が特徴的なアルミ製の車体に、高野山・壇上伽藍の根本大塔を想起させる朱色をコンセプトカラーとして採用し、和洋折衷のデザインで高野山への「期待感」を醸成。

「癒し・調和」
内装は、全体に木目調の装飾を施し、調光式LEDを用いた間接照明を採用するなど「癒し・調和」を演出。

「安全・安心」
床面に滑りにくい材質を採用するとともに、車内段差部に足元灯を設置し、つまずきなどの事故防止対策を実施することで「安全・安心」を提供。

title: Nankai Electric Railway Cable Car: New Koyasan Cable Car Starts Operation!!
description:
On March 1, 2019, the fourth generation of the new Koyasan cable car will start operation. The concept of the new Koyasan cable car is 'Expectations', 'Healing and Harmony', and 'Safety and Security'.

'Expectations'
The passenger car is designed by a Swiss cabin manufacturer, featuring a European-style streamlined aluminum body, with a concept color of vermilion reminiscent of the main pagoda of Danjo Garan in Koyasan, creating an 'expectation' for Koyasan with a blend of Japanese and Western design.

'Healing and Harmony'
The interior is decorated with wood grain throughout, and indirect lighting using dimmable LEDs is adopted to create 'healing and harmony'.

'Safety and Security'
Non-slip materials are used for the floor, and footlights are installed at the steps inside the car to implement accident prevention measures such as tripping, providing 'safety and security'.

title: 南海電鉄 鋼索線：高野山ケーブルカー
description: Koyasan Cable Carは、Koyasanの聖地である高野山駅と極楽橋駅を結ぶ路線です。ケーブルカーは、法律上「鋼索鉄道」として分類され、当社では『鋼索線』と呼ばれています。1930年に開通し、高野山への参拝客や住民の交通手段として重要な役割を果たしてきました。全長0.8Km、高低差328mで、東京タワーとほぼ同じ高さを約5分で昇ります。

title: Nankai Electric Railway Cable Car: Koyasan Cable Car
description: The Koyasan Cable Car connects the terminus of the Koyasan Line, Gokurakubashi Station, with Koyasan Station, the gateway to the sacred site of Shingon Buddhism, Koyasan. The cable car is classified as a 'cable railway' under the law, and we refer to it as 'Kousakusen'. Opened in 1930, it boasts a long history and has served as a means of transportation for both visitors to Koyasan and residents. It covers a distance of 0.8 km and a height difference of 328 m, ascending to a height similar to that of Tokyo Tower in about 5 minutes.

傾城阿波の鳴門 巡礼歌の段

徳島は玉木家の家宝、名刀「国次」を探すため、十郎兵衛、お弓の夫婦は三歳の娘お鶴を国許に残し、諸国を巡るが、じきに金銭も尽き、悪事を重ね尋者となってしまいます。九歳になったお鶴は、両親に会いたい一心から、巡礼姿で諸国遍路の旅に出ていました。ある日、大阪に身を隠すお弓の元に、偶然、巡礼姿のお鶴が訪れます。お弓は話を聞くうちに、間違いなく我が娘、お鶴であることに気がつきます。今すぐに抱きしめ、母と名乗りたい思いを抑え、娘に罪が及ぶことを恐れて、国へ帰るよう諭すお弓ですが、お鶴は「どうやら母さんのように思われて」と泣き、ここにおいてほしいと頼むのでした。同演目を岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会が獅子芝居で、島文楽保存会が文楽で上演しました。

A performance featuring Fushiya's lion theater, which is an important intangible folk cultural asset of Gifu Prefecture, along with lion theater, local kabuki, and bunraku from within the prefecture, was held over two days.

Shima Bunraku Preservation Society (Ichinomiya City, Aichi Prefecture)

The section of the pilgrimage song from the play 'Keisei Awa no Naruto'

In Tokushima, in search of the family heirloom, the famous sword 'Kunisuke', the couple Jurobe and Oyu leave their three-year-old daughter Otsuru at home and travel around the country. Soon, their money runs out, and they resort to wrongdoing, becoming fugitives. At the age of nine, Otsuru, longing to see her parents, sets out on a pilgrimage journey. One day, Oyu, hiding in Osaka, unexpectedly encounters Otsuru in her pilgrimage attire. As Oyu listens to her story, she realizes that this is undoubtedly her daughter Otsuru. Suppressing her desire to embrace her immediately and introduce herself as her mother, Oyu advises Otsuru to return home, fearing that her daughter might be implicated in her troubles. However, Otsuru, crying, says, 'I feel like I might be my mother,' and pleads to stay here. The same play was performed by the Ginan Town Fushiya Shishimai Preservation Society as a lion theater and by the Shima Bunraku Preservation Society as bunraku.

This year, the Seki City Shishimai Preservation Society and the Mino Kabuki Preservation Society will perform.

Kabuki 'Sannin Kichisa'

[Summary] Famous for the lines 'The moon is hazy over the white fish...' and 'This is a good omen for the spring,' this is a work by the playwright Kawatake Mokuami. On the night of Setsubun, Ojo Kichisa steals 100 ryo from a woman of the night by the Sumida River, but Obo Kichisa notices it, and the two fight over the money. A passing monk Kichisa mediates the dispute, and the three men with the same name reveal their true identities and become sworn brothers. The monk offers the 100 ryo to his father, Denkichi, but the bad money is thrown away. The 100 ryo ends up in the hands of the Obo, and Denkichi is killed by the Obo. Ojo and Obo meet the monk again, where the Obo learns for the first time that he killed the monk's father, and Ojo discovers that the woman of the night is the monk's sister. The two regret their sins and contemplate death...

title: 令和5年度岐南地芝居公演(関市獅子舞保存会)
description:
September 10, 2023 (Sunday) Ginan Local Theater Performance @ Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Hall

Continuing from last year, we held the 'Ginan Local Theater Performance' where you can see 'Fushiya's Lion Theater' along with other lion theaters and local kabuki from within the prefecture. This year, the Seki City Lion Dance Preservation Society and the Mino Kabuki Preservation Society performed.

Lion Theater 'Koyasan'

[Summary] Shido Maru, longing to meet his father, Hoshiji (Karakaya Doshin), leaves his sick mother behind and walks alone to Koyasan. While walking on the mountain path, he encounters his father, Karakaya Doshin, and innocently asks, 'Where is Doshin now?' Doshin replies, 'Those who have just become monks are all called Doshin now,' and advises him to return. When Shido Maru tells him about his mother's illness, tears well up in Doshin's eyes. Seeing this, Shido Maru wonders if he might be his father, but Doshin says, 'Hoshiji Nyudo is currently on a pilgrimage across the country, and I do not know his whereabouts,' and urges him to hurry down the mountain to care for his mother.

title: Ginan Local Theater Performance (Seki City Lion Dance Preservation Society)
令和5年度岐南地芝居公演(岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会)
description:
令和5年9月10日（日）岐南地芝居公演＠岐南町伏屋獅子舞会館

岐阜県にて令和6年度開催される、第39回国民文化祭 第24回全国障害者芸術・文化祭 「『清流のぎふ』文化祭2024」のプレイベントのひとつとして、今年も「岐南地芝居公演」を開催しました。「伏屋の獅子芝居」と県内の他の獅子芝居や地歌舞伎が同時にみられる公演で、今年は岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会、関市獅子舞保存会と美濃歌舞伎保存会が出演しました。

　　道行
　　寄
　　悪魔払い
　　獅子芝居『傾城阿波の鳴門　巡礼歌の段』
　　
【あらすじ】
　徳島は玉木家の家宝、名刀「国次」を探すため、十郎兵衛、お弓(獅子)の夫婦は三歳の娘お鶴を国許に残し、諸国を巡るが、じきに金銭も尽き、悪事を重ね尋者となってしまう。
　九歳になったお鶴は、両親に会いたい一心から、巡礼姿で諸国遍路の旅に出ていた。ある日、大阪に身を隠すお弓の元に、偶然、順礼姿のお鶴が訪れる。お弓は話を聞くうちに、間違いなく我が娘、お鶴であることに気がつく。今すぐに抱きしめ、母と名乗りたい思いを抑え、娘に罪が及ぶことを恐れて、国へ帰るよう諭すお弓だが、お鶴は「どうやら母さんのように思われて」と泣き、ここにおいてほしいと頼むのであった。

title: 令和5年度岐南地芝居公演(岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会)
description:
On September 10, 2023 (Sunday), the Ginan Local Theater Performance will be held at the Ginan Town Fushiya Shishimai Hall.

As one of the pre-events for the 39th National Cultural Festival and the 24th National Arts and Culture Festival for Persons with Disabilities, which will be held in Gifu Prefecture in 2024, the 'Ginan Local Theater Performance' was held again this year. This performance allows audiences to see 'Fushiya's Lion Dance' along with other lion dances and local kabuki from within the prefecture. This year, the Ginan Town Fushiya Shishimai Preservation Society, the Seki City Shishimai Preservation Society, and the Mino Kabuki Preservation Society performed.

　　Road Journey
　　Offering
　　Demon Exorcism
　　Lion Dance 'Keisei Awa no Naruto - Pilgrimage Song Segment'
　　
[Summary]
To search for the family treasure of the Tamaki family in Tokushima, the couple Jurobei and Oyu (the lion) leave their three-year-old daughter Otsuru at home and travel through various countries, but soon run out of money and become criminals. At the age of nine, Otsuru, longing to see her parents, sets out on a pilgrimage journey. One day, Oyu, who is hiding in Osaka, unexpectedly meets Otsuru, who is in pilgrimage attire. As Oyu listens to her story, she realizes that Otsuru is undoubtedly her daughter. Suppressing the urge to embrace her and introduce herself as her mother, Oyu advises Otsuru to return home, fearing that her daughter might be implicated in her crimes, but Otsuru, crying, pleads to stay with her, saying, 'I feel like I might be my mother.'

title: 令和6年岐南町二十歳の集い
description: 令和6年1月7日(日) 令和6年岐南町二十歳の集い＠岐南町中央公民館 広報紙『マイタウンぎなん』の特集と合わせてご覧ください。

title: 令和6年岐南町二十歳の集い

title: めっちゃぎなんわかるてれび⑤きらびとがめっちゃわかる
description: ぎふチャン（岐阜放送）「めっちゃぎふわかるてれび」令和５年８月４日（金）放送第５回は”きらびとがめっちゃわかる”岐南町を拠点に活動するきらびと、『きらりと光る人』を紹介します。“100歳まで歩ける身体作り”をスローガンに健康講座を開く高見優貴さんと、子どもたちに読み聞かせを行う「岐南おはなしの会」の代表の伊藤美喜子さんにフォーカスしました。高見さんが開く健康講座は、ただ単に健康で長生きするだけでなく、高見さんならではの“美”を意識することで若々しさを保つことができるとのこと。そんな講座をリポーターが体験取材しました！伊藤さんが代表を務める「岐南おはなしの会」は、約40年間活動を続けており、そのメンバーの皆様に活動内容と子どもたちを惹きつける極意や活動の意義について聞いてみました！

title: Meccha Gifu Wakaru TV ⑤ Kirabito ga Meccha Wakaru
description: Gifu Channel (Gifu Broadcasting) "Meccha Gifu Wakaru TV" aired on August 4, 2023. The 5th episode focuses on "Kirabito ga Meccha Wakaru". It introduces Kirabito, who are active in Ginan Town, as "people who shine brightly." We focused on Yuki Takami, who holds health seminars with the slogan of building a body that can walk until 100 years old, and Mikiko Ito, the representative of the "Ginan Storytelling Association," which conducts reading sessions for children. Takami's health seminars not only aim for longevity but also emphasize beauty, allowing participants to maintain youthfulness. A reporter experienced this seminar! The "Ginan Storytelling Association," led by Ito, has been active for about 40 years, and we asked its members about their activities and the significance of attracting children.

title: 最高の一杯を　＃岐南ラーメンＩＣ
description: 【Ginan Ramen IC】ぎなん らーめん いんたーちぇんじ(名) 国道21号と22号、156号が交差する県下最大規模の交通量を誇る岐南インター周辺に、新店舗から老舗まで個性あふれるラーメン店が集結していること。岐南町は現在も人口増加が続く、若い世代に支持される”熱い”まちであることをこのラーメン激戦区が物語っている。

title: The Best Bowl #GinanRamenIC
description: Ginan Ramen IC is located around the Ginan Interchange, which boasts the largest traffic volume in the prefecture, where National Routes 21, 22, and 156 intersect. A variety of ramen shops, from new establishments to long-established ones, have gathered in this area. Ginan Town continues to experience population growth and is a 'hot' town supported by the younger generation, as evidenced by this ramen battleground.

description:
令和5年1月8日（日）令和5年岐南町二十歳の集い＠岐南町中央公民館

title: 第７１回岐阜県消防操法大会　岐南町消防団５位入賞！
description:
August 7, 2022 (Sunday) "Firefighting Appreciation Festival" 71st Gifu Prefectural Firefighting Skills Competition @ Yamagata City Ijira General Ground

Ginan Town Fire Brigade achieved 5th place among 20 fire brigades in the prefecture. This is the first award in small pump operations in 24 years!

The skills competition is held to improve the firefighting skills and morale of the fire brigade. The participating members underwent rigorous training for about four months for this competition, and even those who did not participate supported the competitors by training together.

The beautiful discipline and speed of extinguishing fires were truly impressive. My heart warmed as I saw the competitors embrace each other after completing all the operations.

Please take a look at the heroic appearance of the Ginan Town Fire Brigade until the end.

title: 岐南地芝居公演（岐阜歌舞伎保存会）
description:
令和４年９月１８日（日）岐南地芝居公演＠岐南町伏屋獅子舞会館

岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会、関市獅子舞保存会、岐阜歌舞伎保存会の３団体が地芝居を競演。３年振りの会館での公演に、町内外から多くの観客が訪れ、場内は満席となりました。

0:58　口上

5:10　地歌舞伎『若緑勢曾我　外郎売』江戸時代に活躍した二代目市川園十郎によって演じられた歌舞伎十八番の一つ。工藤左衛門裕経らが富士の裾野で酒宴を始めようとすると、どこからともなく早口の外郎売が登場。長台詞の言い立てにその場にいた人々は感嘆する。この薬売りは父の仇である裕経を仇討ちしたいという思いを秘め、この酒宴に近づいた曾我五郎であった。

title: Ginan Local Kabuki Performance (Gifu Kabuki Preservation Society)
description:
On September 18, 2022 (Sunday), Ginan Local Kabuki Performance at Ginan Town Fushiya Shishimai Hall.

Three groups, the Ginan Town Fushiya Shishimai Preservation Society, the Seki City Shishimai Preservation Society, and the Gifu Kabuki Preservation Society, competed in local kabuki performances. Many spectators from inside and outside the town visited the performance, filling the venue for the first time in three years.

0:58 Introduction

5:10 Local Kabuki 'Wakamidori Sōga Uirō Uri' performed by the second generation Ichikawa Enjūrō, one of the Kabuki's eighteen masterpieces active in the Edo period. As Kudo Saemon Hirotsune and others try to start a drinking party at the foot of Mt. Fuji, a fast-talking Uirō Uri suddenly appears. The people present are amazed by the long lines. This medicine seller, who secretly harbors the desire to take revenge on Hirotsune, who is his father's enemy, approaches the drinking party as Sōga Gorō.

title: 岐南地芝居公演（関市獅子舞保存会）
description:
令和４年９月１８日（日）岐南地芝居公演＠岐南町伏屋獅子舞会館

岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会、関市獅子舞保存会、岐阜歌舞伎保存会の３団体が地芝居を競演。３年振りの会館での公演に、町内外から多くの観客が訪れ、場内は満席となりました。

12:34　獅子芝居『朝顔日記』
日向の国藩主の娘・深雪（獅子）と宮城阿曽次郎はお家騒動で離ればなれになってしまう。縁談の話が持ち上がるが、相手が阿曽次郎と知らない深雪は縁談を嫌い放浪の旅に出る。その後、島田の宿で２人は再会するものの、盲目となった深雪は気づくことができない。

title: Ginan Local Theater Performance (Seki City Lion Dance Preservation Society)

12:34 Lion Theater 'Asagao Diary'
The daughter of the lord of Hinata Province, Miyuki (Lion), and Miyagi Asojiro are separated due to a family feud. A marriage proposal arises, but Miyuki, unaware that the suitor is Asojiro, dislikes the proposal and embarks on a journey. Later, the two reunite at a lodging in Shimada, but blind Miyuki cannot recognize him.

0:07　道行
1:52　あいさつ
4:53　寄
6:01　悪魔払い

18:16　獅子芝居『傾城阿波の鳴門　巡礼歌の段』
お弓（獅子）は夫の悪事により尋者となってしまい、娘・お鶴を国許に残し隠れて暮らしている。ある日、お弓の元に巡礼姿のお鶴が訪れ、母と娘は再会する。しかしお弓はお鶴に罪が及ぶことを恐れ、母だと名乗ることができない。そしてお鶴に国に帰ることを諭さざるを得ないのであった。

title: Ginan Local Theater Performance (Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Preservation Society)
description:
On September 18, 2022 (Sunday), Ginan Local Theater Performance at Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Hall.

Three groups, the Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Preservation Society, the Seki City Lion Dance Preservation Society, and the Gifu Kabuki Preservation Society, competed in local theater performances. 0:07 - Road Scene
1:52 - Greeting
4:53 - Offering
6:01 - Exorcism

18:16 - Lion Dance Play 'Keisei Awa no Naruto - Pilgrimage Song Scene'
The lion, O-Yumi, has become a seeker due to her husband's misdeeds, leaving her daughter, O-Tsuru, in their homeland and living in hiding. One day, O-Tsuru, in pilgrim attire, visits O-Yumi, and mother and daughter reunite. However, O-Yumi cannot reveal herself as the mother for fear of bringing sin upon O-Tsuru. Thus, she is forced to advise O-Tsuru to return to their homeland.

title: 「岐南町 伏屋の獅子舞」予告篇
description: この映像作品は、「岐南町 伏屋の獅子舞」の予告篇として製作しました。江戸時代より受け継がれてきた「岐南町 伏屋の獅子舞」を、現代の視点でとらえ直し、わが町のクールジャパンを世界に向けて発信する、まちのプロモーション動画です。

title: Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Trailer
description: This video work was produced as a trailer for the 'Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance'. It reinterprets the 'Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance', which has been passed down since the Edo period, from a modern perspective, and is a town promotion video that conveys our town's Cool Japan to the world.

title: OKINAWA travel film
description: この動画は、2024年2月に沖縄でのスタディツアー中に撮影した映像を使用して制作されました。映像には沖縄の魅力的な風景や伝統文化、スタディツアー中のさまざまな体験が収められています。この動画を通じて、沖縄の豊かな魅力を少しでもお伝えできれば幸いです。

title: 沖縄旅行映画
description: This video was created using footage captured during a study tour in Okinawa in February 2024. The footage showcases Okinawa's captivating landscapes, traditional culture, and various experiences from the study tour. Through this video, we hope to share a glimpse of Okinawa's rich charm with you.

title: 【金沢・能登】観光プロモーション動画　- Farm to Table -
description: Ishikawa Prefecture Kanazawa City, Noto Peninsula's tourism promotion video has been produced. The theme of the journey is 'Farm to Table'. How are the rich ingredients produced by the blessings of the magnificent nature of the Kanazawa and Noto area delivered to consumers? Visiting production sites, traditional craft workshops, and restaurants, this journey aims to understand the sustainable food culture of this region and learn about the thoughts of the people living here. Please visit and feel the charm of Kanazawa and Noto.

title: 【Kanazawa・Noto】Tourism Promotion Video - Farm to Table -

How are the rich ingredients produced by the blessings of the magnificent nature of the Kanazawa and Noto area delivered to consumers? Please visit and feel the charm of Kanazawa and Noto.

title: Ayabe Minatsuki Festival 2023

title: 綾部みなつき祭り2023
description: 今年も綾部みなつき祭りが開催されました。多くの人々がその日訪れ、街中がどこも賑わっていました。この祭りを支えてくれた皆さんに感謝の気持ちを込めてこの動画を作りました。来年も楽しみにしています。

title: NOTO - KANAZAWA Sustainable Nature & Life  - Cinematic travel film
description: The Noto Peninsula and Kanazawa, areas of traditional and sustainable living, the place teaches the woven tapestry of nature & life and how we are all connected together. I would be happy if you could feel the sustainability and gentleness from this film.

title: NOTO - 金沢の持続可能な自然と生活 - シネマティック旅行映画
description: 能登半島と金沢、伝統的で持続可能な生活の地域で、自然と生活の織りなすタペストリーと私たちがどのように繋がっているかを教えてくれる場所です。この映画から持続可能性と優しさを感じていただければ幸いです。

title: TOKYO | Japan Cinematic travel film
description: - A glimpse of emotion in the bustling days - Tokyo, the capital of Japan, continues to develop at a rapid pace. The glimple image of emotion amidst the hustle and bustle of a metropolis where people are constantly passing by.

title: 東京 | 日本の映画的旅行フィルム
description: - 喧騒の中の感情のひとしずく - 東京、日本の首都は急速に発展し続けています。人々が絶えず行き交う大都市の喧騒の中での感情のひとしずくのイメージ。

title: TOKYO with Lumix GH6 / Japan Travel cinematic vlog
description: Finally Japan border will be opened from 10th June as government announced and we are so excited to welcome our guests from overseas again! This time we made a cinematic travel Vlog of Tokyo, I stayed 3 days in Tokyo with my gear LUMIX GH6 in end of May. I hope you enjoy our video and catch a latest atmosphere of Tokyo!

title: TOKYO with Lumix GH6 / 日本旅行シネマティックVlog
