title: けふの下呂温泉
description: I heard that the autumn leaves are at their best, so I headed to 'Gandate Park' in Hida-Kosaka. The 'Gandate' in the name refers to the cliffs made of lava, which are designated as a natural monument by the prefecture, and I was overwhelmed by their grandeur. The mountains are adorned with red and yellow autumn leaves, and I could enjoy the scenery while walking along the promenade. There is also a waterfall along the way, and seeing the sunlight streaming through the waterfall up close is incredibly powerful. I was able to enjoy forest bathing as well, fully savoring the autumn atmosphere. Since it is just the right time to see the leaves, if you want to enjoy the autumn foliage, please hurry. Please also take care of Gero Onsen!

description: 紅葉が見ごろということで、合掌村と初矢峠へ行ってみました。少し前まではまだまだかなと思っていた木々が、見事に赤くなっていました。自然の作用だけで、ここまできれいな赤色に染まったことを思うと、なんだか感動してしまいます。比較的寒さも厳しくなかったので、しばし散策をして紅葉を堪能しました。数日は晴天が続くようなので、もっともっと紅葉を撮影していきたいと思います。合掌村には足湯があるので、紅葉と温泉を一度に楽しむことができます！とても風情がありますね！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: Since the autumn leaves are at their best, I went to Gassho Village and Hatsuyatoge. The trees, which I thought would take a while to change, have beautifully turned red. Thinking that such a beautiful red color was achieved solely by nature is quite moving. The cold wasn't too harsh, so I enjoyed a stroll and took in the autumn leaves. It seems that sunny weather will continue for a few days, so I want to take more photos of the autumn leaves. Gassho Village has a foot bath, so you can enjoy both the autumn leaves and the hot springs at once! It's very picturesque! Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
10月30日（土） に開催された、『ありがとう！　下呂駅開業91周年花火』がテーマの、「天壌無窮　悪疫退散　下呂温泉花火物語」の様子です。

列車をイメージしたオレンジカラーと卒寿である紫色の花火が何発も打ち上がり、これまでとは一風変わった趣の催しとなりました。

ぜひ、次の100周年、200周年花火も見てみたいですね。

ちなみに、長生きの秘訣の一つに、適度に温泉につかると良いという説があるそうです。花火の後は、温泉で長寿と健康を目指しましょう！

下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 日々涼しさが増し、長袖でないと肌寒くなってきている下呂温泉です。紅葉スポットの雨情公園（阿多野谷）を歩いてみましたが、まだ紅葉には早かったようです。ですが、所々で葉が赤くなっているところもあり、もう間もなく真っ赤な紅葉の中で散策を楽しむことができそうです。紅葉は冷え込みが急なほどきれいになるという説もあるそうなので、今年の紅葉は期待できそうですね。同じく、冷え込んでいる中にはいる温泉も大いに期待ができます！体を暖めてくれて健康にも良好！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen

However, there are places where the leaves are turning red, and it seems that soon we will be able to enjoy a stroll among the bright red autumn leaves. There is a theory that the more sudden the cold, the more beautiful the autumn leaves become, so this year's foliage looks promising. Likewise, the hot springs in the cold are also highly anticipated! They warm the body and are good for health! Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: On October 9th (Saturday), a lantern floating event was held near the Chaplin statue. The lantern floating is a ceremony to send back the spirits that come during the Obon festival. This time, paper lanterns were used, but there are also times when offerings are placed on boats made of straw or wood and floated down rivers or out to sea. The paper lanterns made by customers were decorated with illustrations, and there was a corner where people could draw illustrations on the lanterns on the spot, attracting many participants. I hope to see this scene again next year. Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 「天壌無窮　悪疫退散　下呂温泉花火物語」が開催されました！今回のテーマは『スポーツ花火』。スポーツの秋、平和の祭典をイメージした花火が打ち上がりました。参加者の方々の歓声も多く聞こえ、楽しんでいただけたと思います。来週の10月16日（土）にも開催されますので、どうかお楽しみに！次回のテーマは『豊作感謝花火』です！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: The 'Tenjo Mukyu, Evil Epidemic Extermination, Gero Onsen Fireworks Story' was held! This time's theme was 'Sports Fireworks'. Fireworks inspired by the autumn of sports and the festival of peace were launched. I believe the participants enjoyed it, as there were many cheers heard. It will be held again next week on October 16th (Saturday), so please look forward to it! The next theme will be 'Harvest Gratitude Fireworks'! Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 「天壌無窮　悪疫退散　下呂温泉花火物語」が再開されました！今回のテーマは『#Light It Blue花火』。医療従事者の皆様に感謝を込めて、青を基調とした花火が打ち上がりました。多くのお客様にもお越しいただき、感染拡大防止対策の徹底のもと、花火を楽しんでいただけました。10月9日（土）にも開催されますので、どうかお楽しみに！温泉につかりながら花火を眺めるのも乙です！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: The 'Tenjo Mukyu, Banish the Epidemic, Gero Onsen Fireworks Story' has resumed! This time's theme is '#Light It Blue Fireworks'. Fireworks based on blue were launched in gratitude to medical professionals. Many customers came to enjoy the fireworks while thoroughly implementing measures to prevent the spread of infection. It will also be held on Saturday, October 9, so please look forward to it! Enjoying the fireworks while soaking in the hot springs is also delightful! Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
Recently, I felt the coolness of autumn, but today, Gero Onsen feels like summer has returned with strong sunlight. I find myself wanting something cold.

I walked about 30 minutes from Jomon Park to the historical Mori Mihara Shidai. On the mountain path, the leaves are still green, and I can hear the voices of cicadas, reflecting the summer climate. The breathtaking view from Mihara Shidai of the town and mountains still looks like summer.

However, on the way to Mihara Shidai, I noticed chestnut husks falling, indicating that autumn is gradually approaching. I look forward to the season of autumn leaves.

After enjoying the stunning view, let’s indulge in the hot springs! Thank you for Gero Onsen!

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
けふの下呂温泉
description:
I stepped into the Hida River at dusk.

Although the sunlight is strong, I realize that the heat of summer is not as intense, and autumn is approaching. The wind is also cool, and when I put my hand into the river's flow, I felt the coldness more than the refreshing coolness I had experienced before. The sunset reflected on the river surface looked somehow calm.

I would like to go and take pictures when the beautiful autumn leaves can be seen. I hope to introduce Gero Onsen in autumn as well.

Now, soaking in the hot springs while feeling the arrival of autumn is exceptional!

Anytime throughout the four seasons, the exquisite hot springs await! Please take care of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: Today’s ‘Nyarang Gourmet’ features ‘Bankoan’ from Gassho Village with ‘Banko Nyan Mitsu’!

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: Using local specialties from Gero such as tomato juice, yomogi-made shiratama, and konnyaku, the signature sweet ‘Banko Anmitsu’ greets you with Nyarang and Gerogurukun. Enjoy it with whipped cream, red bean paste, matcha ice cream, and plenty of black syrup!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: Today, let's take a stroll around Gero Onsen in search of 'Nyarang Gourmet'!

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: Today, let's take a stroll around Gero Onsen in search of 'Nyarang Gourmet'!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 旅行情報雑誌『じゃらん』の公式キャラクター、“にゃらん”と下呂温泉がグルメでコラボ！今、下呂温泉には見逃せない『にゃらんグルメ』が目白押しです！水明館のロビーラウンジ『エビアン』さんで求めたグルメは、話題のマリトッツォ（ブリオッシュ生地に生クリームを挟んだイタリア発祥の伝統的なお菓子）へにゃらんが変身した『にゃらトッツォ』！もちもちの生地の中には、たっぷりの生クリームが！チョコでできた耳とうるうるの瞳、口元がたまらなくキュート！食べたい、でも可愛すぎて無理……と悶えてしまう逸品です！1日先着10食限定、1人２個までで予約可。お値段は単品で￥660、ドリンクセットで￥1100、テイクアウトで￥648です。『にゃらんグルメ』の販売期間は9月1日（水）から11月30日（火）までなので、お見逃しなく！『にゃらトッツォ』を味わったら、そのまま温泉を楽しんで、またほかの『にゃらんグルメ』を探しに行きましょう！旅行するなら下呂温泉！よろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: The official character of the travel information magazine 'Jalan', 'Nyarann', collaborates with Gero Onsen for gourmet! Right now, Gero Onsen is full of must-see 'Nyarann Gourmet'! The gourmet sought at the lobby lounge 'Evian' of Suimeikan is 'Nyarattozzo', which transforms the popular Maritozzo (a traditional Italian sweet made of brioche dough filled with whipped cream) into Nyarann! Inside the chewy dough is plenty of whipped cream! The chocolate ears, sparkling eyes, and adorable mouth are irresistible! You might want to eat it, but it's too cute to do so... it's a masterpiece that makes you swoon! Limited to 10 servings per day, with a maximum of 2 per person, reservations are accepted. The price is ¥660 for a single item, ¥1100 for a drink set, and ¥648 for takeout. The sales period for 'Nyarann Gourmet' is from September 1 (Wednesday) to November 30 (Tuesday), so don't miss it! After enjoying 'Nyarattozzo', enjoy the hot springs and go look for other 'Nyarann Gourmet'! If you're traveling, Gero Onsen is the place to be! Thank you!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
Gero Stationから車で約25分、駐車場に車を置いて、森林浴と軽いウォーキングを楽しみながら「初矢峠の石畳」を見に行きましょう。

石畳は、東美濃と飛騨を結ぶ、南北街道（鎌倉街道とも呼ばれている）の一部に、幅約２M、長さ約70Mが残っていて、その歴史を感じさせてくれます。この石畳がいつできたのかは定かではありませんが、冬になって峠道が凍結し、通行に支障をきたすのを少しでも和らげようとする目的で作られたのではと言われています。明治24（1891）年ごろまで使用され、別ルートの開拓とともにその役割を終えました。

歴史に思いをはせていると、同じく歴史ある下呂温泉に入りたくなってきますね！昔の人も、初矢峠の石畳を通って下呂まで至り、温泉でその疲れを癒したのでしょうか？

今も昔も変わらぬ温泉がここに！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
About 25 minutes by car from Gero Station, let's park the car and enjoy forest bathing and light walking while visiting the 'Ishidatami of Hatsuyatoge'.

The stone pavement remains as part of the north-south road (also called Kamakura Road) connecting Higashi-Mino and Hida, measuring about 2 meters wide and 70 meters long, allowing us to feel its history. It is not certain when this stone pavement was created, but it is said to have been made to alleviate the difficulties of passage when the mountain pass froze in winter. It was used until around Meiji 24 (1891) and ended its role with the development of alternative routes.

As I ponder the history, I feel like taking a dip in the historically rich Gero Onsen! Did people in the past also travel through the stone pavement of Hatsuyatoge to reach Gero and soothe their fatigue in the hot springs?

The hot springs remain unchanged from the past! Please take care of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 温泉街の一画に建つ、下呂温泉初のプリン専門店が「下呂プリン」さんです。お店の中は湯船をイメージしたような雰囲気で、昔懐かしい空気で満ちています。国産の卵と牛乳、天然のバニラビーンズを使用した、ひとつひとつが手作りのプリンはどれも絶品！中でも、昔ながらの少し固めのプリンを再現し、素材の味を引き立たせた「下呂プリン（レトロ）」。季節限定で、ジューシーなマンゴーをぜいたくに使った「下呂プリン（マンゴー）」。※季節によって使用する素材が変わります。地元産下呂牛乳を使用した、なめらかで下呂プリンのベースとなる味の「下呂プリン（まろやか）」。目指したのは風呂上りのコーヒー牛乳。コーヒーゼリーとプリンを混ぜればまさにコーヒー牛乳の味？「下呂プリン（珈琲ゼリー）」。宇治の最高級抹茶を使用し、丹波産の黒豆がほどよい苦みを引き立てる「下呂プリン（抹茶）」。懐かしのメロンソーダをプリンで再現し、サクランボがどこか懐かしい「下呂プリン（メロンソーダ）」。の6種セットが人気を博しています！プリンを味わった後は、すぐそばにある「鷺の足湯」で一休みし、そのまま温泉へ入りにいくのもよいですね！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: The first pudding specialty store in Gero Onsen, 'Gero Pudding', is located in a corner of the hot spring town. The inside of the shop is filled with an atmosphere reminiscent of a hot spring, evoking a sense of nostalgia. Each pudding, handmade using domestic eggs, milk, and natural vanilla beans, is exquisite! Among them, the 'Gero Pudding (Retro)' recreates the traditional slightly firm pudding, enhancing the flavors of the ingredients. There is also a seasonal limited edition 'Gero Pudding (Mango)' that luxuriously uses juicy mangoes. *The ingredients used change with the seasons. The 'Gero Pudding (Mellow)' uses locally produced Gero milk, providing a smooth base flavor for the pudding. Aiming for the taste of coffee milk after a bath, mixing coffee jelly and pudding creates the flavor of coffee milk? 'Gero Pudding (Coffee Jelly)'. Using the finest Uji matcha, the 'Gero Pudding (Matcha)' brings out a moderate bitterness with Tanba black beans. The 'Gero Pudding (Melon Soda)' recreates nostalgic melon soda in pudding form, with cherries adding a touch of nostalgia. A set of these six varieties is very popular! After enjoying the pudding, it's nice to take a break at the nearby 'Sagi no Ashiyu' and then head straight to the hot springs! Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
Gero Onsen is experiencing consecutive days of sunny weather. The sunlight and temperature feel like summer in full swing, and the cicadas are chirping energetically.

I visited the Gassho Village again and enjoyed 'Bankoan Mitsu' at Bankoan. It’s a unique anmitsu made with konnyaku and tomatoes, served with pickled plums and black syrup as a palate cleanser. You can enjoy it as is at first, and then try drizzling black syrup on it for a fun change in flavor. Combining red bean paste with konnyaku, cream with shiratama, and tomatoes with matcha ice cream is also an interesting experience.

After enjoying the anmitsu and exploring Gassho Village, please come to the hot springs! A refreshing sensation awaits that will blow away the summer heat!

There are plenty of hot springs that are perfect for any season! Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
けふの下呂温泉
description: 久々に晴れ間がのぞいた下呂温泉です。気温も一気に高くなっていて、まだまだ夏だと実感します。せっかくの晴天ということで、合掌村へと歩を進め、しばらく体験できなかった「森のすべり台」を堪能しました。全長約175Mというこのすべり台、スピード感とスリル満点で、吹き付ける風がとても心地よいです。何度でも体験したくなる楽しさで、ついつい2回、3回とすべりたくなりますね。（3歳以上1回100円、別途合掌村入場料（高校生以上800円、小中学生400円）必要）すべり台のあとは温泉にゆきましょう！合掌村内にも「合掌の足湯」があるので、こちらにもぜひ浸かってみてください！レジャーと温泉の街！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: It’s been a while since we’ve seen clear skies at Gero Onsen. The temperature has suddenly risen, and I can still feel that it’s summer. Taking advantage of the nice weather, I headed to the Gassho Village and enjoyed the 'Forest Slide' that I hadn’t experienced in a while. This slide, which is about 175 meters long, is full of speed and thrills, and the wind blowing against me is very pleasant. It’s so much fun that I want to experience it again and again, and I find myself wanting to slide 2 or 3 times. (100 yen per slide for ages 3 and up, plus the Gassho Village entrance fee (800 yen for high school students and above, 400 yen for elementary and middle school students) is required.) After the slide, let’s go to the hot springs! There is also a 'Gassho Foot Bath' in the Gassho Village, so please try soaking in it! A town of leisure and hot springs! Please take care of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
温泉街から徒歩約1０分、いでゆ朝市の会場に程近い、飛騨牛茶寮　神月（かんげつ）さんの素肌美人スイーツを賞味しましょう。

その名も、和（なごみ）パフェ「朏（みかづき）」。
地元のブランド米「銀の朏」を使用したババロアに、抗酸化作用のあるリコピンがふんだんに含まれたトマトジュレ、アイスクリームや餡子がトッピングされています。
ほど良い酸味と甘みが上品に混じり合い、ぜいたくな和スイーツとして舌を楽しませてくれます。
ついついもう一杯に手が伸びてしまいそうです！

もちろん、温泉もお忘れなく！
湯船につかりながら手足を動かすと、血行が良くなり効能がUPするそうです！
ぜひお試しください！

安らぎを求めるならここで決まり！
下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
Let's enjoy the beautiful skin sweets at Hida Beef Restaurant Kangei, located about a 10-minute walk from the hot spring town and close to the Ideyu morning market.

It's called the Nagomi Parfait 'Mikazuki'.
The parfait features Bavarian cream made from the local brand rice 'Silver Mikazuki', topped with tomato jelly rich in lycopene, ice cream, and sweet red bean paste.
The perfect balance of acidity and sweetness elegantly blends together, delighting the palate as a luxurious Japanese sweet.
You might find yourself reaching for another cup!

Of course, don't forget the hot springs!
Moving your arms and legs while soaking in the bath is said to improve blood circulation and enhance the effects!
Be sure to give it a try!

If you're looking for relaxation, this is the place to be!
Thank you for considering Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 8月21日（土）に開催された「いでゆ夜市サマーフェスティバルin下呂温泉」の様子です。今回が今年最後の開催となり、雨が降るなど危ぶまれましたが、何とか開始時間にはあがってくれました。お客さんも大勢いらしてくださり、大いに盛り上がりました。新しいひよこのマスコットキャラクター、「げろピー」も参加し、あまびえとのツーショットを披露してくれました。出演者の皆様も、オカリナ演奏の「エーデルワイス」、「シュガースパイス」と「Pokke dance circle（ポッケダンスサークル）」のダンス、「ヨッタリーズ」のバンド演奏と、熱のこもったパフォーマンスを披露してくださいました。いでゆ夜市へご参加くださった皆様へ、改めてお礼申し上げます。来年の開催も、楽しみにお待ちください。そして、お越しの際は温泉へ入ることもお忘れなく！イベントも温泉も天下一品！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: This is the report of the 'Ideyu Night Market Summer Festival in Gero Onsen' held on August 21 (Saturday). This was the last event of the year, and although there were concerns due to rain, it cleared up just in time for the start. Many guests attended, and the atmosphere was lively. The new chick mascot character, 'Gero-P', also participated and showcased a photo with Amabie. The performers presented passionate performances, including the ocarina performance by 'Edelweiss', dance by 'Sugar Spice' and 'Pokke Dance Circle', and band performance by 'Yottariz'. We would like to express our gratitude to everyone who participated in the Ideyu Night Market. We look forward to next year's event. And don't forget to enjoy the hot springs when you visit! Both the event and the hot springs are top-notch! Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 下呂駅から徒歩3分、レストラン「Rigolo×Rigolo（リゴロ×リゴロ）」さんで、素肌美人スイーツの「下呂茶ップリン」を賞味しましょう。クッキーやアイス、チョコレートでユニークな飾りつけをし、目で見ても楽しめるスイーツです。ヨーグルト＆甘酒ティラミス、下呂茶プリンの二層仕立てで、美肌効果のあるコウジ酸とカテキン、整腸作用のあるヨーグルトが美肌を期待させてくれます！ほどよい甘さと酸味、滑らかな舌触りがたまらない逸品です！せっかくですから、温泉街へ向かって、白鷺橋の上のチャップリン像のそばで食べてみたいですね！そのあとは、「下呂茶ップリン」で得た美肌効果を、温泉でさらに高めましょう！入浴時間は、額が汗ばむくらいがちょうどよいと言われているそうです！温泉もスイーツも天下一品！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: Let's enjoy the beautiful skin sweets 'Gero Chappurin' at the restaurant 'Rigolo×Rigolo', a 3-minute walk from Gero Station. The sweets are uniquely decorated with cookies, ice cream, and chocolate, making them enjoyable to look at as well. With a two-layer structure of yogurt & amazake tiramisu and Gero tea pudding, the Koji acid and catechin that have beauty effects, along with the gut health benefits of yogurt, promise beautiful skin! The perfect balance of sweetness and acidity, along with a smooth texture, makes this a must-try! Since we are here, it would be nice to eat it near the Chaplin statue on Shirakabashi while heading to the hot spring town! After that, let's enhance the beauty effects gained from 'Gero Chappurin' even further in the hot springs! It is said that the ideal bathing time is when your forehead starts to sweat! Both the hot springs and sweets are top-notch! Please enjoy Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 雨の中の下呂温泉でしたが、現在は小雨程度になって雲の間から陽光も見えてきました。温泉街などにも被害は出ず、暑さも和らいでいて、湿気が引けば過ごしやすくなりそうです。けふは下呂駅から徒歩15分の温泉寺へと向かいました。静寂に包まれていて、聞こえるのは雨音だけでじっくりと境内を回ることができました。温泉寺は、かつて温泉の湧出が止まってしまったとき、薬師如来の使いとされる白鷺が噴き出す源泉の場所を教えてくれたことから、その薬師如来をまつったのが始まりと言われています。もしかしたらと白鷺を探してみましたが、雨宿りをしているのか姿を見せてはくれませんでした。今度また探しに来ようと思います。そんな伝説を聞いた後で入る温泉はまた格別です！連日のじめじめも吹き飛ばしてしまいましょう！歴史もありがたさも随一！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: It was Gero Onsen in the rain, but now it has become light rain and sunlight is starting to peek through the clouds. There was no damage to the hot spring town, and the heat has eased, making it seem like it will be more comfortable once the humidity decreases. Today, I headed to Onsen-ji, a 15-minute walk from Gero Station. It was enveloped in tranquility, and the only sound I could hear was the sound of rain, allowing me to take my time exploring the grounds. Onsen-ji is said to have been established because, when the hot spring stopped flowing, a white heron, considered a messenger of Yakushi Nyorai, showed the location of the spring. I tried to look for the white heron, but it didn't show itself, perhaps taking shelter from the rain. I think I will come back to look for it again. The hot spring after hearing such legends is exceptional! Let's blow away the continuous humidity! The history and gratitude are unparalleled! Please take care of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 今日は少し遠出をして、下呂温泉街から車で約20分、萩原町にある諏訪神社を訪れました。鎌倉時代にできたといわれる、かつての諏訪城の城壁跡もあるこの諏訪神社。中は広々としていて木が高く茂り、木陰になっていて暑さを和らげてくれていてゆっくりと見回ることができました。昔話によると、築城中に1匹のへびが出て、その片目をつぶして追い払ってしまってから、諏訪城では梅が育たなくなってしまったと言われています。そのへびは諏訪明神の使いであったともいわれており、今でも片目のへびが神社周辺に住んでいるそうです。探してみましたが、へびの姿は見つけられませんでした。さすがにこの暑さに参って、どこかで涼んでいたのでしょうか。古に思いをはせていると、温泉へ浸かりたくなってきました。諏訪神社のへびも、お忍びで何度か温泉へ行っていたのかもしれませんね。歴史と昔話と温泉がたっぷりつまった街！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: Today, I took a little trip and visited Suwa Shrine in Hagiwara Town, about 20 minutes by car from Gero Onsen town. This Suwa Shrine, said to have been established in the Kamakura period, has the ruins of the former Suwa Castle walls. The inside is spacious, with tall trees providing shade, making it comfortable to stroll around. According to an old tale, during the castle's construction, a snake appeared, and after it was driven away by blinding one of its eyes, plum trees could no longer grow in Suwa Castle. It is said that the snake was a messenger of Suwa Myojin, and even now, a one-eyed snake is said to live around the shrine. I tried to look for the snake, but I couldn't find it. Perhaps it was hiding somewhere to cool off in this heat. As I pondered the ancient past, I felt the urge to soak in the hot springs. The snake from Suwa Shrine might have secretly visited the hot springs a few times as well. A town filled with history, old tales, and hot springs! Please take care of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 下呂温泉を代表する老舗旅館、水明館のロビーラウンジ「エビアン」さんへ素肌美人スイーツのひとつ、「下呂シューパルフェ」をいただきに行きましょう。甘酒や抹茶スポンジ、フレークをふんだんに使用した5層の上に、クッキーシューを贅沢にのせたインパクト抜群のスイーツです。地元産の素材でつくられたカスタードクリームやシューには、つやつや肌を作るのに欠かせないアミノ酸がたっぷり。一口ごとに甘みも食感も違ったおいしさが舌に迫り、やみつきになること間違いなしのおいしさです。ぺろりと平らげたら、そのまま温泉へ直行！せっかくですから、水明館さんの温泉にたっぷりつかって、湯上りにまた「下呂シューパルフェ」を味わっちゃうのもいいですね！温泉とスイーツが一度に楽しめるのは下呂温泉ならでは！よろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: Let's go to the lobby lounge 'Evian' of Suimeikan, a long-established ryokan representing Gero Onsen, to enjoy one of the beautiful skin sweets, 'Gero Shoe Parfait.' This impactful dessert is lavishly topped with a cookie shoe on five layers made with plenty of sweet sake, matcha sponge, and flakes. The custard cream and shoe made from locally sourced ingredients are packed with amino acids essential for creating smooth skin. Each bite brings a different sweetness and texture that will surely make you addicted. After finishing it off, you can head straight to the hot spring! Since you're there, it's also nice to soak in Suimeikan's hot spring and enjoy 'Gero Shoe Parfait' again after bathing! Enjoying both hot springs and sweets at the same time is unique to Gero Onsen!

description: Seeking beautiful skin sweets, let’s head to 'Périgord Coffee Roastery'. I ordered 'Tochi Nut Crush Ice'. It comes with vanilla ice cream and French toast, accompanied by the Gero specialty 'Tochi Nut Senbei', which is rich in antioxidant properties. The elegant sweetness of the chilled vanilla ice cream, the gentle texture of the French toast, and the crunchiness of the 'Tochi Nut Senbei' blended together to create an exquisite dish that I finished in no time. The heat was blown away, and I felt refreshed both physically and mentally. The deliciousness made me want a second serving. Without forgetting the aftertaste, off to the hot springs! Further refreshment is to be expected! A town of hot springs and sweets that are gentle on the skin! Please take care of Gero Onsen!

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
けふの下呂温泉
description:
7月31日（土）に開催された「いでゆ夜市サマーフェスティバルin下呂温泉」の様子です。

幸い天候にも恵まれて、前回以上に盛り上がりを見せました。
出店で販売しているドリンクとスナックを頬張りながら、チアダンスの「ユニークスタイルクラブデリシャス」さん、女性太鼓の「華響」さん、太鼓演奏の「龍神子供太鼓」さんたちが披露してくれた、見事なパフォーマンスを拝見しました。
どれも素晴らしく、目を離すことができないほどで、あっという間に時間が過ぎていきました。
来週の８月7日（土）にも開催予定ですので、ぜひいらしてください。

夜市をたんのうした後は、温泉で汗を流しましょう！
今から次回の開催が楽しみです！

イベントも温泉も天下一品！
下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
This is an account of the 'Ideyu Night Market Summer Festival in Gero Onsen' held on July 31 (Saturday).

Fortunately, the weather was favorable, and the event was even more lively than the last time.
While munching on drinks and snacks sold at the stalls, we enjoyed wonderful performances by the cheer dance group 'Unique Style Club Delicious', the women's taiko group 'Hanakyo', and the taiko performance group 'Ryujin Kodomo Taiko'.
All of them were fantastic, and I couldn't take my eyes off them, and time flew by in no time.
The next event is scheduled for August 7 (Saturday), so please come!

After enjoying the night market, let's wash away our sweat in the hot springs!
I am already looking forward to the next event!

Both the event and the hot springs are top-notch!
Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 飛騨川沿いの遊歩道を散策です。川沿いであるおかげか、暑い中にあっても涼しく散策ができました。しばらく歩いていると、塚田の渡しと書かれた石碑に出会いました。調べてみると、古くは奈良時代から重要な渡し船の拠点となっていたようです。大正時代に六ツ見橋ができてからは廃止されたそうで、その名残が残っています。対岸にも同じく石碑があるようで、今回はそうと気づかずに通り過ぎてしまったので、次回は見に行ければと思います。過去に思いをはせながら温泉につかるのもまた一興ですね！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: A stroll along the promenade by the Hida River. Thanks to being by the river, I was able to enjoy a cool walk even in the heat. After walking for a while, I came across a stone monument that read 'Tsukada no Watashi'. Upon researching, it seems that it has been an important ferry point since the Nara period. It was discontinued after the construction of the Mutsumi Bridge in the Taisho era, leaving some remnants. It seems there is also a similar stone monument on the opposite bank, which I passed by without noticing this time, so I hope to see it next time. Soaking in the hot springs while reflecting on the past is also a pleasure! Please take care of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
I went down to the Takehara River in the Ogawa area.

The green trees are vibrant, and the sound of the flowing water is pleasant to the ears.
The water is very clear, and when I put my hand in, it felt cool, providing a refreshing sensation in the hot sunlight.

This Takehara River merges with the Hida River, and thinking that it is part of that large flow makes me feel somewhat strange.

Now, during these hot days, let’s cool off with a hot spring!
Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

7月24日（土）に開催された、「いでゆ夜市サマーフェスティバルin下呂温泉」の動画です！

コロナ禍ということもあり、例年よりも規模を縮小した形での開催となりましたが、それを感じさせない活気と熱気に満ちた2時間でした！この日は、「龍神子供太鼓」と「飛騨萩原御前太鼓」の2チームが参加し、見事な太鼓演奏を披露してくださいました。

出店でも飛騨牛コロッケや手羽先を販売し、お客さんが舌鼓をうっていました。

次回開催は7月３１日（土）。それ以降も、８月７，１４日、２１日の毎週土曜日開催です！（雨天の場合は中止します）

祭りと温泉の街、下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
This is a video of the 'Ideyu Night Market Summer Festival in Gero Onsen' held on July 24 (Saturday)!

Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the event was held on a smaller scale than usual, but it was filled with energy and excitement for two hours! On this day, two teams, 'Ryujin Children’s Taiko' and 'Hida Hagiwara Gozen Taiko', participated and presented wonderful taiko performances.

At the stalls, Hida beef croquettes and chicken wings were sold, and customers were enjoying the food.

The next event will be held on July 31 (Saturday). After that, it will be held every Saturday on August 7, 14, and 21! (It will be canceled in case of rain)

Please support Gero Onsen, the town of festivals and hot springs!

description: 高台からの下呂温泉の風景を映してきました。一望できるところから下呂温泉を見渡すと、山の向こうまであっという間に行けそうな気がしてきます。普段何気なく通り過ぎているところも、また違った風に見えますね。晴れ間がのぞき、陽光が熱いくらいでしたが、空には大きな雲が集まってきていました。このあと、一雨きそうな雰囲気です。そんなときは雨宿りがてら温泉に入るに限ります！雨が止むまで、のんびりとつかって過ごしましょう！どんな天気でも格別の温泉が待ってます！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: I have captured the scenery of Gero Onsen from a high point. Looking out over Gero Onsen from a vantage point makes it feel like I could reach the mountains in no time. Even places I usually pass by seem to look different. The sun peeked through, and it was quite warm, but large clouds were gathering in the sky. It feels like it might rain soon. In such times, there's nothing better than soaking in the hot springs while waiting for the rain to stop! Let's relax and enjoy the hot springs until the rain stops! No matter the weather, exceptional hot springs are waiting for you! Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

description: Once again, I visited Kougetsu Honke in search of sweets. My target was one of the Gero Onsen Beautiful Skin Sweets, the 'Wa' MORI盛りパフェ. This special dessert is packed with Japanese ingredients and contains plenty of essential nutrients for beautiful skin, such as isoflavones and vitamin C. The luxurious collaboration of Japanese and Western flavors, along with the sweetness of the fruits, made it impossible to stop eating, and I finished it in no time. Even while soaking in the hot spring afterward, I couldn't forget the taste! I want to go eat it again tomorrow! When it comes to beautiful skin and sweets, Gero Onsen is the place to be! Thank you very much!

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
けふの下呂温泉
description:
スイーツを求めて、幸月本家（こうげつほんけ）さんへお邪魔しました。

和菓子も洋菓子も扱っているお店で、どのお菓子もとてもおいしそうです。
今日は、おまんじゅうの　げろじまん　と　幸月の生どら　を賞味。
どちらも絶品でしたが、より印象に残ったのは生どらでした。
ふかふかの生地に、生クリームとつぶあんがミックスされていて和と洋のコラボレーションを一度に味わえます。
思わず二つ目に手が伸びてしまいそうでした。

甘いもののあとは温泉へ入りたくなりますね！
テイクアウトして、温泉あがりに食べるのもおいしそうです！

下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
I visited Kogetsuhonke in search of sweets.

It is a shop that handles both Japanese and Western sweets, and all the confections look very delicious.
Today, I tasted the Gero-jiman steamed bun and Kogetsu's fresh dorayaki.
Both were exquisite, but the fresh dorayaki left a stronger impression.
The fluffy dough is mixed with fresh cream and sweet red bean paste, allowing you to enjoy a collaboration of Japanese and Western flavors at once.
I couldn't help but reach for a second one.

After something sweet, I feel like taking a dip in the hot springs!
It sounds delicious to take it out and eat it after soaking in the hot springs!

Thank you for Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
7月3日（土）に開催された、天壌無窮 悪疫退散　下呂温泉花火物語です。

今回のテーマは七夕花火、天候にも恵まれて、彦星と織姫の再会を祝福するように、見事な花火が打ちあがりました。
間近で見るとその迫力はひとしおで、花火がこちらに迫ってくるような感覚になりました。
色とりどりの花火はとてもきれいで、もっともっと眺めていたくなってしまいます。

花火のあとは当然温泉へ入りました！
花火と温泉のぜいたくなとりあわせは、やみつきになりそうです！

温泉も花火も天壌無窮！
下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
The Gero Onsen Fireworks Story, held on July 3rd (Saturday), is dedicated to the eternal heavens and the eradication of evil.

This time, the theme was Tanabata fireworks, and we were blessed with good weather, allowing magnificent fireworks to light up the sky in celebration of the reunion of Hikoboshi and Orihime.
Seeing them up close was incredibly powerful, giving the sensation that the fireworks were coming right at us.
The colorful fireworks were so beautiful that I wanted to keep watching them forever.

After the fireworks, of course, we went to the hot springs!
The luxurious combination of fireworks and hot springs is sure to become addictive!

Both the hot springs and the fireworks are eternal!
Please take care of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 今日は、下呂温泉足湯の里ゆあみ屋さんの足湯へお邪魔しました。ゆったり腰をおろしてくつろげるスペースがあり、ほど良い温かさのお湯にひたりながらリラックス。お店にはお土産やドリンク、スイーツが販売されていて、それを片手に足湯を楽しむのもおすすめです。次はそのスイーツを味わってみたいですね。たくさんの種類があり、どれもおいしそうで目移りしてしまいます。足湯をたんのうしたあとは、温泉に入りたくなりました！足湯と温泉、スイーツ！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: Today, I visited the foot bath at Yuumiyasan in Gero Onsen. There is a relaxing space where you can sit back comfortably and enjoy the pleasantly warm water. The shop sells souvenirs, drinks, and sweets, and it's also recommended to enjoy the foot bath while holding one of those. I would like to try the sweets next. There are many varieties, and they all look delicious, making it hard to choose. After enjoying the foot bath, I felt like taking a dip in the hot spring! Foot baths, hot springs, and sweets! Please take care of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 雨上がりの下呂温泉を散歩してみました。街のあちこちに、あじさいの花が咲いています。青や紫色の花が多くみられますが、皆さんはどんな色がお好みでしょうか？しらさぎ緑地は雨の後ということで、より緑が映えるようでした。晴れの日に散策するのもいいですが、こうした中を歩くのも趣があって楽しいですね。こういう日は温泉に入って気分一新が最高です！雨音を聞きながら温泉にひたるのも良い感じです。晴れの日も雨の日も温泉三昧！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: I took a walk in Gero Onsen after the rain. Hydrangeas are blooming all over the town. There are many blue and purple flowers, but what colors do you prefer? Shirakagi Green Space looked even greener after the rain. While it's nice to stroll on sunny days, walking in such weather is also enjoyable. On days like this, soaking in the hot springs to refresh your mood is the best! Listening to the sound of the rain while soaking in the hot springs feels great. Enjoying the hot springs on both sunny and rainy days! Please take care of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 街を歩いていると、おいしそうな匂いにつられて、GEROGERO BUTTER STAND（ゲロゲロバタースタンド）さんに引き寄せられました。店内には自家製バターや様々な品物が並んでいて、おしゃれな外装や車のオブジェ、バターミルクの足湯など人目をひくものが満載です。持ち帰りもできるお菓子や食べ物、ドリンクも販売しており、この日はサクサクのクッキーとぜいたくなバタークリームの甘みが楽しめるバターサンド。かつおぶしがアクセントでついている、バターと醤油のこうばしい香りがたまらない、焼きおにぎりに舌鼓を打ちました。ほかの商品も食べてみたいですね。お土産を買って、おなかを満たして足湯に入ったら、今度は温泉へいきましょう！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: As I walked through the town, I was drawn in by a delicious smell to GEROGERO BUTTER STAND. Inside the store, there were homemade butters and various items on display, along with stylish exteriors, car sculptures, and a buttermilk foot bath that caught the eye. They also sell take-home snacks, food, and drinks, and on this day, I enjoyed a crispy cookie and a butter sand with luxurious butter cream sweetness. I savored grilled rice balls with a delightful aroma of butter and soy sauce, accented with bonito flakes. I want to try other products as well. After buying souvenirs, filling my stomach, and soaking in the foot bath, let's head to the hot springs next! Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 下呂発温泉博物館へ足を運びました。館内には温泉を科学と文面から紹介するコーナーがあり、楽しくわかりやすく温泉について学ぶことができます。意外な発見や温泉に関連する産業などの解説もあり、ついつい時間を忘れてしまいそうです。学んだあとは、館内にある足湯に入りましょう。熱いお湯と冷たい水で構成され、歩行浴を楽しめます。温度差と運動によって血行促進の効果があり、頭脳にも健康にも優しい施設です。さらに滋養するために、温泉へゆきましょう！全身つかればさらに効果があがるかも？頭脳と健康のお供下呂温泉！　よろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: I visited the Gero Onsen Museum. Inside the museum, there is a section that introduces hot springs through science and text, allowing you to learn about hot springs in a fun and easy-to-understand way. There are also explanations of surprising discoveries and industries related to hot springs, making it easy to lose track of time. After learning, let's enjoy the foot bath available in the museum. It consists of hot water and cold water, allowing you to enjoy walking baths. The temperature difference and exercise promote blood circulation, making it a facility that is good for both the mind and health. To further nourish yourself, let's go to the hot springs! Soaking your whole body may enhance the effects even more? Gero Onsen, your companion for the mind and health! Thank you very much!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
6月26日（土）の「天壌無窮　悪疫退散　下呂温泉花火物語（てんじょうむきゅう　あくえきたいさん　げろおんせんはなびものがたり）」の花火の様子です。

下呂大橋（いでゆ大橋）からの風景で、夜空に咲く花火がとてもきれいでした。打ち上げ時間は10分間ほどだったのですが、もっともっと続いてほしいと思ってしまいました。
色とりどりの花火は、まるで生き物のようでした。

9月4日（土）まで、花火は毎週土曜日に開催する予定ですので、ぜひご覧にいらっしゃってください。
次は7月3日（土）夜8時30分からの予定です。

花火の後は当然温泉へ！　しっとりゆっくり湯船につかりましょう！

夏の土曜は下呂温泉！　よろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
This is the scene of the fireworks from the 'Tenjō Mukyū, Evil Epidemic Dispersal, Gero Onsen Fireworks Story' on June 26 (Saturday).

The view from Gero Ohashi (Ideyu Bridge) was beautiful with fireworks blooming in the night sky. The launch time was about 10 minutes, but I wished it would last much longer.
The colorful fireworks looked like living creatures.

Fireworks are scheduled to be held every Saturday until September 4 (Saturday), so please come and see them.
The next one is scheduled for July 3 (Saturday) at 8:30 PM.

After the fireworks, of course, it's time for the hot springs! Let's soak in the bath slowly and gently!

Summer Saturdays are for Gero Onsen! Thank you very much!

Gero Onsen_R3.06.25

I went to the heron foot bath today during my foot bath tour.

This is the first foot bath born in Gero Onsen, featuring a cypress-made bath and roof, allowing for a thorough soak.

Before that, it’s nice to visit the nearby Kaeru Shrine, where many frogs welcome you.

Soaking in the foot bath makes me feel warm and a bit sleepy... What appeared in my dreams were... herons, frogs, and hot springs!

This is a good omen! Let’s go to the hot springs!

Please take care of the Gero Onsen, colored by hot springs and mystery!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
晴れ間だった昼から、あれよあれよと雲が出てきて、現在はしとしと雨降りの下呂温泉です。

まだ晴れている間に、少し遠出をして乗政にあるしだれ栗の群生地へ行きました。
その名の通りに、しだれた枝をもつこの栗の群生地は、全国でも数か所しかないという希少なものです。
中には100年を超える個体もあり、濃い緑がとてもきれいでした。

さて、遠出をしたあとは温泉に入るのが一番です。
温泉パワーでしだれ栗のような長寿を！

下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
From the sunny afternoon, clouds quickly gathered, and now it is drizzling in Gero Onsen.

Before the rain, I took a little trip to the group of weeping chestnuts in Norimasa. As the name suggests, this group of chestnuts with drooping branches is a rare sight, found in only a few places nationwide. Some of the trees are over 100 years old, and the deep green is very beautiful.

After a trip, there's nothing better than soaking in the hot springs.
May the power of the hot springs grant longevity like the weeping chestnuts!

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

description: Today, the sun was hidden behind the clouds all day. Although it didn’t rain, it felt cool and somewhat melancholic. It seemed like a quiet and relaxed time was flowing along the streets of the city and by the Hida River. The large stones by the riverbank must have been watching over Gero Onsen for a long time, right? On a day like this, there's nothing better than soaking in the hot springs to refresh oneself! Our motto is 'Every day is a hot spring day,' so please take care of Gero Onsen!

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: 本日は、太陽がずっと雲に隠れていました。雨は降らなかったけれど、涼しくてなんだかしんみりした気持ちになります。市街の道や飛騨川のそばでも、静かでゆったりした時が流れているようでした。河原にある大きな石たちは、ずっと昔から下呂温泉を見てきたのでしょうか？こんな日は、温泉に入って気分転換に限ります！日々是温泉がモットーの、下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 納涼を求めて歩くうちに、いつのまにか雨情公園へたどり着いていました。暑い中でも、川のせせらぎのおかげで涼しい空気に包まれているようです。流した汗も引いていって、散策するにはうってつけです。さすがに泳ぐには支障がありそうですが、手を浸してみると涼しさがそこから全身に広まっていきます。この後は、しめに温泉に入れば、暑さも吹っ飛んでいってしまうでしょう。下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: While seeking coolness, I found myself arriving at Ujo Park before I knew it. Even in the heat, the sound of the river seems to wrap me in cool air. The sweat I shed is fading, making it perfect for a stroll. It seems like swimming might be a challenge, but when I dip my hands in, the coolness spreads throughout my body. After this, if I take a dip in the hot springs, the heat will surely blow away.

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: As a continuation of the previous entry, I visited one of the spots for the digital photo rally, Gassho Village. It forms a settlement with traditional gassho-zukuri houses relocated from Shirakawa-go, recreating Japan's original landscape. The beauty of nature spreads out, along with museums, dining places, and experiential facilities, making me feel as if I had traveled back in time. After strolling around, I took a moment to relax in a foot bath. Now, let's immerse ourselves in the hot springs!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: カラッと晴れ間が広がっている下呂温泉です。市街にあるデジタルフォトラリーのスポットを、いくつか撮影して回りました。けふも暑くなりそうと思っていると、午後から急に激しい雨が！ついさっきまで、あんなに晴れていたのがウソのように、窓から雨が降り注いでいる光景が見えます。突然の雨には、折り畳み傘と雨宿りと、温泉が欠かせません！濡れて冷えた体を、ホットに回復させましょう！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: It is a clear day at Gero Onsen. I went around taking pictures of several spots in the city for the digital photo rally. Just when I thought it would be hot today, it suddenly started pouring rain in the afternoon! It looks like a lie that it was so sunny just a moment ago, as I see the rain pouring down from the window. For sudden rain, a folding umbrella, a place to take shelter, and hot springs are essential! Let's warm up our chilled bodies! Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
一雨去り、爽やかさと暑さが同居している下呂温泉です。

日差しは雲に遮られがちですが、知らず知らずに木陰や水場を求めて歩いていて、夏の暑さがやってきていたのだなあと実感しました。

花や虫が暑さに負けずにいる姿を見ると、こちらも暑い暑いとぼやいていてはいけないと、気合が入ります。

心機一転、リフレッシュを図るなら温泉がベスト！
下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
After a rain, Gero Onsen is a place where freshness and heat coexist.

The sunlight is often blocked by clouds, but I realized that summer heat had arrived as I unknowingly walked in search of shade and water.

Seeing flowers and insects thriving despite the heat motivates me not to complain about the heat.

If you want to refresh yourself, hot springs are the best! Please take care of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: It’s a beautiful day at Gero Onsen! The sunlight is strong, and I feel the excitement of summer approaching.

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: Despite the heat, flowers are blooming beautifully everywhere. I can’t hear the cicadas yet, but soon the noisy chorus will begin.

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
雨の中の下呂温泉です。

しっとりとはしていますが、憂鬱とは無縁のさわやかな空気に包まれています。

山向こうには、霧の合間から青空が見え、この雨もずっとは続かないとわかっているからかもしれないですね。

雨の日は、気温がさがったり濡れたりして冷えた体を温めるのに、あたたかい温泉がもってこいです！

下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
It is Gero Onsen in the rain.

It is moist, but it is wrapped in a refreshing air that is unrelated to gloom.

Beyond the mountains, blue sky can be seen through the gaps in the mist, perhaps because we know that this rain will not last forever.

On rainy days, warm hot springs are perfect for warming up a chilled body due to the drop in temperature and getting wet!

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

The hot spring inns are lined up around the Hida River, and just looking at them makes you want to soak in the hot springs! description:
#天橋立 #ソフトトラベル #ソフトトラベルプラン #京都の秋 #秋の日本
賑やかな都市を離れ、初秋の京都の田舎の静かな美しさを発見しましょう。葉が色づき始めると、風景は豊かな緑、柔らかな金色、そして赤のヒントが見事に融合します。このブログは、京都の穏やかな田舎の宝石を巡る旅にあなたを連れて行き、この季節の魔法を体験するのに田舎が最適な場所である理由を紹介します！

🌟私がしたこと
✨ 高さのある竹に囲まれた象徴的な嵐山竹林を散策し、まるで別世界に足を踏み入れたかのような体験をしました - https://maps.app.goo.gl/TDGoyx99iwDaBksu6
✨ 日本の「三景」の一つである天橋立の静かな田舎を探索しました。天橋立ビューランドへのスカイリフトに乗り、砂州と周囲の美しさのパノラマビューを楽しみました - https://maps.app.goo.gl/h9bcZx6skRkcmufL7
✨ 魅力的な京都丹後鉄道観光列車に乗り、北京都の絵のような田舎を楽しみました - https://willer-travel.com/en/train/tantetsu/
✨ 食通や買い物好きにぴったりの活気ある新京極商店街で、心温まる一蘭ラーメンの夕食で一日を締めくくりました - https://maps.app.goo.gl/BMSTuXt98Foo8rMh9
✨ 日本最大の湖である琵琶湖の息をのむような景色を楽しめる大津の琵琶湖プリンスホテルにチェックインしました - https://maps.app.goo.gl/MgjRp11McUfoP2C8A

このブログは、京都の初秋の魅力を捉え、象徴的なランドマーク、風光明媚な景色、忘れられない料理体験を組み合わせています。🍂 京都への旅行を計画している方や旅行コンテンツが好きな方は、ぜひ「いいね」と「コメント」を残し、チャンネル登録をお忘れなく！

description:
#ソフトトラベル #京都秋 #京都旅行Vlog #京都日本 #嵯峨野ロマンチックトレイン

初秋の京都はまさに魔法のようです！紅葉が始まったばかりの時期、鮮やかな緑、燃えるような赤、黄金色の黄色が混ざり合い、驚くべき色の万華鏡を作り出します。この季節に訪れる価値が100%ある理由をお見せするために、私と一緒に京都の timeless beauty を探検しましょう！

🌟 私がしたこと：
✨ 二年坂と三年坂の歴史的な通りを散策し、伝統的な木造家屋や居心地の良いお店が時を超えた感覚をもたらします。その途中で、シロカカフェで美味しいマドレーヌとほうじ茶ラテを楽しみました - https://maps.app.goo.gl/DFmZizgzqULwpRhr5
✨ 自分だけのカスタマイズされた香水を作り、京都のユニークで思い出に残るお土産を手に入れました - https://maps.app.goo.gl/DFmZizgzqULwpRhr5
✨ 祇園町南川を夕方に散策し、夜の京都の魅力的な雰囲気を味わいました - https://maps.app.goo.gl/5hDYzwQ4ZmQ6SxM26
✨ ジュニダニャで美味しいすき焼きの食事を楽しみ、秋の日にぴったりのボリューム満点で風味豊かな料理を味わいました - https://maps.app.goo.gl/97XRyxVRHBuG6czM9
✨ 嵯峨野ロマンチックトレインに乗り、保津川と初秋の紅葉の息をのむような景色に囲まれました - https://www.sagano-kanko.co.jp/en/?
✨ 美しい京都古伝町花伝荘温泉旅館に宿泊し、探索の一日の後にリラックスできるプライベートバスでのんびりしました - https://maps.app.goo.gl/2iMqbXpZh8msgvvcA

京都を夢見ている方や次の旅行を計画している方、このVlogは初秋の京都の美しさと温かさを紹介しています。🍂 もしこれが将来試してみたいと思ったら、いいね、コメント、チャンネル登録を忘れずに！

title: Exploring Japan: Tsuyama to Kobe, Mount Rokko and Arima Onsen! 🇯🇵 Day 2 Journey
description:
#JapanTravel #KobeAdventures #MountRokko #ArimaOnsen #ShabuShabuDelights #TravelJapan #Day2Journey #Japan #Autumn #Tsuyama ✈️

🎥 Join me and Mom on Day 2 of our unforgettable journey through Japan! 🇯🇵 Today, we're exploring the charming town of Tsuyama, driving back to Okayama, and then embarking on an adventure to Kobe. 🚗🚅 

Our day starts with a visit to a cozy café in Tsuyama, where we enjoy a delightful brunch amidst the picturesque surroundings. ☕ Next, we hop back into the car and make our way to Okayama, where we catch a train to the vibrant city of Kobe. 🚆 

In Kobe, we take a public bus to the Mount Rokko Cable car station, where we ascend to the mountaintop and soak in the breathtaking views of the surrounding area. 🏔️ Along the way, we make a stop at the charming Arima Onsen town, immersing ourselves in the relaxing atmosphere and rejuvenating hot springs. 🌸 

As the sun sets, we head to Mount Rokko Garden Terrace's observatory to marvel at the stunning night view of Kobe port. 🌃 Finally, we wrap up our day with a visit to a fantastic shabu shabu restaurant, where the owner's warm hospitality and delicious food make for a memorable dining experience. 🍲 

Stay tuned for Day 3, where we'll continue our adventure through Japan's hidden gems! Don't forget to hit subscribe and join our travel family as we explore the Land of the Rising Sun together! 🌅

title: 日本を探る：津山から神戸、六甲山と有馬温泉！🇯🇵 2日目の旅
description:
#日本旅行 #神戸アドベンチャー #六甲山 #有馬温泉 #しゃぶしゃぶの楽しみ #旅行日本 #2日目の旅 #日本 #秋 #津山 ✈️

🎥 私と母と一緒に、日本を通じての忘れられない旅の2日目に参加してください！🇯🇵 今日は、魅力的な津山市を探索し、岡山に戻り、そして神戸への冒険に出発します。🚗🚅 

私たちの一日は、津山の居心地の良いカフェを訪れ、美しい景色の中で素晴らしいブランチを楽しむことから始まります。☕ 次に、車に戻り岡山に向かい、活気ある神戸市行きの電車に乗ります。🚆 

神戸では、公共バスで六甲山ケーブルカーの駅に向かい、山頂に上がって周囲の息をのむような景色を楽しみます。🏔️ 途中、有馬温泉の魅力的な町に立ち寄り、リラックスした雰囲気と rejuvenating hot springs に浸ります。🌸 

日が沈むと、六甲ガーデンテラスの展望台に向かい、神戸港の素晴らしい夜景を楽しみます。🌃 最後に、素晴らしいしゃぶしゃぶレストランを訪れ、オーナーの温かいおもてなしと美味しい料理で思い出に残る食事体験をします。🍲 

3日目もお楽しみに！日本の隠れた宝石を探索し続けます！チャンネル登録をお忘れなく、一緒に日の出の国を探検しましょう！🌅

I hope to create some sort of awareness about the challenges designers of fashion or creative industry in Malaysia, and the adversities that we faced, and how I kept fighting to keep doing what I do, and trying to make changes and adapt. Although my effort is still not reaching out to much people yet, and I'm not sure how this will turn out but I've decided to keep trying and never give up. I hope you guys will support this channel by simply clicking the like and subscribe button, it will mean a world to me. Thanks and much love, YJ.

title: 福知山城 現代大茶会 アフタームービー【出演：クリス・ペプラーさん、水野直己さん】
description:
＼　　　2020年大河ドラマ「麒麟がくる」放送直前！　　　／
　＼明智光秀の知られざる魅力と福知山城の盛り上がりを／
　　＼　　　　 クリス・ペプラーさんが発信 　　　　／

コンセプトは「明智光秀が、この令和の時代に茶会を開くとしたら・・・」。

「光秀は茶の湯に親しむ文化人でもあった」という知られざる光秀の魅力を発信すべく、光秀が築いた京都・福知山城の本丸広場を舞台に行った「福知山城　現代大茶会」を、クリス・ペプラーさんと水野直己さんが振り返ります。

＊　＊　＊

【福知山城 現代大茶会】2019年11月9日

「明智光秀が築いた城下町 福知山」特別大使であり、光秀の子孫とされTV・ラジオパーソナリティーのクリス・ペプラーさんが「城主」として「現代大茶会」を主宰しました。

大茶会を彩る「現代版 茶菓子」（スイーツ）を、国内外で活躍するシェフパティシエで福知山ドッコイセ大使の水野直己さんが新たに創作。
「ワールドチョコレートマスターズ」で世界一に輝いた水野さんならではの、丹波くりの独創的なチョコレート茶菓子「Tamba（丹波）」がお披露目されました。

お茶菓子は、茶道家・松村宗亮さんが点てたお茶とともに、市内で茶道部に所属する高校生や100人の市民にふるまわれました。

＊　＊　＊

title: Fukuchiyama Castle Modern Grand Tea Ceremony After Movie【Featuring: Chris Pepple, Naoki Mizuno】
description:
＼　　　Before the broadcast of the 2020 Taiga drama 'Kirin ga Kuru'!　　　／
　＼We will convey the unknown charm of Akechi Mitsuhide and the excitement of Fukuchiyama Castle／
　　＼　　　　 Chris Pepple will deliver it 　　　　／

The concept is 'If Akechi Mitsuhide were to hold a tea ceremony in this Reiwa era...'.

To convey the unknown charm of Mitsuhide, who was also a cultured person fond of tea, Chris Pepple and Naoki Mizuno will look back on the 'Fukuchiyama Castle Modern Grand Tea Ceremony' held in the main courtyard of Fukuchiyama Castle, which was built by Mitsuhide.

＊　＊　＊

【Fukuchiyama Castle Modern Grand Tea Ceremony】November 9, 2019

Chris Pepple, a special ambassador of 'Fukuchiyama, the castle town built by Akechi Mitsuhide' and a descendant of Mitsuhide, presided over the 'Modern Grand Tea Ceremony' as the 'castle lord'.

The 'modern tea sweets' that adorned the grand tea ceremony were newly created by Naoki Mizuno, a chef patissier active both domestically and internationally, and the Fukuchiyama Dokkoise ambassador. 
The unique chocolate tea sweets 'Tamba' made from Tanba chestnuts, created by Mizuno, who won the World Chocolate Masters, were unveiled.

title: The Pride and Beauty of Nikko, Tochigi 180sec
description:
Yomeimon Gate—a symbol of Nikko Toshogu Shrine, which is said to be one of Japan's most lavish shrines—is also called Higurashimon Gate (the "timeless gate"). This is because the gate's decorations are said to be so gorgeous that you can stare at them all day without ever getting tired of them.

Several years ago, the shrine underwent a major restoration during which craftsmen well-versed in the techniques used to create the shrine removed around 500 of its carvings and then repaired them, infusing them with vivid new life.

These techniques live on in the area surrounding Nikko Toshogu Shrine and the other Shrines and Temples of Nikko, all of which have been designated as a World Heritage Site. The Nikko woodcarvings represent one example of such techniques, and they feature distinctive curves carved using a unique type of carving knife, a “hikkaki-tou.” Visitors are given the opportunity not only to check out “Nikko woodcarving” but also to experience it for themselves.

If you visit Toshogu Shrine after experiencing the ancient techniques used to build it, we're sure you'll see it in a new light.

title: 日光の誇りと美しさ 180秒
description:
陽明門—日本で最も装飾された神社の日光東照宮の象徴であり、「日暮門」とも呼ばれています。この門の装飾は非常に豪華で、日が暮れるまで見ていても飽きることがないと言われています。

数年前、神社は大規模な修復を行い、創建時の技術を受け継ぐ職人たちが約500体の彫刻を外し、修復を施し、色鮮やかに生まれ変わりました。

これらの技術は日光東照宮や日光の他の社寺の周辺地域に息づいており、すべてが世界遺産に指定されています。日光彫はその一例であり、独特な刀「ひっかき刀」を使用して彫られた曲線が特徴です。訪問者は「日光彫」を見るだけでなく、自分自身で体験する機会も与えられます。

古の技術に触れた後に東照宮を訪れると、新たな視点で見ることができるでしょう。

title: 佐渡市クルーズ船寄港の様子
description: 佐渡島は新潟県の沖合に位置し、面積は約855平方キロメートル、海岸線が約280kmある日本海側最大の離島です。島の気候は沖合の海流の影響から本土に比べ温暖で降雪量も少ない環境となっています。島には寒暖両系の様々な植物が自生しており、海産物はもとより、米や果樹などの多種多様な農産物も豊富であり、一年を通じて食材にも恵まれています。2024年7月27日に佐渡島の金山が世界文化遺産にも登録され、見どころもたくさん、クルーズ船で佐渡へ寄港したお客様にも、心に残るおもてなしを目指しています。クルーズ船でも佐渡にも是非お越しください。

title: The Situation of Cruise Ship Calls in Sado City
description: Sado Island is located off the coast of Niigata Prefecture, with an area of about 855 square kilometers and a coastline of approximately 280 km, making it the largest remote island on the Sea of Japan side. The island's climate is milder and has less snowfall compared to the mainland due to the influence of offshore ocean currents. Various plants of both cold and warm climates grow naturally on the island, and it is rich in a variety of agricultural products, including seafood, rice, and fruits, providing abundant ingredients throughout the year. On July 27, 2024, the Sado Island gold mine will be registered as a World Cultural Heritage site, and we aim to provide memorable hospitality to customers who visit Sado by cruise ship. Please come to Sado by cruise ship as well.

title: ５月の香美町
description: Today marks the end of May. Due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, many people were unable to visit Kamitown during the self-restraint period in May. Here, I would like to introduce a little bit of the scenery of Kamitown in May. Please enjoy the views from the Kamitown tourism poster shooting locations: 'Kasumi Coast', 'O-katsura of Wae', 'Uhe Mountain Rice Terraces', and 'Kaeru Island'. Enjoy the sounds of birds chirping, water flowing, frogs croaking, and waves crashing, and experience the true scenery of Kamitown.

title: May in Kamitown
６月の香美町
description: Today marks the end of June. The rainy season began on June 10, and there have been many rainy days. The rice planting in the town has also finished, and for the rice fields, it can be said that the rain is a blessing. Additionally, it has become the season where we can see the sunset over Kasumi Coast. I would like to introduce a little bit of the scenery of Kōbichō in June. Please take a look at 'Kasumi Coast', 'Waiike no Ōkatsura', 'Uhe Mountain's Terraced Rice Fields', and 'Kaeru Island' from the location of the Kōbichō tourism poster shoot. Enjoy the scenery of Kōbichō as it is, with the sunset view, the sound of rain, and the chirping of birds.

title: Kōbichō in June
７月の香美町
description: July has come to an end. The rainy season has finally cleared on July 31, and it seems that hot summer is on its way. Please take care to avoid heatstroke. Here are a few glimpses of Kamitown's scenery in July. Please enjoy the views of 'Kasumi Coast', 'Oikeno Okatsura', 'Uhe Mountain's Terraced Rice Fields', and 'Kaeru Island' from the Kamitown tourism poster shooting locations. Enjoy the sunset scenery, the lights of fishing fires, the sound of evening cicadas, and the chirping of birds, all of which represent the true landscape of Kamitown.

Please enjoy the views from the Kamitown tourism poster shooting locations: 'Kasumi Coast', 'Waiike's Great Katsura', 'Uhe Mountain's Terraced Rice Fields', and 'Kaeru Island'. Enjoy the summer-like blue sky, blue sea, lush green rice ears, and the sound of cicadas, which represent the true scenery of Kamitown.

title: August in Kamitown
９月の香美町
description: As September comes to an end, October is finally here. The mornings and evenings have become cooler, and comfortable days continue. The rice harvesting in the town has begun, marking the season of fruitful autumn and appetizing autumn. Please enjoy the delicious ingredients of Kamitown. Here are a few glimpses of the scenery in Kamitown during September. From the locations of the Kamitown tourism posters, please take a look at 'Kasumi Coast', 'Waiike's Great Katsura', 'Uhe Mountain's Terraced Rice Fields', and 'Kaeru Island'. The trees in the mountains are starting to change color, and we are entering the peak of autumn foliage. Please come to Kamitown to enjoy its delicious ingredients and beautiful scenery.

title: October in Kamitown

title: １１月の香美町
description: November has come to an end, and December has arrived. The cold is increasing day by day. The waves of the Sea of Japan are becoming rough, the trees in the mountains are shedding their leaves, and the first snow is likely to arrive soon. If you visit Kamitown, please come prepared with winter tires.

title: November in Kamitown
description: 11月も終わり、12月となりました。日ごとに寒さが増してくる季節となりました。日本海の波は荒くなり、山の木々は落ち葉となり、初雪の便りが間もなくやってくるのでしょうか。香美町へお越しの際には冬用タイヤを備えてお越しください。

title: １２月の香美町
description: Happy New Year! Thank you for your support last year. I look forward to your continued support this year. In December, we welcomed the full-fledged winter with snowfall. The year 2021 is the Year of the Ox. The Tajima cattle, the source of black-haired Wagyu beef nationwide, is a pride of Kamitown. If you visit Kamitown, how about tasting the very delicious Tajima beef?

description: Gifu Prefecture Takayama City has the largest area in Japan, with an elevation difference ranging from a minimum of 436m to a maximum of 3,190m. title: Hida Takayama: The Ultimate Spinach Created by Clear Air
description: The sweetness that comes from the temperature differences in the region. From March to December, along with the cool air of the mountains. Hida spinach has a 'special sweetness' nurtured by the temperature differences between day and night in the high-altitude region of Hida. During the day, it absorbs nutrients under the sunlight, and at night, the temperature drops significantly, trapping the sweetness. This climate creates the unique softness and flavor of Hida. Traditional cultivation techniques are preserved by 350 farmers. Immediately after harvest, pre-cooling, vacuum cooling, and refrigerated transport are thoroughly implemented. The 'mountain temperature' is delivered directly to dining tables in Kansai, Chubu, Kanto, and Hokuriku. 🍳Recommended ways to enjoy: - If you make it into ohitashi, the sweetness of the leaves becomes mellow. - Stir-frying with bacon makes the thick texture the star. - In soup, it warms your heart. 🥬Shipping period: March to December. Delivering the 'seasonal' greens of Hida, undeterred by summer heat or winter cold. 📌Storage points: - Note these four words: 'thickness', 'sweetness', 'temperature difference', 'freshness management'. - Photos of 'green that feels the cool air', 'steaming ohitashi', and 'glossy leaves' are great. - If you find 'Hida-produced' at the supermarket, it's a seasonal delicacy.

title: Hida Takayama Scenic Drive 'Hida-Mino Seseragi Road'
description: A scenic drive course 'Hida-Mino Seseragi Road' that connects Gujo Hachiman Town to Takayama City Kiyomi Town, approximately 90 minutes long. As the name suggests, you can enjoy the beautiful nature along the clear streams of Yoshida River, Mase River, and Kawakami River, covering about 65 km to Takayama and Kiyomi Town. Starting from Gujo Hachiman, you can feel the atmosphere of a castle town. As you gradually gain elevation, the scenery transforms like a picture scroll, with lush Meihō Plateau, forests of white birch and larch, and Nishi Ure Pass. The few traffic signals and sharp curves make it easy to drive. Opening the window allows you to feel the pleasant sound of the river and the breeze of the highlands, making you feel as if you are blending into nature. The scenery changes with the seasons, showing different expressions with the fresh greenery of spring, cool breezes of summer, autumn leaves, and winter's tranquility. It's a breathtaking scenic road that makes you want to take your camera and go out. How about taking a little trip on your next holiday?

title: #飛騨高山 の伝統工芸品「宮笠」
description: 今から約330年前に一之宮町に伝えられたという「宮笠」。イチイとヒノキの木を薄く削って細長く切り出したものを水に浸し、編み込んで作る。材料のこしらえも、幾何学模様のような編み目もすべて匠の為せる技。代々、宮村で暮らす問坂義一さん・和彦さんは親子でこの伝統技術を守っている。宮笠は乾いているときは軽く通気性に優れ、雨や雪で水分を含むと編み込まれた木が膨張してすき間が詰まり、雨水の侵入を防ぐ。材料、寸法、形、編み方の違いで様々な種類あるが、セミ笠はそうした技術の集大成。祖父から父、父から息子たちへと受け継がれ、飛騨一之宮の伝統工芸の灯りはこれからも赤く燃え続ける。

title: Traditional Craft of Hida Takayama: Miyagasa
description: Miyagasa, which is said to have been passed down in Ichinomiya Town about 330 years ago. It is made by soaking thinly shaved and elongated pieces of Ichii and Hinoki wood in water and weaving them together. The preparation of materials and the geometric patterns of the weaving are all the work of skilled artisans. The father and son, Yoshikazu and Kazuhiko Toisaka, who live in Miyamura, have been preserving this traditional technique for generations. When dry, Miyagasa is lightweight and highly breathable, and when it absorbs moisture from rain or snow, the woven wood expands, filling the gaps and preventing rainwater from entering. There are various types depending on the materials, dimensions, shapes, and weaving methods, but the semi-gasa is the culmination of such techniques. Passed down from grandfather to father, and from father to sons, the light of traditional crafts in Hida Ichinomiya will continue to burn brightly.

Goshikigahara, which spreads at the northwest foot of Mount Norikura in the Northern Alps, is a vast forest area of about 3000ha located at the southern end of Chubu Sangaku National Park. It is truly a hidden gem where rare untouched nature remains abundant.

With many streams, waterfalls, ponds, and wetlands originating from Mount Norikura, as well as various wild animals, birds, and insects, it is a spot where you can enjoy the diverse expressions of nature. Once you step in, you can feel the power of the great nature.

title: Hida Takayama: A Journey to the Forest of Goshikigahara that Awakens the Senses
description:
～自然探勝の聖地、秘境探検を楽しむ～
北アルプス乗鞍岳の北西山麓に広がる「五色ケ原」は、中部山岳国立公園の南端にあたる約3000haの広大な森林地帯です。これまで、ほとんど手つかずの希少な自然が豊富に残る、まさに秘境。

乗鞍岳を源とする多くの渓流と滝、池、湿原、さらに多種の獣、野鳥、昆虫などの野生生物が生息し、自然の多彩な表情が楽しめるスポットです。ひとたび足を踏み入れたら、偉大な自然のパワーを感じることができます。

title: #飛騨高山 ふるさとの風景
description:
Gifu Prefecture Takayama City is an area rich in nature, surrounded by mountains over 3,000 meters high. In spring, new green buds sprout, in summer, the cool breeze of the highlands, in autumn, the colorful foliage, and in winter, the snow-covered landscape turns everything into a silver world—it's a place where you can fully experience the changing of the seasons.

The scenery spreading at the foot of the Northern Alps changes its expression every time you visit, leaving a deep impression in your heart. The clear air, the chirping of wild birds, and the sound of the wind passing through the trees... Time wrapped in the rhythm of nature makes you forget the hustle and bustle of daily life.

In spring, we enjoy the blooming weeping cherry blossoms, in summer, we cool off in the clear streams and greenery. In autumn, the mountains are dyed in golden and crimson colors, and in winter, a fantastic snowy landscape spreads out. No matter which season you visit, the beauty of each captivates travelers.

Moreover, not only nature but also the old townscape and the skills of artisans are one of the attractions of this area. Takayama, where nature and culture coexist, is a special place that gently heals the hearts of those who visit.

Take a journey to Hida Takayama to calm your mind. A quiet time with the seasons awaits you.

title: Hida Takayama: Scenery of Hometown
#飛騨高山 の 伝統工芸
description: 岐阜県高山市には、古くから受け継がれる“匠の技”が今もなお息づいています。木を知り尽くし、美しく組み上げる飛騨の木工。繊細な筆遣いで時を刻む飛騨春慶塗。大地の恵みを活かし、暮らしに寄り添ってきた技術——。それぞれの技は、自然と共に生きてきた飛騨の人々の知恵と工夫の結晶です。こうした伝統工芸は、ただ“モノ”をつくるだけではなく、心を込めて受け継がれてきた“生き方”そのもの。幾世代にもわたり培われてきた「手仕事」の魅力は、今の時代だからこそ見直される価値があります。静かな工房の音、道具と向き合う真剣な眼差し、そして完成した作品に宿るぬくもり。一度その世界をのぞいてみてください。

title: Traditional Crafts of Hida Takayama
description: In Takayama City, Gifu Prefecture, the 'artisan skills' that have been passed down for generations are still alive today. Hida woodworking, which knows wood intimately and assembles it beautifully. Hida Shunkei lacquer, which marks time with delicate brushwork. Techniques that have utilized the blessings of the earth and have been close to daily life. Each of these skills is a crystallization of the wisdom and ingenuity of the people of Hida, who have lived in harmony with nature. Such traditional crafts are not just about creating 'things', but are a way of life that has been passed down with care. The charm of 'handwork', cultivated over generations, is a value that is being reconsidered in today's era. The sounds of a quiet workshop, the serious gaze facing the tools, and the warmth that resides in the completed works. Please take a look into that world.

title: 五酒五感、#飛騨高山 で味わう極上の一杯
description: Gifu Prefecture's Takayama City. Surrounded by the Northern Alps, this city is known as a tourist destination rich in historical streets and natural blessings. However, did you know there is another charm? That is - 'sake.' In Takayama City, not only sake but also craft beer, whiskey, wine, and even rare lemon liqueur are locally produced, making it extremely rare to be able to taste five different types of 'local sake' in one city. Traditional sake brewed in a sake brewery that has been in operation since the Edo period. Craft beer made from local spring water and locally sourced malt. Fruity wine that takes advantage of the high-altitude climate. Fragrant liqueur made from highland-grown fruits. And uniquely flavored whiskey finished with meticulous distillation. Takayama City offers a rich sake culture where you can enjoy not only the sake itself but also the local climate, techniques, and the thoughts of the people behind it.

The new cherry blossom spot 'Hirayusakura' in Hirayu Onsen, Okuhida Onsen Village is in full bloom. Seven types of cherry blossoms, including Edohigan and Yaehigan, are blooming with 500 trees, creating a spring-like spectacular view of pink all around.

The Kobano Mitsuba Tsutsuji, which is also the flower of Takayama, is in full bloom.

description: Surrounded by fruits, vegetables, and flowers, the paradise of Kuzuno Town. Production of fruits such as apples and peaches, as well as vegetables like spinach and tomatoes, is thriving. Blessed with a climate of temperature differences, delicious water, and sunlight, the fruits and vegetables grown with care are also excellent as processed products. The gelato and juice made from apples and peaches, which are condensed with the natural sweetness, have a refreshing taste.

title: Mizunomichi Town #Hida Takayama #Kuzuno Town
description: フルーツや野菜、花に囲まれた桃源郷「久々野町」。りんごや桃のほか、ホウレンソウやトマトといった果物や野菜の生産が盛んです。寒暖差のある気候と美味しい水、太陽の光に恵まれ、丹精込めて育てられた果物や野菜は加工品も絶品。自然の甘さがギュッと凝縮された、りんごや桃のジェラートやジュースは目が覚めるような味わいです。

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　一之宮町
description: Morio Inako, chairman of the Hida Ichinomiya Tourism Association, will introduce the charms of the town. Ichinomiya Town is located in the southern part of Takayama City and is an area steeped in history and tradition. Surrounded by beautiful nature, it is a popular area for green tourism, where you can experience farming that takes advantage of the environment and interact with local people. Among them, Hida Ichinomiya Mizunashi Shrine is considered to be the most prestigious shrine in Hida, and is worshiped and revered by the people living in the area. You can also see and experience a variety of other genres, such as the Cabinet Office-certified Doburoku Special Zone, the 1,100-year-old Garyu Cherry Tree, a walk on Mt. Iyama where you can see the watershed, and winter sports. Please come to Ichinomiya Town. (About 20 minutes by car from downtown Takayama)

title: ReVIEW! #Hida Takayama Ichinomiya Town
description: 飛騨一之宮観光協会会長　稲子盛雄さんが町の魅力をご紹介。一之宮町は、高山市の南部に位置する歴史と伝統が息づく地域。美しい自然に囲まれており、その環境を活かした農業体験や地元の人たちとのふれあい体験ができるグリーンツーリズムが盛んな地域です。なかでも、飛騨一宮水無神社は飛騨の国で最も格式高い神社とされ、地域に住む人たちの信仰を集め敬われています。他にも内閣府認定のどぶろく特区、樹齢1,100年の臥龍桜、分水嶺が見られる位山の散策やウィンタースポーツなど様々なジャンルを見て感じることができます。一之宮町に是非お越しください。（高山市街地から車で約２０分）

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　高根町
description: Mamoru Kosaka, chairman of the Hida Takane Tourism Association, will introduce the charms of the town. Takane Town is located in the southeast of Takayama City, on a highland surrounded by nature overlooking Mt. Norikura and Mt. Ontake. Because it is adjacent to the Kiso region of Nagano Prefecture, its history, culture, and customs are strongly influenced by Kiso, and it is known as a foreign place even within Hida. Takane Town is also famous for being a production area for Kiso horses, and the stone Buddha statues made for memorial services for horses are filled with stories between people and horses. Takane Town is putting a lot of effort into fermented foods, and its whiskey distillery, which was repurposed from an abandoned school, is attracting a lot of attention. In addition, suna, which is pickled with lactic acid bacteria without using any salt, and country miso, which is often used in Hida's local cuisine, are also actively produced. The region's unique cool summers and cold winters are conducive to growing these fermented foods. It is also a unique place with many other attractions such as Hibata Soba, Takane Corn, Nomai Pass, and Mt. Ontake. Please come to Takane Town. (Approximately 50 minutes by car from Takayama city center)

title: ReVIEW! #Hida Takayama Takane Town
description: 飛騨高根観光協会会長　小坂守さんが町の魅力をご紹介。高根町は高山市の南東に位置し、乗鞍岳と御嶽山を望み大自然に囲まれた高地にあります。長野県木曽地域に隣接しているため、歴史や文化、風俗に至るまで木曽の影響を色濃く受けており、飛騨の中でも異郷の地として知られています。高根町は木曽馬の産地だったことでも有名であり、馬の供養のために作られた石仏には、人と馬との物語が込められています。高根町では発酵食品に力を入れており、廃校を再利用したウイスキー蒸溜所は大きな話題を集めています。また、塩を一切使わず乳酸菌で漬けられた「すな」や、飛騨の郷土料理によく使われる田舎味噌なども盛んに作られています。この地域特有の涼しい夏と寒冷な冬の環境が、これらの発酵食品の育成に役立っています。その他には火畑そばやタカネコーン、野麦峠や御嶽山など様々な見どころがあるユニークな場所になっています。高根町に是非お越しください。（高山市街地から車で約５０分）

title: 平安時代にタイムスリップしたような、艶やかな春のおとずれをつげる「#生きびな祭」。飛騨一宮水無神社で養蚕や農業の繁栄と女性の幸福を祈念して行われます。#飛騨高山 　#氷菓

A vibrant spring arrival reminiscent of the Heian period: the 'Ikibina Festival'. Held at Hida Ichinomiya Minashi Shrine, it prays for the prosperity of sericulture and agriculture, as well as the happiness of women.

The hot spring 'Garyu no Sato' sourced from the Iiyama mountain range, which rises to an elevation of 1,529m in Ichinomiya Town.
description: A healing spot where you can enjoy high-quality hot springs, open-air baths, saunas, jacuzzis, and relaxation rooms.

title: 1000年の時を越えていまなお咲き誇る一之宮町の名所「#臥龍桜」。周囲7.3m、枝の⾧さは東西20m、南北30mに枝を広げる大樹で国指定天然記念物。ピンク色の桜花が視界一面に広がります。#飛騨高山
1000 Years of History: The Famous 'Garyu-zakura' in Ichinomiya Town Still in Full Bloom
description: A famous cherry blossom tree, 'Garyu-zakura', in Ichinomiya Town, which has been blooming for over 1000 years. It is a large tree with a circumference of 7.3m and branches extending 20m east-west and 30m north-south, designated as a national natural monument. The pink cherry blossoms spread across the entire view.

title: #飛騨高山 で江戸時代から愛される一之宮町の伝統工芸品「宮笠」。イチイやヒノキの木を薄く削って細長く切り、水に浸して柔らかくしたものを編み込んで作ります。
The traditional craft 'Miyagasa' of Ichinomiya Town, loved since the Edo period in Hida Takayama.
description: Miyagasa is made by thinly shaving and cutting wood from Ichii and Hinoki, soaking it in water to soften it, and then weaving it together.

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　久々野町
description: 株式会社MGN 代表取締役 桐山淳一さんが町の魅力をご紹介。久々野町は、高山市の南部に位置し、美しい自然の風景が広がる地域です。この町は果物や野菜の生産が盛んで、「ひだ桃源郷」とも呼ばれるほどです。春になると、果物の花が咲き誇り、まるで夢のような風景が広がります。特に「飛騨りんご」や「飛騨もも」、「飛騨なし」、「飛騨メロン」などが特産品として有名です。なかでも、飛騨りんごを使った「アップルパイ」は大変人気で、発売するとすぐに完売してしまうほど。久々野町随一の名産品にまで成長しました。また、アルコピアスキー場跡地では毎年8月にひまわり園がオープンします。約20万本のひまわりが一面に咲き誇り、久々野町の新たな観光スポットとして注目を集めています。さらに、8月中旬にはくぐの納涼夏まつりが開催され尺玉が夜空を飾り、山々に轟音を響かせる必見のイベントになっています。久々野町に是非お越しください。（高山市街地から車で約３０分）

title: ReVIEW! #Hida Takayama Kuguno Town
description: Junichi Kiriyama, CEO of MGN Co., Ltd., will introduce the charms of the town. Kuguno Town is located in the southern part of Takayama City and is an area with beautiful natural scenery. This town is famous for its fruit and vegetable production, and is even called the 'Hida Peach Source Village.' In spring, the fruit flowers bloom, creating a dream-like landscape. Particularly famous are 'Hida apples,' 'Hida peaches,' 'Hida pears,' and 'Hida melons.' In particular, the 'Apple Pie' made with Hida apples is extremely popular and sells out as soon as it goes on sale. It has grown to become one of Kuguno Town's most famous products. Additionally, a sunflower garden opens every August on the site of the former Alcopia Ski Resort. Approximately 200,000 sunflowers are in full bloom, attracting attention as a new tourist spot in Kuguno Town. Furthermore, in mid-August, the Kugu Summer Summer Festival is held, where shakudama floats decorate the night sky and their roars echo through the mountains, making it a must-see event. Please come to Kuguno Town. (About 30 minutes by car from downtown Takayama)

title: 標高1,529ｍ、宮川と飛騨川の分水嶺の山「位山」。霊山として崇められています。樹木や植物が生い茂り、自然との出会いも楽しみのひとつ。登山道を歩くと多くの巨石群が現れ神秘的な雰囲気。#飛騨高山
Mount Iiyama, a watershed between the Miyagawa and Hida rivers, with an elevation of 1,529 m. It is revered as a sacred mountain.
description: The mountain is covered with trees and plants, and encountering nature is one of the pleasures. Walking the hiking trail reveals many giant rock formations, creating a mystical atmosphere.

description: Takayama, the city with the largest area in Japan, is filled with many attractions throughout the town. Surrounded by the Hida Mountains (Northern Alps), this area boasts rich nature and beautiful scenery that changes with the seasons, offering a variety of charms. Experience the emotions that can only be felt here.

title: Welcome to Hida Takayama
description: 日本一面積が広い市である高山市は、町のすみずみまでたくさんの見どころに溢れています。飛騨山脈(北アルプス)に抱かれ、豊かな自然と四季折々の美しい景色に癒される、多彩な魅力を持つエリアです。ここでしか味わえない感動体験をあなたに。

title: 高山駅から車で約20分の場所にある「久々野公民館」。明治から平成に作られたおひな様や土雛、江戸時代から伝わる貴重なものが展示されています。飾らなくなったおひな様を集め今では1600体以上！#飛騨高山
description: 明治から平成に作られたおひな様や土雛、江戸時代から伝わる貴重なものが展示されています。飾らなくなったおひな様を集め今では1600体以上！

title: #飛騨高山 自然と歴史が調和する町　#一之宮
description: Experience the blessings of nature and the food of the mountain village, and enjoy the Gajyuu cherry blossoms and doburoku.

title: Hida Takayama: A Town Where Nature and History Harmonize - Ichinomiya
description: Ichinomiya Town, where you can experience rural life and interact with local people through active 'Green Tourism'. You can enjoy the blessings of nature and the food of the mountain village by viewing the Gajyuu cherry blossoms and hiking Mt. Wiyama, where you can see the watershed. It's also a nice point that you can taste the doburoku made in this town at inns and restaurants in the area, as it is recognized as a 'doburoku special zone' by the Cabinet Office. In winter, the Mondeus Park offers a stage for winter sports with its snowy slopes.

title: 合掌造りをはじめとした飛騨の古い貴重な民家が復元され、農山村の暮らしを知ることができる「#飛騨の里」。こちらでは、市民の方が寄付をされた1000体以上の土びなを鑑賞することができます。#飛騨高山
