It tells the story of a grandchild tired of urban life during the COVID-19 pandemic and a grandmother eagerly waiting for the day she can meet her grandchild. The title conveys the feelings of longing to meet (Aite) between the two, who are separated by the countryside (Inaka) and the city (Tokai), and how they are connected through smartphones (IT) and SNS. The judging session held on November 2, 2021, awarded it 3rd place among the works from all 30 municipalities. Please take a look.

title: 羽州街道を往く～歩いて発見！秋田市・歴史文化遺産～
description: 現在の福島県の桑折から、宮城県を経て山形県、秋田県を北上し、青森県の油川に至る羽州街道は、江戸時代、多くの人やものが行き交う大動脈でした。秋田市の羽州街道の沿線には、文化財に指定されている古い建物や文化施設などが点在しており、今もその名残を感じとることができます。また、秋田藩士・荻津勝孝の筆と伝えられる「秋田街道絵巻」には、往時の街道の風景や人々の様子が活き活きと描かれています。このたび、秋田市では、そうした魅力を歴史ストーリーで結び、“秋田市ならでは”の街道歩きをお楽しみいただけるように、ＰＲ映像を制作しました。様々な角度から、羽州街道の魅力をたっぷりとご紹介いたします。

title: Traveling the Ushu Highway - Discovering Akita City’s Historical and Cultural Heritage on Foot
description: The Ushu Highway, which runs from present-day Koori in Fukushima Prefecture, through Miyagi Prefecture, Yamagata Prefecture, and Akita Prefecture, and reaches Aburakawa in Aomori Prefecture, was a major artery during the Edo period, bustling with people and goods. Along the Ushu Highway in Akita City, there are many old buildings and cultural facilities designated as cultural properties, where you can still feel the remnants of the past. Additionally, the 'Akita Kaido Emaki,' attributed to Akita samurai Katsutaka Ogitsu, vividly depicts the scenery and people of the highway in those times. This time, Akita City has produced a PR video to connect these attractions with historical stories, allowing you to enjoy a unique walking experience along the highway. We will introduce the charm of the Ushu Highway from various angles.

description:
★日本国際映像祭2025オフィシャルコレクション作品

「時を旅する」筏。
かつて林業として栄えた筏（いかだ）流しの文化は、時代とともにカタチを少し変えて現在も同じ北山川の風景の中を筏師の櫂さばきひとつで下っていく。
夏のあいだ丸太筏に乗って急流を下る体験アクティビティとしての筏下りに、この小さな村に世界中から珍しい体験を求める旅行者が訪れる。
　筏師は昔ながらのエンジンも使わない筏で川筋を読み櫂を漕ぎ、また自然の地形を利用して筏を前へと進ませる。
北山川の夏の風物詩となった観光筏下りは、林業から観光へと産業転換をし現在も昔と変わらぬ風景をみせてくれ、まるでタイムマシーンに乗ったかのう様なかつての日本の現風景を見せてくれる。

title: Official Collection Work of the Japan International Film Festival 2025: Traveling Through Time on the Kitayama River Raft
description: Official Collection Work of the Japan International Film Festival 2025: A raft that travels through time. The culture of rafting, which once thrived as a forestry industry, has slightly changed its form over time and continues to flow through the same scenery of the Kitayama River, guided by the skillful strokes of the raft master. During the summer, tourists from around the world visit this small village seeking the unique experience of rafting down the rapids on a log raft. The raft master uses no engines, reading the river's flow and paddling, while also utilizing the natural terrain to propel the raft forward. The tourist rafting on the Kitayama River, which has become a summer tradition, has transformed from forestry to tourism, showcasing a landscape that remains unchanged from the past, almost like a time machine revealing the current scenery of Japan as it once was.

水しぶき、壮大な北山峡谷の岩壁、そして経験豊富な筏師が伝統技術で木筏を操る迫力のシーンを体感してください！

没入型VRを通じて、日本唯一の原木木筏漂流──北山川観光木筏漂流を体験し、まるで筏に乗って激流を駆け抜けているかのような感覚を味わえます。

この貴重な北山村の木筏文化は国内外で高く評価されており、壮大な吉野熊野国立公園の自然景観と結びついて、皆様を一緒に鑑賞し体験することをお誘いします。

📅 営業期間：5月3日～9月30日
#北山川木筏漂流 #北山村 #伝統木筏

title: 【360°VR 全方位視点】Kita-Yama River Sightseeing Rafting
description:
The age restriction for HMD viewing is 10 years and older. You can also view it from a regular screen with a 360-degree perspective.

Experience the splashing water, the magnificent cliffs of the Kita-Yama Gorge, and the stunning scenes of experienced rafters operating the wooden rafts using traditional techniques!

Through immersive VR, experience Japan's only log rafting - Kita-Yama River Sightseeing Rafting, as if you are personally riding on the raft rushing through the rapids.

This precious Kita-Yama village rafting culture is highly regarded both domestically and internationally, combined with the magnificent natural scenery of Yoshino Kumano National Park, inviting you to appreciate and experience it together.

📅 Operating period: May 3rd to September 30th
#KitaYamaRiverRafting #KitaYamaVillage #TraditionalRafting

title: 【360°VR 全方位檢視】北山村VR影片
description: 【HMD視聴年齢制限：10歳以上】一般的な画面を使用しても360度の視点で視聴できます。紀伊半島の深山に位置する北山村は、日本唯一の飛び地村で、小さくても驚きに満ちた隠れた秘境です。ここでは、刺激的な北山川観光木筏漂流を体験し、伝統的な原木筏で流れ下ることができます。また、北山村は珍しい柑橘「じゃばら」（邪払）の原産地で、世間から隔絶された壮大な自然景観を持っています。没入型VRを通じて、日本の山間の静けさの美しさに浸り、大自然に優しく癒される瞬間を感じてください。

title: 【360°VR全方位視】北山村VR影片
description: The North Mountain Village, located in the deep mountains of the Kii Peninsula, is Japan's only exclave village, a small yet surprising hidden gem. Here, you can experience the thrilling North Mountain River sightseeing rafting, riding a traditional log raft downstream. Additionally, North Mountain Village is the birthplace of the rare citrus fruit 'Jabara' (邪払) and boasts magnificent natural scenery that is isolated from the world. Through immersive VR, let yourself indulge in the tranquil beauty of Japan's mountains and feel the gentle healing of nature on your soul.

title: 北山川観光筏下り
description: 日本で唯一、丸太を組んだ筏で川下りが楽しめるのは、和歌山県北山村だけ！🌊🍃 主に付加体の地層からなる大地の急激な隆起と北山川の下方浸食により、標高差600mに及ぶV字状の大峡谷が形成されました。この地域の付加体は、ジオパーク地域内で最も古い竜神付加体で、7000万年前に堆積した地層です。この壮大な景色を、北山川観光筏下りで直接体験することができます！ 筏師が手作りした全長約30mの筏に乗り、600年も続いた筏師の技術を引き継ぐ伝統的な川下りが楽しめます！ 特に入り組んだ岩肌と激しい流れが織り成す壮大な景色を堪能しながら、筏師の熟練の技術による水上アクティビティを体験できます！ 全国でここだけの体験をしてみませんか‼️ 実施期間: 5月土・日・祝日　6月土・日 7・8・9月は木曜を除く毎日（木曜が祝日の場合は運航） 所要時間 2時間（筏乗船時間約1時間10分） 対象年齢 満10～満75才までの健康・健脚な方

title: Kitayama River Sightseeing Rafting
description: The only place in Japan where you can enjoy rafting on a raft made of logs is Kitayama Village in Wakayama Prefecture! 🌊🍃 The rapid uplift of the land mainly composed of accretionary complex strata and the downward erosion of the Kitayama River have formed a V-shaped gorge with an elevation difference of 600m. The accretionary complex in this area is the oldest Ryujin accretionary complex within the geopark, with strata deposited 70 million years ago. You can directly experience this magnificent scenery through Kitayama River sightseeing rafting! You can enjoy traditional rafting that inherits the techniques of raft masters that have continued for 600 years on a handmade raft about 30m long! While enjoying the magnificent scenery created by the intricate rock faces and fierce currents, you can experience water activities through the skilled techniques of the raft masters! Why not try this unique experience available only here nationwide‼️ Implementation period: Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays in May, Saturdays and Sundays in June, and every day except Thursdays in July, August, and September (operating on Thursdays if it is a holiday). Duration: 2 hours (about 1 hour and 10 minutes of rafting time). Target age: Healthy and fit individuals aged 10 to 75.

description: 伊勢湾最大の離島である答志島。島内には３軒の温泉宿があり、九鬼水軍を率いた九鬼嘉隆の首塚や胴塚、太平洋の絶景を楽しめる希望の丘などの散策スポットが多く点在。２～4月頃にはこの島の風物詩となっている和具浦漁港での塩ワカメ作りの風景が楽しめます。また、答志島と菅島で水揚げされる一本釣りの鰆（さわら）のうち、秋と冬に獲れた脂肪分の高いものが「答志島トロさわら」とブランド化されています。

title: Toba Onsen District - Doshi Island Area
description: Doshi Island, the largest remote island in Ise Bay, has three hot spring inns. There are many sightseeing spots, including the tomb of Kuki Yoshitaka, who led the Kuki navy, and Kibo Hill, where you can enjoy the spectacular view of the Pacific Ocean. From February to April, you can enjoy the scenery of salt wakame making at Waguura Fishing Port, which has become a local tradition. Additionally, the high-fat 'Doshi Island Toro Sawara' is branded from the saury caught by pole-and-line fishing in Doshi Island and Sugashima during autumn and winter.

title: 鳥羽温泉郷　相差エリア
description: 三重県の伊勢志摩国立公園に位置する鳥羽市。このうち太平洋に面した相差（おうさつ）エリアは、南鳥羽では最も人口が集まった海女と漁師の港町で、１７の温泉宿があります。ここでは、現役海女さんの話を聞きながら、新鮮な魚貝類が食べられる海女小屋体験や、「女性の願い事なら必ず一つは叶えてくれる」という神明神社の参道にある石神さんなどの人気スポットが楽しめます。

title: Toba Onsen District, Osatsu Area
description: Located in the Ise-Shima National Park in Mie Prefecture, Toba City. The Osatsu area, facing the Pacific Ocean, is a port town with the largest population of ama (female divers) and fishermen in southern Toba, featuring 17 hot spring inns. Here, you can enjoy experiences such as listening to stories from active ama divers and tasting fresh seafood at ama huts, as well as popular spots like Ishigami-san on the approach to Shinmei Shrine, which is said to grant at least one wish for women.

title: こんな田舎なのに魅力たっぷりえびの市。知らなかった人損してますよ。
description: こんにちは！宮崎県えびの市観光商工課ＰＲ担当のみなほです。皆さんえびの市を知っていますか？ポテンシャルは高いのに中々知名度が上がらないこの町。観光地や綺麗な景色、特産品もあるのに知ってもらえないこの町。そんなポテンシャル満載の魅力たっぷりなこの町をもっと色んな人に知ってもらいたい、従来の情報発信だけでは伝わらないこのご時世。そこで、みなほ、動画配信始めます。新型コロナウイルス感染症によりアウトドア人気が高まった時、えびの高原にある「えびの高原キャンプ村」が大盛り上がりしたのは地元の人しか知らない…。今回の動画で紹介するえびの高原はキャンプやトレッキングするには最適の場所。えびの高原の四季折々の景色に囲まれて体験するアウトドアアクティビティは非日常感にあふれていて、仕事や私生活のストレスを発散するには最高のデトックス効果抜群の場所です！この動画を見て少しでも魅力を感じたそこのあなた！えびの市は皆さんを迎える準備はいつでも出来ていますよ！是非、えびの市へおじゃったもんせ（お越しください）~！

description: Hello! I am Minaho, the PR representative of the Ebino City Tourism and Commerce Division in Miyazaki Prefecture. Do you know about Ebino City? This town has high potential but its recognition is not increasing. There are tourist spots, beautiful scenery, and local specialties, yet this town remains unknown. I want more people to know about this town full of potential and charm, especially in this day and age where traditional information dissemination is not enough. Therefore, I, Minaho, will start video distribution. When the popularity of outdoor activities increased due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the 'Ebino Kogen Camp Village' in Ebino Kogen became very popular, but only the locals know about it... The Ebino Kogen introduced in this video is the perfect place for camping and trekking. Surrounded by the seasonal scenery of Ebino Kogen, the outdoor activities you experience here are filled with a sense of the extraordinary, making it the best place for detoxing from work and personal life stress! If you feel even a little charm from this video, you there! Ebino City is always ready to welcome you! Please come to Ebino City~!

title: 飛騨高山グルメ3傑
description: 岐阜の小京都と言われる飛騨高山の隠れた名店3傑をご紹介致します。まずは「TEPPAN たなか」 目の前で焼き上げるＡ５等級のみの飛騨牛ステーキは、五感を通して味わえる最高のご馳走です。次にご紹介するのは緑に囲まれ静かで自然豊かな隠れ家、「オーベルジュ飛騨の森」季節の厳選食材をふんだんに使用したシェフ自慢のイタリアンと自然派ワインをご堪能ください。最後に「ゲストハウス&カフェSOY」築100年を超える古民家を再生し創られたゲストハウスです。日本古来の醤油・味噌・納豆・豆腐・・・全てのもとは「大豆」からとのコンセプトの基、地元の素材を活かした発酵食品をベースにした料理は素朴な味わいが特徴です。飛騨高山に行ったらこ３店舗に足をお運びください！

title: Hida Takayama Gourmet Three Best
description: Introducing 3 hidden stores in Hida Takayama, which is said to be the Little Kyoto of Gifu. First of all, 'TEPPAN Tanaka'. Hida beef steak with only A5 grade baked right in front of you is the best treat you can enjoy through your five senses. Next, we would like to introduce you to the quiet and natural hideaway surrounded by greenery, 'Auberge Hidano no Mori'. Enjoy the chef's pride of Italian and natural wines using carefully selected seasonal ingredients. Finally, 'Guesthouse & Cafe SOY' is a guesthouse created by recreating an old folk house that was over 100 years old. Traditional Japanese soy sauce, miso, natto, tofu ... All of them are based on the concept of 'soybeans' and are characterized by a simple taste based on fermented foods that make use of local ingredients. description: 広島県庄原市、熊野神社。旧比婆大社。創建年は不詳。比婆山山麓に位置するこの場所は日本最古とされる歴史書『古事記』の伝承を現代に伝える場所です。神々の母伊邪那美命(イザナミノミコト)は、立烏帽子山に伊邪那岐(イザナギノミコト)が訪ねてきた際、夜になったので自分の櫛に火をつけて灯りとして、この山道を歩き、天から火の雨が降り注いだ際に途中の岩穴に身を隠し難を逃れたという逸話が残されています。また、後に火の神を産んだ伊邪那美は、この道の岩穴で亡くなり、黄泉の国に旅立ったとも伝えられています。

title: KUMANO Shrine 伊邪那美(イザナミ)の道
description: Kumano Shrine, Shobara City, Hiroshima Prefecture. Former Hiba Ohyashiro Shrine. The year of foundation is unknown. Located at the foot of Mt. Hiba, this place is a place to convey the tradition of Japan's history book said that oldest history book 'Kojiki' to the present day. The mother of the gods, Izanami Nomikoto When Izanagi Nomikoto visited her, Mt. Tateeboshi, It's night, so she lit her comb and used it as a light. There is an anecdote that she hid herself in a rock hole on the way and escaped the difficulty when it rained on fire from the sky. It is also reported that Izanami, who later gave birth to the god of fire, died in a rock hole on this road, and she left for heaven.

title: 出雲大社 - IZUMO NO OHYASHIRO
description: Izumo Taishaは島根県出雲市大社町杵築東にある神社です。日本最古の神社の一つで、主祭神である大国主大神は日本国創造の神様とされています。旧暦の十月には八百万の神がこの地に集まり、神議が行われると言い伝えられています。

title: Izumo Taisha - 出雲大社
description: Izumo Taisha is a shrine located in Kizukihigashi, Taisha-cho, Izumo City, Shimane Prefecture. One of the oldest shrines in Japan, Okuninushi no Okami, the main deity, is considered to be the god who created Japan. It has been said that in October of the lunar calendar, eight million gods will gather here and hold a deity meeting.

title: 山陰海岸 - Sanin(mountain’s yin) Coast
description: 日本の中国地方では古くから中国山地の北を山陰、南を山陽と呼んできました。地名をつけるとき、山の北と南を陰と陽、川の北と南を陽と陰で表現することは古代中国の考えに基づいています。これは、南天に太陽が昇る北半球では、山の北が影になり、南が太陽に当たるからです。川の場合、洛陽（洛水と呼ばれる川の北の地域）と淮陰（淮水と呼ばれる川の南）のように川の北と南で陰陽と表現する土地が中国にあります。川の場合では、南から指した光が川面に跳ね返り、川の北を照らし、南の物体が川面に影を落とすことから、そう呼ばれるようになりました。中国山地を挟んで北側の山陰地方の海岸は日本海に面しています。大陸から吹く風により発生する日本海の荒波により形成された山陰の海岸の風光明媚な景観をお楽しみ下さい。

title: Sanin海岸 - 山陰海岸
description: In the Chugoku region of Japan, the north of the Chugoku Mountains has been called Sanin(mountain’s yin) and the south has been called Sanyo(mountain’s yang) for a long time. When naming a place, it is based on the idea of ancient China that the north and south of the mountain are represented by yin and yang, and the north and south of the river are represented by yang and yin. This is because in the northern hemisphere, where the sun rises in the southern sky, the north of the mountain is in the shadow and the south is in the sun. In the case of rivers, there are lands in China that are described as Yinyang in the north and south of the river, such as Rakuyo (the area north of the river called Luoyang) and Huaiyin (south of the river called Huai’an). In the case of rivers, the light from the south bounces off the surface of the river, illuminating the north of the river, and objects in the south cast shadows on the surface of the river. The coast of the San'in(mountain’s yin) region on the north side of the Chugoku Mountains faces the Sea of Japan. Enjoy the scenic landscape of the San'in coast formed by the rough waves of the Sea of Japan generated by the wind blowing from the continent.

title: 元乃隅稲成神社 MOTONOSUMI INARI - Shrine
description: 1955年に地元の網元であった岡村 斉(おかむら ひとし)さんの枕元に狐が現れ、『私をこの地に鎮祭せよ』と告げました。以来、元乃隅神社では狐を神使として祀り、1987年から10年間に渡って奉納された延べ123基の鳥居が海岸線に沿って並ぶ光景は圧巻です。

title: MOTONOSUMI INARI - Shrine
description: In 1955, a fox appeared at the bedside of Mr. Hitoshi Okamura, who was a local Amimoto, and said, "Put me down here." Since then, Motonosumi Shrine has enshrined a fox as a priest, and the sight of a total of 123 torii gates dedicated for 10 years from 1987 lined up along the coastline is spectacular.

title: 島根県 石見國 一宮 物部神社 - Ichinomiya Iwami Province Mononobe - Shrine
description: The deity enshrined is Umashimaji no Mikoto, the founder of the ancient powerful family Mononobe. Umashimaji no Mikoto is a child of Nigihayahi no Mikoto, and it is said that during the eastern expedition of Emperor Jimmu, he defeated Nagasunehiko and later led the Mononobe clan to protect the imperial castle. It has a history of more than 1500 years since its foundation, and the main shrine is the second largest shrine after Izumo Taisha. The shrine crest 'Hioi Crane' is a sacred crest based on the fact that Umashimaji no Mikoto descended on a crane, and is said to be the only shrine crest in Japan.

title: Ichinomiya Iwami Province Mononobe - Shrine
description: 御祭神は古代豪族 物部氏 初代宇摩志麻遅命(うましまじのみこと)。宇摩志麻遅命は邇芸速日命(にぎはやひのみこと)の子にあたられ、神武天皇の東征の際、長髄彦(ながすねひこ)を討ち、後に物部氏を率いて皇城守護の任に就いたとされています。創建から数えて1500年以上の歴史があり、ご本殿は出雲大社に次ぐ二番目の大きさで、春日造りの巨大神殿となっています。御神紋『ひおい鶴』は宇摩志麻遅命が鶴に乗って降臨されたという故事に基づいた御神紋で、日本唯一の御神紋と言われています。

title: 長浜神社 Nagahama - Shrine〜出雲の国の始まりを記した国引き神話の主役を祀る神社〜
description: The enshrined deity is Yatsukamizuomitsunu no Mikoto. A long time ago, Yatsukamizuomitsunu no Mikoto thought, 'Izumo Province is like a long strip of cloth; I made the country too small at first. So let's make it bigger.' After completing the land dragging four times at Kiduki's cape, Sada's country, Kurami's country, and Miho's cape, Yatsukamizuomitsunu no Mikoto was enshrined in Nagahama as the god of land dragging, the general guardian of Izumo Province, who had completed the creation of the land. Due to the story of the Kunibiki myth, Yatsukamizuomitsunu no Mikoto is widely worshiped as a great god who attracted the country, attracted people, and attracted happiness, and a god who attracted victory.

Please enjoy the scenery of the Geiyo Islands, which is a representative island group of Setouchi, and the beautiful appearance of Yoso Island in early summer.

Please enjoy the beauty of scattered islands in Setouchi and magnificent view of Shimanami Kaido in VR.

title: 東京 赤坂 氷川神社 - TOKYO AKASAKA HIKAWA Shrine
description: 鎮座から千年を数える赤坂氷川神社。御祭神は素戔嗚尊(スサノオノミコト)、奇稲田姫命(クシナダヒメノミコト)、大国主命(オオクニヌシノミコト)。かつて、奇稲田姫命は八岐大蛇(ヤマタノオロチ)の生贄になっていたところを素戔嗚尊によって助け出され、後に素戔嗚尊の妻となりました。大国主命は、お二人の御子孫にあたられ、国造の神様として出雲大社の主祭神でもあられます。ヤマタノオロチ退治の舞台となった出雲国の簸川(ひかわ)が由来とされ、951年に東国遊行中だった蓮林僧正が現在の赤坂4丁目で一夜を過ごした際に夢中でお告げを受け、この地にお祀りしたしことに始まります。その後、江戸幕府第八代将軍、徳川吉宗によって建立された御社殿はかつての震災、戦災を免れ、鳥居、狛犬、灯籠に建立当時の面影を現在に伝えます。

title: Tokyo Akasaka Hikawa Shrine - 東京 赤坂 氷川神社
description: Akasaka Hikawa Shrine, which counts a thousand years since its enshrined. Deity: Susano-no-mikoto, Kushinadahime-no-mikoto, Okuninushi-no-mikoto. In the past, Kushinadahime-no-mikoto was rescued by Susano-no-mikoto from the sacrifice of Yamata-no-Orochi, and later became the wife of Susano-no-mikoto. Okuninushi is the descendant of couple, and is also the main deity of Izumo Taisha as a national creation god. It is said to have originated from Hikawa in Izumo Province, which was the stage for exterminating Yamata-no-Orochi. It begins when a monk who was traveling to Togoku in 951, in his dream, responded to the announcement from the deity when he spent the night at the present Akasaka 4th street and worshiped here. After that, the shrine built by Yoshimune Tokugawa, the eighth shogun of the Edo Shogunate, escaped the former earthquake and war damage, and conveys the remnants of the time when it was built to the torii gate, guardian dog, and lantern.

title: 琵琶湖畔の突端に佇む寺院 伊崎寺　Isakiji, a temple standing at the tip of Lake Biwa
description: Isakijiは滋賀県の近江八幡市の琵琶湖の湖畔に聳え立つ天台宗の修験の三大聖地とされる寺院です。比叡山延暦寺の支院でもあるこの寺院では、毎年8月に伊崎の棹飛と呼ばれる行事が行われています。行者が琵琶湖の絶壁から突き出した長さ13mに及ぶ棹から7m下の水面に飛び込む千年以上の歴史ある伝統行事です。初秋の近江八幡に琵琶湖の美しい景観と伊崎寺の荘厳な世界がありました。

title: Isakiji, a temple standing at the tip of Lake Biwa
description: Isakiji is a temple that stands on the shores of Lake Biwa in Omihachiman City, Shiga Prefecture, and is considered to be one of the three major sanctuaries of the Tendai sect. At this temple, which is also a branch of Hieizan Enryakuji Temple, an event called Saotobi of Isaki is held every August. It is a traditional event with a history of more than 1000 years, in which the performer jumps into the water surface 7 m below the 13 m long rod protruding from the cliff of Lake Biwa. In early autumn, Omihachiman had a beautiful landscape of Lake Biwa and the majestic world of Isakiji Temple.

title: 【山形県金山町】2018山形ふるさとCM大賞「スギタ家の朝」
description: Yamagata Television Co., Ltd. (YTS)主催の「第19回山形ふるさとCM大賞」提出作品。金山町としては初の「優秀賞」を受賞しました。

title: Yamagata Kaneyama Town 2018 Yamagata Hometown CM Award 'Sugita Family's Morning'
description: This is a submission for the 19th Yamagata Hometown CM Award organized by Yamagata Television (YTS). It won the 'Excellence Award' for the first time for Kaneyama Town.

title: 山形ふるさとCM大賞2024　山形県金山町
description: 株式会社山形テレビ（ＹＴＳ）が主催する「第24回山形ふるさとＣＭ大賞」において、金山町が「特別賞」（プレゼン賞）を受賞しました。今年度は金山町町制施行１００周年をテーマに金山町の魅力を集めたPRCMを制作しました。今年度の作品は「金山らしさが表現されていたこと」や「佐藤町長のプレゼンと登壇者のチームワーク」が高く評価され、受賞に至りました。応援してくださった皆様、誠にありがとうございました。

title: Yamagata Furusato CM Award 2024 - Kaneyama Town, Yamagata Prefecture
description: The 24th Yamagata Furusato CM Award, organized by Yamagata Television (YTS), awarded Kaneyama Town the 'Special Award' (Presentation Award). This year, a PRCM was produced focusing on the charm of Kaneyama Town, themed around the 100th anniversary of the town's establishment. The work was highly praised for 'expressing the uniqueness of Kaneyama' and 'the teamwork of Mayor Sato's presentation and the presenters,' leading to the award. Thank you to everyone who supported us.

title: 山形ふるさとCM大賞2025　山形県金山町
description: On December 10th, the 25th Yamagata Furusato CM Award was broadcasted on Yamagata Television, showcasing the unique CM works from various cities and towns. This year's work from Kaneyama Town features students from Kaneyama Junior High School, who handled the sound recording and narration, expressing the charm of Kaneyama Town with the theme of 'The Sounds of Kaneyama'. Thank you very much to everyone who supported us.

title: Yamagata Furusato CM Award 2025 - Kaneyama Town, Yamagata Prefecture
description: 12月10日、山形テレビで「第2５回山形ふるさとCM大賞」が放送され、各市町村の個性あふれるCM作品が紹介されました。今年の金山町の作品は金山中学校の生徒が「金山の音」をテーマに収音やナレーションを担当し、金山町の魅力を表現した作品となっています。応援してくださった皆様、誠にありがとうございました。

title: 飛騨の里 保護猫センター 「にゃんLiving」 五十嵐 浩子　Interview
description: 飛騨の里で動物愛護活動をしている人の負担を減らす仕組み作りが必要だと感じそんな想いで創った「にゃんliving」。代表の五十嵐 浩子の活動を取材してみました。

title: Hida no Sato Cat Protection Center 'Nyan Living' Interview with Hiroko Igarashi
description: I felt the need to create a system to reduce the burden on those engaged in animal welfare activities in Hida no Sato, and with that thought, I created 'Nyan Living'. I interviewed Hiroko Igarashi, the representative of the cat protection center.

title: 岡山県北　森の芸術　～The Forest Of The Arts Northrn OKAYAMA～
description: 2024年9月28日～11月24日に開催された「森の芸術祭・岡山」。イベント終了後も一部のアート作品が常設展示され、訪れる人々を魅了し続けています。この動画では、アート作品とその周辺の観光スポットをご紹介。芸術と自然が織りなす特別な空間で、岡山の新たな魅力を発見してみませんか？

title: The Forest Of The Arts Northrn OKAYAMA
description: The 'Forest of the Arts Festival - Okayama' will be held from September 28 to November 24, 2024. Even after the event ends, some art pieces will be permanently displayed, continuing to captivate visitors. This video introduces the art pieces and surrounding tourist spots. Why not discover Okayama's new charm in this special space where art and nature intertwine?

title: おかやまうつくしのひと時へ。岡山後楽園＆岡山城
description: ※This video was produced in 2021 and is published on YouTube as an archive.

title: A Beautiful Moment in Okayama: Okayama Korakuen & Okayama Castle
description: Okayama Korakuen is a large garden built by the second lord of the Okayama domain, Ikeda Tsunamasa, as a place of relaxation. The spacious garden, adorned with seasonal flowers, is like a different world reminiscent of the Edo period. In 1952, it was designated as a 'Special Scenic Spot' as a historical cultural heritage and received a three-star rating in the Michelin Green Guide Japan.

title: おかやま日本遺産探訪7つのストーリーを巡る旅【full ver.】
description: 岡山県内の7つの日本遺産にまつわる地を、魅力的な動画でご案内。時空を超え、今に息づく古のストーリーを疑似体感しながら、その物語に秘められた地域の歴史や文化に想いを馳せてみませんか？

title: おかやま日本遺産探訪7つのストーリーを巡る旅【full ver.】
description: This video guides you through seven sites related to Japan's heritage in Okayama Prefecture. Experience the ancient stories that transcend time and reflect on the history and culture hidden within these narratives.

title: ココロに響く、岡山アートトリップ【full ver.】
description: 岡山県北・奈義町は、今注目のアートエリア。体感型現代美術館の先駈け「NagiMOCA」はもちろん、秀峰・那岐山をはじめ、自然が生み出す景観そのものがアート。大自然の中で心を解放して向き合えば、五感を刺激する出会いがそこに。さぁ、次の旅は岡山へ。

title: 響く心、岡山アートトリップ【フルバージョン】
description: Okayama Prefecture's Nagi Town is an emerging art area. Not only is it home to the pioneering experiential contemporary art museum 'NagiMOCA', but the stunning scenery created by nature, including the majestic Mt. Nagi, is art in itself. When you free your mind in the great outdoors, you'll encounter experiences that stimulate your senses. So, let’s make your next trip to Okayama.

title: 岡山で日本刀の聖地を訪ね、匠の技に触れる旅【short ver.】
description: Okayama Prefecture's Setouchi City Nagashima Town, which has flourished as a production area for Japanese swords since the Kamakura period. We will visit a rare sword museum in this town. The magnificent yet delicate skills of the craftsmen, temples related to swords, and local flavors. The deeper you know, the more profound it becomes, a day exploring Bizen Nagashima. Now, the next trip is to Okayama.

title: Visit the Sacred Place of Japanese Swords in Okayama and Experience the Artisan's Craft【short ver.】
description: Setouchi City Nagashima Town in Okayama Prefecture, which has flourished as a production area for Japanese swords since the Kamakura period. We will visit a rare sword museum in this town. The magnificent yet delicate skills of the craftsmen, temples related to swords, and local flavors. The deeper you know, the more profound it becomes, a day exploring Bizen Nagashima. Now, the next trip is to Okayama.

title: 岡山の旅なら叶う！ 贅沢＆美味な果物時間【full ver.】
description: 晴れの国岡山はおいしい国でもあるんです。なかでも白桃やぶどうは全国屈指の生産量。旬を迎える夏から秋にかけては“くだもの王国”の本領発揮！ 果樹農園で収穫体験ができたり、街のお店で絶品フルーツメニューに出会えたりと、贅沢＆美味な時間が待っています。さぁ、次の旅は岡山へ。

title: Okayama's Journey: Luxurious and Delicious Fruit Time【full ver.】
description: Okayama, the land of sunshine, is also a land of deliciousness. Among them, white peaches and grapes boast some of the highest production in the country. From summer to autumn, when they are in season, the true essence of the 'fruit kingdom' is on full display! You can experience fruit picking at orchards and encounter exquisite fruit menus at local shops, promising a luxurious and delicious time. So, let’s make your next trip to Okayama.

title: 【岡山後楽園・岡山城】フォトコンテスト入賞作品を動画で紹介！
description: This is a video created from the award-winning works of the 'My Best Okayama Korakuen and Okayama Castle Photo Contest' held in the autumn of 2021 to promote the charm of 'Okayama Korakuen', one of Japan's three famous gardens, and the brave castle 'Okayama Castle'. Please enjoy the best shots of the captivating scenery throughout the four seasons. You can see various landscapes, including the nighttime light-up events 'Fantasy Garden' and 'Ujo Togenkyo'. Currently, Okayama Castle is closed for large-scale renovation work, but it is scheduled to reopen on November 3 this year. We look forward to the renewed Okayama Castle!

title: 2泊3日で周遊！岡山を味わい尽くす女子二人旅
description: みなさんは、岡山県の魅力をどのくらい知っているでしょうか。古き良き街並みを堪能できる「倉敷」を思い出す人が多いのでは？　でもそれだけじゃないんです！大自然と広大な高原で気分をリフレッシュできる「蒜山（ひるぜん）高原」や歴史ある温泉街「湯原温泉」、恋人たちの聖地と言われる「黒島ヴィーナスロード」などなど…挙げたらキリのない岡山県の魅力の数々を、2泊3日で味わい尽くす女子二人旅にまとめました！

title: 2泊3日で周遊！岡山を味わい尽くす女子二人旅
description: How much do you know about the charm of Okayama Prefecture? Many people might recall the beautiful streets of Kurashiki. But that's not all! You can refresh your mind in the vast highlands of Hiruzan, enjoy the historic hot spring town of Yubara Onsen, and visit the 'Venus Road' of Kuroshima, known as a sacred place for lovers. This is a summary of the countless attractions of Okayama Prefecture, all experienced in a 2-night, 3-day girls' trip!

title: 【Cinematic Vlog:日本遺産】『ジャパンレッド』発祥の地:吹屋ふるさと村（岡山県高梁市）
description: ベンガラ色で統一されたノスタルジックな風景。中国山地の山懐に抱かれた吹屋は、ベンガラ生産やその原料であるローハで巨大な富を築いた豪商たちが作り上げた町。赤銅色の石州瓦とベンガラ色の外観で統一された赤い町並みが印象的です。精巧な意匠が施された豪商たちの屋敷は一見の価値あり。岡山県「ふるさと村」にも指定されています。ベンガラの絵の具を使ってハンカチやバッグを作る体験プランも人気です。

title: Cinematic Vlog: Japan Heritage - The Birthplace of Japan Red: Fukiya Furusato Village (Okayama Prefecture, Takahashi City)
description: The town was developed by merchants who prospered through the manufacture and sale of Bengara color pigment and its ingredient, melanterite, from the end of the Edo Period and into the Meiji Period. The town's buildings are an impressive sight with their Bengara red with reddish-brown Sekishu rooftiles. When you visit, try your hand at making a handkerchief or a bag using Bengara pigment.

title: 【吹屋ふるさと村】歩きたくなる紅色のまち！弁柄と銅の町・備中吹屋でベンガラ染体験！:日本遺産（岡山県高梁市）
description:
一度は行きたい！ベンガラ色の町並み「吹屋」を大満喫する方法
高梁市の山の中に突如現れる赤い町並み「吹屋」。江戸時代、赤の顔料「ベンガラ」の産地として栄えた独特の歴史があります。町並みを見るだけ・歩くだけでも楽しいのですが、歴史を知ると当時の様子がありありとわかり、町が輝いて見えます。ベンガラ窯元の邸宅、ベンガラ工場跡、銅山の坑道跡、豪邸「広兼邸」を巡りながら、町並み散策、そして「べんがら型染め体験」。このルートで巡れば、魅惑の吹屋を大満喫できること間違いなし！

title: Bengara-dyed Experience in the Red Town of Bichu Fukiya: A Japanese Heritage Site (Takahashi City, Okayama Prefecture)
description: A must-visit! How to fully enjoy the Bengara-colored townscape of 'Fukiya'. The red townscape of 'Fukiya' suddenly appears in the mountains of Takahashi City. It has a unique history as a production area for the red pigment 'Bengara' during the Edo period. Just seeing and walking through the town is enjoyable, but knowing the history makes the town shine vividly as you can imagine the scenes from that time. While touring the Bengara kiln owner's residence, the ruins of the Bengara factory, the copper mine tunnels, and the grand 'Hirokane Residence', you can stroll through the town and experience 'Bengara-style dyeing'. Following this route, you are sure to fully enjoy the enchanting Fukiya!

title: 【津山まなびの鉄道館】こどもたちも大喜び！まなびと発見がいっぱいの鉄道館（岡山県津山市）
description: Children will be delighted! A must-see for railway fans! A large number of nostalgic vehicles on display. Tsuyama Manabi no Tetsudoukan consists of a space displaying vehicles, a turntable, and the driving wheels of steam locomotives, as well as a space where visitors can learn about the history of Okayama's railways and the mechanisms of railways through hands-on experiences. The former Tsuyama roundhouse, built in 1936, is a valuable facility that boasts the second largest scale in Japan. A diesel locomotive 'DE50-1' equipped with a powerful engine, of which only one was manufactured in Japan, is preserved here. If you visit with your family, children will be thrilled! The sound of the whistle at 12:00 and 15:00 on opening days is impressive! This is a must-visit spot for those interested in railways and locomotives!

title: Tsuyama Manabi no Tetsudoukan: A Railway Museum Full of Learning and Discovery for Children!
description: 津山まなびの鉄道館は、旧津山扇形機関車庫として車両、転車台、蒸気機関車の動輪など展示するスペースと、岡山の鉄道の歴史や、鉄道のしくみを体験しながら学べるスペース、さらに、津山の街並みをジオラマ展示したスペースで構成されています。1936年に建設された旧津山扇形機関車庫は現存するものでは国内2番目の規模を誇る貴重な施設です。国内で1台のみ製造された大馬力のエンジンを積んだディーゼル機関車「DE50-1」が保存されています。家族で訪れれば、こどもたちも大喜び！開館日の12時と15時に汽笛の吹鳴は迫力満点！鉄道や機関車に興味がある人も必見のスポットです！

description: 晴れの国岡山はおいしい国でもあるんです。なかでも白桃やぶどうは全国屈指の生産量。旬を迎える夏から秋にかけては“くだもの王国”の本領発揮！ 果樹農園で収穫体験ができたり、街のお店で絶品フルーツメニューに出会えたりと、贅沢＆美味な時間が待っています。さぁ、次の旅は岡山へ。

title: Okayama's Journey: Luxurious and Delicious Fruit Time【short ver.】
description: Okayama, the land of sunshine, is also a land of deliciousness. Among them, white peaches and grapes boast some of the highest production in the country. From summer to autumn, when they are in season, the true essence of the 'fruit kingdom' shines! You can experience fruit picking at orchards and encounter exquisite fruit menus at local shops, promising a luxurious and delicious time. So, let’s make Okayama your next travel destination.

https://carillon-house.com/

A training facility equipped with an environment conducive to nature experiences and training.

Carillon House, a training accommodation facility, is located on Maejima Island in Ushimado (Setouchi City, Okayama Prefecture), which is renowned as Japan's Aegean Sea. The tranquil scenery of olive trees and the blue sea is breathtakingly beautiful. The core facility, Carillon House, consists of a lodging building that accommodates 250 people, a training building, and a large hall. The vast grounds are equipped with an observatory, multipurpose workshop, and Bizen pottery climbing kiln, providing an optimal environment for a variety of activities and programs such as learning, outdoor activities, marine sports, and cultural experiences. It serves as a lodging-type seminar house for corporate training and also plays a role as a support facility for local events.

Please take a look at the great nature of the island from the sky, the beauty of the Seto Inland Sea's many islands, and the entire facility located by the sea!

title: 白石島 盆踊り（白石踊）【岡山県笠岡市】
description: It is said to have started to mourn those who died in the Genpei Suwa battle, and is a traditional Bon dance held from the night of August 13 to 16. The dance features a circle of dancers performing various types of dances, including male and female dances, all to a single melody (ondo). Due to its unique form, it has been designated as an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Asset by the country.

Many people visit for summer marine leisure, hiking courses, temples associated with Kobo Daishi, and the mystical Shiraishi dance.

The hiking courses on the island have many large rocks and breathtaking photo spots everywhere, so why not walk and take pictures?

description:

The view from 'Maejima Sunset Park' and the site of the stone quarry used for the reconstruction of Osaka Castle, known as 'Osaka Castle Construction Remains', is breathtaking! Let's explore the island by rental bicycle♪

Additionally, the area around Ushimado, including Maejima, has been selected as one of the '100 Best Sunsets in Japan', and the orange-tinted sunset over the Seto Inland Sea will surely become a memorable part of your trip!

Sakahara Fureai Mine Park / Sakahara Mine Museum

"Time Travel to the Showa Era! Experience Retro Railways"

Sakahara Fureai Mine Park is built on the site of the former Kichigahara Station and shunting yard of the old Kataoka Railway. The park features the Sakahara Mine Museum, which recreates the mining scene and lifestyle from around 1955 (Showa 30), and displays 11 actual vehicles that were used, available for viewing. The castle tower's floors from B1 to 6th floors, except 2nd floor where important cultural properties are exhibited, can be rented in the evening for parties or other activities. title: OKAYAMA Explore Tour to Inujima！-a paradise of art and leisure-
description:
Located about 10 minutes by regular boat service from Hoden Port in southeastern Okayama Prefecture, Inujima is a small island with a circumference of 3.6km and an area of 0.54 k㎡. The island's beautiful, peaceful beaches attract campers and picnickers. Visitors can also enjoy sea kayaking with a qualified guide.

Inujima is one of the venues of the famous Setouchi Triennale, an event which has brought vitality to the islands in the Seto Inland Sea. The Inujima Seirensho Art Museum opened in 2008, restoring and preserving the remains of the smelter. Inujima "Art House Project" began in 2010 under artistic director Yuko Hasegawa and architect Kazuyo Sejima.

This small island allows you to roam the neighborhoods, meet the locals, see incredible art and savor this slow pace of life. Small pathways form a maze that's easy to get lost in, but with the island being only four kilometers in circumference you won't be lost for long, so enjoy the adventure!!

title: 岡山の犬島探検ツアー！-アートとレジャーの楽園-
description:
岡山県南東部の宝伝港から定期船で約10分の場所に位置する犬島は、周囲3.6km、面積0.54k㎡の小さな島です。島の美しい静かなビーチはキャンパーやピクニックを楽しむ人々を惹きつけます。訪問者は資格を持ったガイドと一緒にシーカヤックを楽しむこともできます。

犬島は、瀬戸内海の島々に活気をもたらした有名な瀬戸内トリエンナーレの会場の一つです。犬島精錬所美術館は2008年に開館し、精錬所の遺構を修復・保存しています。犬島「アートハウスプロジェクト」は2010年に芸術監督の長谷川祐子と建築家の妹島和世のもとで始まりました。

この小さな島では、近隣を散策し、地元の人々と出会い、素晴らしいアートを見て、このゆったりとした生活のペースを味わうことができます。小道は迷路のように形成されており、簡単に迷ってしまうかもしれませんが、島の周囲はわずか4キロメートルなので、長く迷うことはありません。冒険を楽しんでください！

description: 北海道の内浦湾にある洞爺湖町では、ホタテの養殖が盛んだ。ユネスコの世界遺産にも登録されているこの地域は、100年の間に４度も噴火を繰り返す「有珠山」や、噴火によって形成されたカルデラ湖「洞爺湖」があり、その噴火によって降り注ぐ火山灰はやがて豊富な土壌となり、川からはミネラル豊富な水が海に注がれる。そんな美しい海で育ったホタテの味は絶品である。特に春は、「耳づり」と言われる独特な養殖方法に多くの人手が必要なため、小さな漁業町は活気づく季節である。

title: 春の北海道の漁師
description: In Toyako Town, located in the Uchiura Bay of Hokkaido, scallop farming is thriving. This area, registered as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, features 'Usuzan,' which has erupted four times over the past 100 years, and 'Lake Toya,' a caldera lake formed by volcanic eruptions. The volcanic ash that falls from these eruptions eventually becomes rich soil, and mineral-rich water flows from the rivers into the sea. The taste of scallops raised in such beautiful waters is exquisite. In particular, spring is a lively season for this small fishing town, as the unique farming method called 'mimiduri' requires many hands.

title: 大雲海
description: 洞爺湖は、円形の青い湖の真ん中にポツンと浮かぶ中島が特徴的で、年に数回その全てが隠れるほどの大きな雲海が現れる。遠方には、１世紀の間に４度の噴火を繰り返す活火山「有珠山」にも囲まれたこのエリアは、「洞爺湖有珠山ジオパーク」として、ユネスコの世界登録もされている。

title: Great Sea of Clouds
description: Lake Toya is characterized by a small island floating in the middle of a circular blue lake, but a large sea of clouds appears several times a year, hiding everything. This area, surrounded by the active volcano 'Usuzan', which has erupted four times over the past century, is registered as a UNESCO World Geopark as 'Lake Toya and Usuzan Geopark'.

The Wamanuma area, which was deeply familiar with Edo culture due to the river transport of the Tone River, still has remnants of its prosperity everywhere.
'Wamanuma Inari Sushi' is one of them, loved for over 200 years without changing its form.
It is also popular as a souvenir for visiting 'Wamanuma Seiryu Mountain', which has national treasure architecture known as Saitama Nikko.

https://www.oideyo-kumagaya.com/cate-gourmet/16466/

The lava known as 'pillow lava' resembles a giraffe's stripe pattern, and the rock is also called 'Giraffe Rock,' creating a mystical world that makes you forget your daily life.

title: NIIGATA ASMR_06 手しごと篇
description: 新潟には数々の名産品があります。そこには職人の”丁寧な仕事”や”技”が見え隠れしています。一つ一つ笹の葉で包む”笹団子”。「てぶり」という盛り方の音が子気味良い”へぎそば”。何度も何度も繰り返し表面を焼き上げる、米どころ新潟の”せんべい”。高温で一つ一つじっくりと揚げる”栃尾の油揚げ”。音でも新潟を味わってみませんか。

title: NIIGATA ASMR_06 Handmade Edition
description: Niigata has many local specialties. The craftsmanship and skills of artisans are evident in each product. The 'sasa-dango' wrapped in bamboo leaves. The pleasant sound of 'hegi-soba' served in a unique way called 'teburi'. The 'senbei' that is repeatedly grilled to perfection in the rice-producing region of Niigata. The 'Tochio's deep-fried tofu' that is carefully fried one by one at high temperatures. Why not experience the taste of Niigata through sound?

title: NIIGATA ASMR_05 温泉篇
description: 新潟県では宿泊施設のある温泉地数が144あり、全国で第3位を誇る温泉天国です。また日本海に面し、海・山・川、そして雪や紅葉など、雄大な自然に囲まれた温泉スポットがたくさんあり、様々な効能や泉質を楽しめます。 たゆたゆと湯口から溢れる湯の音、野鳥のさえずり、虫の声…温もりの中、自然とひとつになったような体験をどうぞ。

title: NIIGATA ASMR_05 Onsen Edition
description: Niigata Prefecture boasts 144 hot spring areas with accommodation, ranking third in the country as a hot spring paradise. Facing the Sea of Japan, there are many hot spring spots surrounded by magnificent nature, including the sea, mountains, rivers, and seasonal changes like snow and autumn leaves, where you can enjoy various effects and water quality. Experience the sound of water overflowing from the hot spring, the chirping of wild birds, and the voices of insects... enjoy an experience that feels like becoming one with nature in warmth.

title: NIIGATA ASMR_04 雪旅篇
description: 新潟には昔から伝わる雪国独自の文化や習慣が多く残っています。長く続く冬の季節、雪と共存し、雪を利用し、雪の楽しみを見つける。そこには寒さに負けないたくましさや知恵と工夫が感じられます。そんな雪国ならではの旅を擬似体験。あたり一面まっ白く積もった雪は、音を吸収し、ピーンと張り詰めた空気に清々しさが漂います。

title: NIIGATA ASMR_04 Snow Travel Edition
description: In Niigata, many unique cultures and customs of the snow country have been passed down since ancient times. During the long winter season, people coexist with snow, utilize it, and find enjoyment in it. There is a sense of resilience and wisdom that does not succumb to the cold. Experience a simulated journey unique to the snow country. The snow piled up all around absorbs sound, and a refreshing atmosphere drifts in the taut air.

title: NIIGATA ASMR_03 ものづくり篇
description: The sounds released by artisans that seem to convey the breath of the creator.

title: NIIGATA ASMR_03 Craftsmanship Edition
description: In fact, Niigata is the third largest manufacturing prefecture in Japan, following Kyoto and Tokyo, with a designated number of traditional crafts. There are places where you can not only admire beautiful crafts but also experience and learn about their charm and history. From the tense atmosphere of the artisans' workshops, the sounds of craftsmanship that have continued unchanged since ancient times resonate. The sounds released from their hands surely convey the soul and warmth of humanity.

description: 日本最長を誇るドラゴンドラで空中散歩を楽しみませんか？アップダウンを繰り返しながら苗場と田代の間を約25分で結びます。エメラルドグリーンに輝く神秘的な二居湖や眼下に流れる清津川などの絶景をお楽しみいただけます。また、テイクアウトコーヒー付き 苗場ドラゴンドラ往復乗車券を購入すると絶景を眺めながらカフェタイムをお楽しみいただけます。

You can enjoy the breathtaking views of the mystical Lake Niigata shining in emerald green and the clear Kiyotsu River flowing below. Additionally, if you purchase a round-trip ticket for the Naeba Dragon Gondola with takeout coffee, you can enjoy cafe time while admiring the stunning scenery.

title: Echigo Plain: Evening Scenery of the Blessed Land, Niigata City
description: The Echigo Plain, centered around Niigata City, is known as one of Japan's premier rice-producing areas, particularly for Koshihikari. The sight of the sunset illuminating the rice fields on this fertile land, formed by the Shinano River and the Agano River, is a breathtaking landscape worthy of the name. In spring, the rice fields are filled with melted snow water, turning green in summer as the rice grows. Furthermore, the golden fields bowing before harvest symbolize the Echigo Plain, with distant landmarks such as Mount Yahiko and Mount Kakuda.

title: 【NIIGATA-SORADORI】信濃川と萬代橋　進化するみなとまち新潟　新潟市
description: Niigata City, Shinano River and Bandai Bridge, the evolving port city of Niigata. The Shinano River, originating from the distant Kobushin Mountain and flowing into the Sea of Japan via the Nagano Chikuma River, has nourished the lives of people in the Niigata Plain, known as the best rice-producing area in Japan. Here in Niigata City, the river's role ends at Bandai Bridge and soon transforms as it approaches the Niigata West Port, which is about to celebrate its 150th anniversary. Niigata City continues to evolve as a waterfront city.

description:
にいがた観光ナビ【NIIGATA-SORADORI】佐渡市関岬　潮風と人が育む佐渡牛

あまり知られていないが、佐渡は上質な牛肉の生産地でもある。佐渡牛は、畜産農家の深い愛情と海洋気候により、ミネラルを豊富に含んだ牧草、そして日本海から吹く潮風に育まれ、上質なブランド牛として出荷される。ここ佐渡島、関岬の放牧場は有数の佐渡牛の育成地である。ストレスを感じる事のない大自然の中で育ったブランド牛は、その土地で食べてみたい一品である。

description:
Niigata Tourism Navigation 【NIIGATA-SORADORI】 Sado City Sekimisaki, The Sado Beef Nurtured by Sea Breeze and People

Although not widely known, Sado is also a production area for high-quality beef. Sado beef is nurtured by the deep affection of livestock farmers and the marine climate, rich in minerals from the pasture and the sea breeze blowing from the Japan Sea, and is shipped as a high-quality brand beef. The grazing area at Sekimisaki on Sado Island is one of the leading breeding grounds for Sado beef. Brand beef raised in the great outdoors without stress is a dish you want to try in that land.

Niigata City Fukushima Wetland Morning Mist Traditional Fishing
Fukushima Wetland, located in the northern district of Niigata City, is a habitat for over 200 species of migratory birds, cherished not only by the citizens but also by many bird lovers. It is also known as the northern limit habitat for rare plants such as the giant water lily. The traditional fishing that has been practiced in Fukushima Wetland for a long time involves boats gliding over the lake surface in the early morning. The silhouettes of fishermen blending into the morning mist represent a scene of Niigata that should be preserved along with the rich natural environment of the wetland.

description:
NIIGATA-SORADORIにいがた観光ナビ
小千谷市　縮の雪さらし

小千谷縮みは、小千谷市周辺を産地とする麻織物である。よりの強い糸で織った布を雪に晒すことで、染め上げられた麻糸は更に鮮やかさを増し、色柄を引き立てさせる繊維の奥深く効果は見られ、糸そのものの膨らみが出て織物全体がふっくらと感じられ、雪国の風土を包み込んだ逸品が誕生する。この小千谷縮雪晒しの光景は、雪深い小千谷の地に春を呼ぶ風物詩である。雪の白と色鮮やかな反物が織りなすストライプは一見の価値がある。

title: NIIGATA-SORADORI: Snow Exposure of Ojiya Shrink - A Snowy Landscape Adorned with Hemp Fabric
description: Ojiya shrink is a hemp textile produced in the Ojiya city area. By exposing the woven fabric made from strong threads to snow, the dyed hemp threads become even more vibrant, enhancing the colors and patterns. The effect is seen deep within the fibers, causing the threads to swell and giving the entire textile a fluffy feel, resulting in a product that encapsulates the essence of the snowy region. The sight of Ojiya shrink snow exposure is a seasonal tradition that brings spring to the snow-laden land of Ojiya. The stripes created by the white snow and colorful fabric are worth seeing.

十日町　星峠の棚田　雲海煙る原風景

今なお日本の原風景を残す星峠の棚田。１年を通じて、その美しさを楽しむことができる。全国から多くのカメラマンが訪れるほど朝陽を映す棚田や、この土地ならではの雲海に霞む幻想的な景観は、見る者を魅了して止まない。松之山や十日町を訪れた際には、是非とも足を運んでみたいスポットである。

The rice terraces reflecting the morning sun and the mystical landscape shrouded in sea of clouds attract many photographers from all over the country. It is a spot you definitely want to visit when you are in Matsunoyama or Tokamachi.

title: 【NIIGATA-SORADORI】龍ヶ窪　清水出でる神秘の地　津南町
description:
にいがた観光ナビ【NIIGATA-SORADORI】津南町　龍ヶ窪　清水出でる神秘の地

　国内有数の豪雪地帯　津南町にある。日本名水百選に選ばれるほどの清らかな湧き水を湛える龍ヶ窪は、水量毎分30トン、日量43,000トンの池の水が1日に1回入れ替わる。伝説にまつわり二つの神社を有する神聖な場所として、遠い昔から村の人達により大切に守られてきた。その神秘的で厳粛なたたずまいは、訪れた人を魅了して止まない。

title: Ryugakubo: A Mysterious Place Where Clear Water Flows in Tsunan Town
description:
Niigata Tourism Navigation 【NIIGATA-SORADORI】 Tsunan Town, Ryugakubo, a mysterious place where clear water flows.

Located in Tsunan Town, one of Japan's major heavy snowfall areas. Ryugakubo, which is selected as one of Japan's top 100 famous waters, has a clear spring water that flows at a rate of 30 tons per minute and replaces the pond's water of 43,000 tons daily. It is a sacred place with two shrines related to legends, cherished and protected by the villagers since ancient times. Its mysterious and solemn atmosphere continues to captivate visitors.

title: 祝 佐渡金山世界遺産登録！「黄金KAIDO」でお得な旅を／佐渡・新潟
description:
【What is Golden KAIDO...】 Sado Mine (Niigata Prefecture) and Toi Mine (Shizuoka Prefecture) were gold mines directly controlled by Tokugawa. The gold that was excavated was transported to Edo and Suruga, where Ieyasu spent his time. Since there were also gold mines in Nagano and Yamanashi Prefectures, the road that connected Sado and Toi, where gold was transported, was named 'Golden KAIDO'.

【Affordable Drive Plan】 An affordable drive plan is currently on sale for the expressway in the Golden KAIDO area.

【For more details, check the official web】 https://gold-road.jp/

title: Celebrating the Registration of Sado Mine as a World Heritage Site! Affordable Travel on 'Golden KAIDO' / Sado, Niigata

title: Tsunami Snow Festival: Sky Lanterns Illuminating the Night Sky in Tsunan Town
description: The 'Tsunami Snow Festival' held in Tsunan Town, located at the southernmost tip of Niigata Prefecture along the Shinetsu border, marks the end of the harsh winter in this heavy snowfall area and the awaited arrival of spring. The sky lanterns that fill the night sky are a must-see, reminiscent of the Disney movie 'Tangled.' General participants can also release sky lanterns, providing unforgettable emotions for both 'viewers' and 'releasers.'

description:
Niigata Tourism Navigation【NIIGATA-SORADORI】
Tokamachi City Kiyotsu Gorge A Hidden Paradise Drenched in Seven Colors

Located in Tokamachi City, Niigata Prefecture, it is one of Japan's three great gorges. During the autumn foliage season, many tourists visit to admire the beauty of the majestic green schist and columnar jointing. It was closed due to a rockfall accident in 1988, but now, thanks to the opening of the Kiyotsu Gorge Tunnel, it can be enjoyed safely and securely. It is also a tourist spot where you can enjoy both the breathtaking views and hot springs.

にいがた観光ナビ【NIIGATA-SORADORI】柏崎の海あそび　シーカヤック・SUP　柏崎市

　1年を通じて県内外から多くの観光客の訪れる柏崎の海。全長４２ｋｍにも及ぶ。その海岸線は非常に変化に富み、海の透明度と相まって絶景を生み出している。さらに近年では、シーカヤックやスタンドアップパドルボードなどのマリンアクティビティを楽しむこともでき、気軽に海からも絶景を楽しむことができるようになっている。穏やかな日本海に沈む夕陽は、一見の価値がある。

title: Kashiwazaki Sea Activities: Sea Kayaking and SUP in Kashiwazaki City
description:
Niigata Tourism Navigation [NIIGATA-SORADORI] Kashiwazaki Sea Activities: Sea Kayaking and SUP in Kashiwazaki City

Kashiwazaki's sea attracts many tourists from both inside and outside the prefecture throughout the year. The coastline stretches over 42 km and is very diverse, creating stunning views along with the sea's transparency. In recent years, it has also become possible to enjoy marine activities such as sea kayaking and stand-up paddleboarding, allowing easy access to breathtaking views from the sea. The sunset over the calm Sea of Japan is worth seeing.

description: One of Niigata's most popular tourist destinations, the hidden Okutadami. The largest artificial lake in Japan, with a total water storage capacity of over 600 million tons, offers grand scenery in spring that resembles 'Northern Europe' and in autumn known as 'the autumn leaves of Okutadami.' You can enjoy a boat tour on the lake surrounded by mountains over 2,000 meters high.

title: 埼玉の祭 #37 秩父夜祭
description: 「秩父夜祭」は、京都祇園祭、飛騨高山祭と共に日本三大曳山祭の一つに数えられ、2016年には「秩父祭の屋台行事と神楽」としてユネスコ無形文化遺産に登録されました。毎年、12月2日、3日に諸行事が華やかに行われる「秩父夜祭」は、秩父の人々にとって、一年の総決算ともいえる祭りです。

title: Saitama Festival #37 Chichibu Night Festival
description: The 'Chichibu Night Festival' is counted among Japan's three major float festivals along with the Gion Matsuri in Kyoto and the Takayama Matsuri in Hida. In 2016, it was registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage as 'Chichibu Festival's Float Events and Kagura'. The festival, which takes place on December 2nd and 3rd every year, is a grand event for the people of Chichibu, marking the culmination of the year.

title: 埼玉の祭 #23 猪俣の百八燈

title: Saitama Festival #23 Inomata's 108 Lanterns

This event is a fantastic occasion where 108 mounds built on the ridge of Doumae Mountain are lit up on a summer night. The main participants are children and young people aged 6 to 18, who work together from preparation to the day of the event. It is one of the Bon events where you can feel a solemn and fantastic atmosphere.

○概要
瑞泉寺は、天正9年・宝暦12年・明治12年と三度大きな火災にあって（伽藍）建物が焼失しましたが、そのたびに地域の方々の想いとともに再建されてきました。その際、京都本山のお抱え大工らが直接の再建と指導のために派遣され、井波の大工らに卓越した技術を伝えたといわれております。現在まで連綿と続く伝統工芸の井波彫刻は、京都の優れた伝統的な寺院建築や寺院彫刻に学んだ技術と、瑞泉寺再建などで培ってきた井波大工の技術との調和・融合によって生み出されたと考えられます。このことから、井波別院瑞泉寺は井波彫刻発祥の地ともいわれております。

○Phone number: 0763-82-0004

○Overview
Zuisen-ji has suffered three major fires in the years Tensho 9, Hōreki 12, and Meiji 12, resulting in the loss of its buildings (garan). However, it has been rebuilt each time with the support and wishes of the local community. During these reconstructions, skilled carpenters from the main temple in Kyoto were dispatched to directly oversee and guide the rebuilding, passing on their exceptional techniques to the carpenters of Inami. The traditional craft of Inami carving, which has continued to this day, is believed to have been created through the harmony and fusion of techniques learned from Kyoto's excellent traditional temple architecture and sculpture, and the skills cultivated by Inami carpenters during the reconstruction of Zuisen-ji. For this reason, Inami Betsuin Zuisen-ji is said to be the birthplace of Inami carving.

〇概要
散居村とは富山県の西部に位置する砺波平野は主に庄川と小矢部川が形成した扇状地です。およそ220キロ平方メートルの広さに屋敷林に囲まれた約7,000戸を超える家（農家）が点在する散居村が広がっています。
　砺波平野の散居村の成り立ちは、それぞれの農家が自分の周りの土地を開拓して米作りを行ってきたことに由来します。農地が自分の家の周りにあることは、扇状地上での田植え後の朝夕の水の管理、施肥などの管理、刈り取ったあとの稲の運搬など、日常の農作業をするためにはとても効率の良いことでした。
　また砺波平野の散居村の特徴としては、それぞれの家の周りに屋敷林をめぐらせてきたことです。この地方では屋敷林は「カイニョ」と呼ばれ、冬の冷たい季節風や吹雪、夏の日差しなどから家や人々の暮しを守ってくれました。スギの落ち葉や枝木などは毎日の炊事や風呂焚きの大切な燃料として利用されました。またスギやケヤキ、タケ等は家を新築する際の建材や様々な生活道具の用材としても利用されました。
　このように昔の散居村の人々は、自分の家の周りの農地を耕して米や野菜を作って生活し、日常生活に必要な資材を屋敷林から調達するという、きわめて自給自足に近い生活を送ってきました。
　散居村という集落形態は、砺波平野で暮らした先人たちが、自然に働きかけて自然との共生を図って残してくれた知恵の結晶といえるものです。

title: Cycling in Nanto: Scenic Village ②
description:
〇Shooting period: Mid-June

〇Shooting location: Nanto City, Fukuno, Inami, Iguchi (Scattered Village)

〇Overview
The scattered village refers to the Takaoka Plain located in the western part of Toyama Prefecture, which is mainly formed by the Shogawa and Oyabe rivers. It is a scattered village with over 7,000 houses (farms) surrounded by house forests, covering an area of about 220 square kilometers.
The formation of the scattered village in the Takaoka Plain is derived from the fact that each farmer has developed the land around their own house for rice cultivation. Having farmland around one's house is very efficient for daily agricultural work, such as managing water in the morning and evening after rice planting, fertilization, and transporting harvested rice.
Another characteristic of the scattered village in the Takaoka Plain is that each house is surrounded by a house forest. In this region, the house forest is called "Kainyo," which protects houses and people's lives from cold seasonal winds and snow in winter, as well as summer sunlight. The fallen leaves and branches of cedar are used as important fuel for daily cooking and bathing. Additionally, cedar, zelkova, and bamboo are also used as building materials and various living tools when constructing new houses.
In this way, the people of the old scattered village lived a life that was very close to self-sufficiency, cultivating rice and vegetables around their homes and procuring necessary materials for daily life from the house forest.
The form of the scattered village can be said to be a crystallization of the wisdom left by the ancestors who lived in the Takaoka Plain, working with nature to achieve coexistence with it.

description: 南砺市福光は、全国のバット生産の約4割を占める一大生産地。福光地域のバット産業は、大正時代から始まり、今も多くのプロ野球選手が使用する木製バットが、福光の工場から生み出されています。南砺市観光協会主催ツアー『なん旅』では、バット工場を見学し、職人の手ほどきでバット削りを体験できます。移動は便利な地元タクシーをご用意。さあ、もっと、南砺を感じる旅へー。

title: Official 'Nanto Travel' Fukumi Bat Story PV
description:
#Nanto City #Toyama Prefecture #Fukumi #Craftsmanship #Baseball #Nanto Travel
Fukumi in Nanto City is a major production area, accounting for about 40% of bat production nationwide. The bat industry in the Fukumi region began in the Taisho era, and wooden bats used by many professional baseball players are still produced in Fukumi's factories. The 'Nanto Travel' tour organized by the Nanto City Tourism Association allows you to visit bat factories and experience bat carving under the guidance of craftsmen. Convenient local taxis are provided for transportation. Now, let's embark on a journey to feel more of Nanto.

title: Official PV of 'Nantabi' - Experience Traditional Craft in World Heritage Gokayama
description: The Gokayama Gassho-zukuri village, registered as a World Cultural Heritage site. The high-quality and durable 'Gokayama Washi' is still passed down as an important industry. In 'Nantabi', you will paint a paper-mache doll made of washi inside a gassho-zukuri house and create your own cat figurine. Now, let's embark on a journey to feel more of Nanto.

title: Zuisenji temple Night Museum ＜Toyama, Nanto＞
description: 南砺市井波は全国随一の木彫りのまちで「日本遺産」にも認定されています。今も約200名の職人が江戸中期からの彫刻技術を受け継いでいます。そんな井波の中心にある井波別院瑞泉寺は、まるで『木彫刻の美術館』とも称され、精緻な彫刻が随所に施されています。本プランでは、寺内の木彫刻をライトアップすることで陰影が生まれ、昼間より彫刻の緻密さを感じることができます。また、井波彫刻師が解説してくれるので、井波彫刻の技術への理解を深めることができます。

title: 瑞泉寺夜の美術館 ＜富山、南砺＞
description: Nanto City Inami is recognized as one of the best wood carving towns in Japan and has been designated as a 'Japan Heritage'. About 200 craftsmen continue the carving techniques that have been passed down since the mid-Edo period. The Zuisenji Temple, located in the center of Inami, is referred to as a 'museum of wood carvings', with intricate carvings adorning various parts of the temple. This plan allows you to experience the detailed beauty of the carvings more vividly through lighting at night, creating shadows that enhance their intricacy compared to during the day. Additionally, a local Inami carver will provide explanations, deepening your understanding of Inami's carving techniques.

title: 【旅なんと】福野の曳山～新町編～　Trip to Nanto City, Toyama Prefecture
description: 福野には、上町・七津屋（船鉾型曳山)、横町、浦町・辰巳町、新町（以上３基花傘山型­曳山）の計４基の曳山がある。山人形の意匠は、上町・七津屋の「神功皇后の西征航海」、横町の「猩々の汲み酒」、浦­町・辰巳町の「素戔嗚尊の大蛇退治」、新町の「橋弁慶牛若丸」である。福野の曳山の曳き廻しの開始時期は不明。但し、上町には文政４年（1821）以降の古­文書があり、横町には弘化４年に曳山の修繕を下記録があることから、文政年間（181­8～1830）には各町で曳山を作り、天保年間（1830～1844）には４町の曳山­が揃って曳き廻されたと思われる。享保期（1716～1736）に経済不況となった際の打開策として、人々は神を奉り、­招福除災や町内繁栄を祈ったのだろう。安永期（1772～1781）には各地で曳山祭­りが流行した。〇毎年5月3日開催　福野中心市街地一帯

title: Trip to Nanto City, Toyama Prefecture
description: Fukuno has a total of four floats: Kamimachi and Nanatsuya (funahoko type float), Yokomachi, Uramachi and Tatsumimachi, and Shinmachi (the last three are hanakasa type floats). The designs of the float dolls are 'Empress Jingu's Western Expedition Voyage' for Kamimachi and Nanatsuya, 'Shōjō's Sake Fetching' for Yokomachi, 'Susanoo's Defeat of the Great Serpent' for Uramachi and Tatsumimachi, and 'Benkei and Ushiwakamaru on the Bridge' for Shinmachi. The start date of the float parades in Fukuno is unknown. However, there are ancient documents from after 1821 in Kamimachi, and records of repairs to the floats in Yokomachi from 1847, suggesting that floats were made in each town during the Bunsei era (1818-1830), and that all four towns' floats were paraded together during the Tenpo era (1830-1844). During the Kyōhō period (1716-1736), as a way to overcome the economic recession, people likely worshipped gods and prayed for good fortune and prosperity in the town. During the An'ei period (1772-1781), float festivals became popular in various regions. Held annually on May 3rd in the central area of Fukuno.

However, there are ancient documents from after 1821 in Kamimachi, and records of repairs to the floats in Yokomachi from the 4th year of Kōka, suggesting that floats were made in each town during the Bunsei era (1818-1830), and all four towns' floats were likely paraded together during the Tenpo era (1830-1844). During the Kyōhō period (1716-1736), when there was an economic recession, people likely worshipped gods to pray for good fortune and the prosperity of their town. During the An'ei period (1772-1781), float festivals became popular in various regions.

description: 福野夜高祭り（ふくのよたかまつり）福野神明社の春祭りは、５月１日・２日の夜高祭が神迎えの宵祭り、３日が神輿と曳山の巡行する本祭りです。かつて、神は常に神社においでになるのではなく、祭りの時だけおいでになるものと考えられ、これを迎える神迎えの行事として宵祭りが行われました。宵祭りでは、夜高行燈の練り回しが行われ、赤々とともる行燈の灯とともに、夜高太鼓と若衆の「ヨイヤサ！ヨイヤサ！」という勇ましい掛け声が春の夜空に響き渡ります。２日は呼び物の引合い（通称：ケンカ）が行われます。神明社の神様は喧嘩が大好きな女神であり、引き合いが激しいほどお悦びになると言い伝えられており、上町通りで上り行燈と下り行燈がすれ違う瞬間に始まります。昔はローソクでしたので、灯が燃え移ったりしたこともありました。全部の町内が練り終わると、締めくくり「しゃんしゃん」の儀が行われます。各町裁許が銀行四つ角に集まり、無事終えたことの報告と引継ぎの儀式で、手締め（しゃんしゃん）が行われます。神迎えを終えた５月３日は本祭りが行われます。４町（上町、新町、浦町、横町）の曳山が、紋付・袴姿の裁許に先導され神明社に参詣します。また、午後からは庁内をみこしが巡幸し、氏子が清めの塩をまいて行列をお迎えします。

title: Trip to Nanto City, Toyama Prefecture - 福野夜高祭り　～引き合い（通称：ケンカ）～
description: The Fukuno Yotaka Festival (福野夜高祭り) is a spring festival at Fukuno Shinmeisha Shrine, with the Yotaka Festival on the nights of May 1st and 2nd serving as the welcoming ceremony for the gods, and the main festival on the 3rd featuring the procession of portable shrines and floats. It was once believed that the gods did not always reside at the shrine but only came during the festival, which is why the welcoming ceremony is held. During the evening festival, the Yotaka lanterns are paraded, and the sounds of the Yotaka drums and the spirited shouts of the young men resonate in the spring night sky. On the 2nd, the highlight event known as 'Hiki-ai' (commonly referred to as 'Kenka') takes place. The deity of the Shinmeisha Shrine is said to be a goddess who loves fights, and it is believed that the more intense the Hiki-ai, the more pleased she becomes. This event begins when the ascending and descending lanterns pass each other on Kamimachi Street. In the past, when candles were used, there were instances of flames catching. Once all the neighborhoods have completed their parades, a concluding ceremony called 'Shanshan' is held. Each neighborhood gathers at the bank intersection to report the safe completion of the festival and perform a hand-clapping ritual. The main festival on May 3rd features the floats from four neighborhoods (Kamimachi, Shinmachi, Uramachi, Yokomachi) leading to the Shinmeisha Shrine, accompanied by the portable shrine parading through the town, where the parishioners scatter purifying salt to welcome the procession.

title: Trip to Nanto City, Toyama Prefecture
description: The Fukuno Yotaka Festival (福野夜高祭り) is held on April 30th every year at the JR Fukuno Station square (rotary). The highlight is the Bunkyu giant lantern, which is about 15 meters tall and more than twice the size of the giant lanterns still passed down in the Fukuno area of Nanto City. It recreates the scale of those made in an era without utility poles. The evening festival, starting on May 1st, features the procession of the Yotaka lanterns, with the sounds of Yotaka drums and the spirited shouts of the young men echoing. The biggest attraction is the 'hiki-ai' (fight) that begins around 11 PM on the 2nd, where the young men break each other's lanterns with lively clappers. The intense competition captivates the audience. During the main festival, four town floats visit the Shinmei Shrine, and the portable shrine parades through the town.

title: KOKIRIKO -The Ancient Japanese Folk Song- ｜こきりこ　English Ver.
description: In Gokayama, a life in harmony with nature has been passed down through generations. Along with the World Cultural Heritage Gassho-style Village, Kokiriko—believed to be Japan’s oldest folk song—has been faithfully preserved by the locals. Passed down through generations in the Gokayama region, Kokiriko is a simple folk song and dance with roots in a performing art called Dengaku, which originated around 1,400 years ago during the Taika Reforms. Believed to be the oldest folk song in Japan, its name appears in many ancient documents.

description: Recently renovated, this is the birthplace of Takahama's beach. It is perfect for those who want to enjoy the beach slowly as it is relatively less crowded.

title: 【福井県高浜町】若狭和田ビーチ－Wakasa Wada Beach
description: Wakasa Wada Beach in Takahama, Fukui Prefecture, is a popular beach that has obtained Asia's first international environmental certification, 'BLUE FLAG'. It features excellent transparency, shallow waters, and a wide white sandy beach. It has also been selected as one of Japan's 88 bathing beaches. During the beach opening period, lifeguards and rescue personnel are stationed for safety. The scenery is beautiful, and it has been chosen as one of Japan's top 100 sunsets.

title: Wakasa Wada Beach - 【福井県高浜町】
description: Wakasa Wada Beach in Takahama, Fukui Prefecture, is a popular beach that has obtained Asia's first international environmental certification, 'BLUE FLAG'. It features excellent transparency, shallow waters, and a wide white sandy beach. It has also been selected as one of Japan's 88 bathing beaches. During the beach opening period, lifeguards and rescue personnel are stationed for safety. The scenery is beautiful, and it has been chosen as one of Japan's top 100 sunsets.

title: 【福井県高浜町】白浜海水浴場・鳥居浜海水浴場－Shirahama Beach/Toriihama Beach
description: Shirahama BeachとToriihama Beachは、青い海が美しい海水浴場です。お子様連れにちょうどいい砂浜の広さで、砂浜の後ろには松原が広がります。波が少なく、磯遊びができる岩場があり、小さいお子様連れのファミリーに人気です。

title: Shirahama Beach/Toriihama Beach - Takahama Town, Fukui Prefecture
description: Both Shirahama Beach and Toriihama Beach are beautiful beaches with blue seas. They have a sandy beach that is just right for families with children, and behind the beach, there is a pine grove. The waves are small, and there are rocky areas for tide pooling, making them popular with families with small children.

title: 【福井県高浜町】城山海水浴場－Shiroyama Beach
description: 波が少なく、磯遊びができる岩場があり、小さいお子様連れのファミリーに人気です。高浜町の景勝地「明鏡洞」のある城山公園がすぐ横にあり、芝生広場なども同時に楽しめます。城山公園は日本の夕日百選にも選ばれており、景観も楽しめます。

title: Shiroyama Beach - 【福井県高浜町】
description: The beach has few waves and rocky areas for tide pooling, making it popular with families with small children. Next to Shiroyama Park, which features the scenic spot 'Meikyo Cave' in Takahama Town, visitors can also enjoy the grassy areas. Shiroyama Park has been selected as one of Japan's top 100 sunset spots, offering beautiful views.

title: 【福井県高浜町】青葉山登山
description: 青葉山は美しい山容から別名「若狭富士」と呼ばれる高浜町のシンボルです。東峰（693m）と西峰（692m）の2つの峰からなり、バラエティに富んだ登山道は初心者から上級者まで人気のコース。また各ポイントでの絶景や約500種類の有用植物が自生し希少植物にも出会える山です。ナレーションは英語ですが、青葉山の魅力がたっぷり感じられる動画です。

title: Aoba Mountain Climbing in Takahama Town, Fukui Prefecture
description: Overlooking the Sea of Japan, Mt. Aoba (693m) is a symbol of Takahama town and offers breathtaking views and a variety of trails for beginners and advanced hikers! Revered as a sacred mountain since ancient times, It’s home to many shrines and temples, and is also known for its rare flora, including an abundance of medicinal wild plants.

title: 【福井県高浜町】音海大断崖 漁船クルーズ
description: 県の名勝に指定されている、高さ260mにおよぶ絶壁の大断崖を間近で見ることができる迫力のクルーズ。漁船でめぐることも魅力の一つ！

title: 【Fukui Prefecture Takahama Town】Oumi Great Cliff Fishing Boat Cruise
description: A powerful cruise that allows you to see the magnificent cliffs, designated as a scenic spot by the prefecture, up close at a height of 260m. One of the attractions is exploring by fishing boat!

title: EN（縁）short
description: 若狭湾と若狭富士「青葉山」に囲まれる福井県高浜町。海と山、両方の美しい景色、グルメ、様々な体験が楽しめます。そんな福井県高浜町へぜひお越しください。

title: EN（縁）short
description: Takahama Town, surrounded by Wakasa Bay and Mt. Aobayama, offers beautiful scenery of both the sea and mountains, gourmet food, and various experiences. We invite you to visit Takahama Town in Fukui Prefecture.

title: 【福井県高浜町】SUPーマリンアクティビティ
description: 高浜町の名勝「明鏡洞」や奇岩の風景を楽しみながらSUPはいかがですか？波の少ない場所から始められるコースなので、初心者も安心！認定資格を取得したインストラクターによるレクチャーを受けて、透明度を誇る高浜の海の上ををゆったり散歩してみませんか。

title: 【Fukui Prefecture Takahama Town】SUP Marine Activity
description: How about enjoying SUP while taking in the scenic views of the famous 'Meikyo Cave' and the strange rock formations in Takahama Town? The course starts in a location with little waves, making it safe for beginners! Under the guidance of certified instructors, why not take a leisurely stroll on the clear waters of Takahama?

title: Karakuri Puzzle Box 小田原・箱根のからくり細工 2017/08/25 Fri.
description: 小田原・箱根地域は世界的にも珍しい、からくり細工の産地。寄木の秘密箱は有名ですが、ほかにも昔から、組木細工、楊枝鳥（ようじどり）、タバコマジックなど様々なからくり細工がつくられてきました。実は海外の立体パズルマニアの間では、とても有名な産地なんです。からくり細工、立体パズルの第一人者の亀井明夫さんのところには、日本中、そして海外からも、若い弟子入り志願者が増えています。この地域特有の寄木や木象嵌、ろくろ挽きなどの多彩な木工技術と、若い感性の融合によって、小田原・箱根のからくり細工・立体パズルは進化を続けています。

title: Karakuri Puzzle Box
description: The Odawara and Hakone region is a rare production area for Karakuri crafts worldwide. While the secret boxes made of yosegi are famous, various other Karakuri crafts such as interlocking puzzles, toothpick birds, and tobacco trick boxes have been made for many years. In fact, it is a well-known area among overseas 3D puzzle enthusiasts. Akio Kamei, a leading figure in Karakuri crafts and 3D puzzles, has seen an increase in young apprentices from all over Japan and abroad. The fusion of the region's unique woodcraft techniques, such as yosegi, wood inlay, and lathe work, with young sensibilities continues to evolve the Karakuri crafts and 3D puzzles of Odawara and Hakone.

description: Odawara lacquerware uses durable and less warped keyaki wood for its base. By repeatedly applying natural lacquer, which also acts as a protector, the bowls become even stronger and more beautiful in grain. While lacquerware may seem difficult to handle, Odawara lacquerware bowls are sturdy, practical, and truly 'authentic' for everyday use. The Odawara-Hakone region has been a woodworking area that has developed for over a thousand years, primarily focusing on lathe turning. The beginning of Odawara lacquerware dates back to the Muromachi period when lacquer was applied to turned wooden bowls. Since then, it has developed as practical lacquerware. The main video introduces the wood turning and lacquer application by craftsmen from Odawara.

description: Since people have distanced their lives from the workings of nature, the balance between humans and nature is gradually breaking down. However, in Hiruzan, an ecosystem where humans and nature nurture each other still remains. It is a space where humans and nature blend inseparably, flowing with a relaxed time that is said to be 'Hiruzan time,' in accordance with the flow of nature. To live together, humans and nature must protect and enrich nature. GREENable is an activity and brand that aims to restore the relationship where humans and nature can live together. Why not experience the richness we truly had here in Hiruzan?

title: 瀬見温泉
description: A quiet hot spring area overlooking the clear stream of the Mogami Oguni River. Blessed with scenic mountain waters, this hot spring area is particularly wonderful during the autumn foliage season. It is said that this hot spring began when Benkei, searching for a birthing bath for his wife, the North Lady, who gave birth to Kamewakamaru, found the rising steam from a nearby rock. Nearby, there are many legends and historical sites related to Yoshitsune and Benkei, such as the Kamewari Koyasu Kannon, which was said to have blessed the birth of Kamewakamaru, and the Yumoto Shrine, where the guardian deity of Semmi Onsen is enshrined. In summer, many people can be seen enjoying sweetfish fishing in the nearby Mogami Oguni River.

title: Semmi Onsen
description: 最上小国川の清流に臨む静かな温泉場。山水の景勝に恵まれ、特に紅葉の季節がすばらしい温泉地です。源義経の妻、北の方が亀若丸を生んだ際、産湯を探しに出た弁慶が近くの岩陰から立ち昇る湯煙を見つけたのがこの温泉の始まりと伝えられています。近くには亀若丸の誕生に加護のあった亀割子安観音や瀬見温泉の守り神が祀られている湯前神社など、義経・弁慶に関する伝説や旧跡が数多く残っています。夏は、近くを流れる最上小国川でアユ釣りを楽しむ方を多く見かけます。

title: 山刀伐峠
description: Yamato-bari Pass is one of the passes connecting Mogami Town and Obanazawa City. Although its elevation is only 470 meters, the northern side towards Mogami Town is steep, while the southern side towards Obanazawa City has a relatively gentle terrain. On May 17, 1689, in the Genroku era, Matsuo Basho and Kawai Sora stayed at the house of a feudal lord in Mogami Town and then crossed the Yamato-bari Pass, which is said to be the 'greatest difficulty' in 'The Narrow Road to the Deep North', heading towards Obanazawa City. It is now maintained as a walking path and remains a valuable historic site that recalls Matsuo Basho's journey even after 300 years.

title: Owase Wappa - Handmade Wooden Bento Boxes
Owase Wappa - 手作りの木製弁当箱
description: Owaseは高品質な日本のヒノキの生産者として長い歴史があります。Owase Wappaは、Owaseから厳選されたヒノキのみを使用して作られ、元々は山で働く男性の日常生活のための弁当箱として使用されていました。伝統的な方法を用いて、厳選された材料が彫刻され、慎重に曲げられ、桜の樹皮を使って縫い合わされ、何層にもわたって漆塗りされます。1つのWappaを完成させるのに1ヶ月以上かかり、すべての45の工程が1人の手によって行われます。漆は一級品を使用し、混合物を使わないことで自然素材にしっかりと付着します。気難しい自然素材のため、仕上がりは深い色合いで、手にした人を魅了します。「Owase Wappa」は100年使用できるほどの耐久性があり、人工素材では体験できない「温もり」と「愛」があり、自然素材のためにユニークな作品が生まれます。人々に愛されるために、私たちは伝統を守りながら現代生活に合った新しい漆器の創造に取り組んでいます。

title: Ama & Ise Jingu Special Program - Learning About the Relationship Between Gods & Nature
description: Ama are female free diving fishermen who make a living by catching abalone, turban shells and seaweed. It’s a great way to fish. Sustainability and continuity have great meaning, as such many conventions have been set in order to protect the resources that we are targeting to “not catch too much” and prevent the resources from running out. Ama huts are huts where Ama prepare to go fishing, light fire to warm themselves after fishing and rest their tired bodies. It is an indispensable place for Ama fishers. Shinsen is a meal offered to the Gods and for about 1,500 years, Ise Jingu has served meals twice a day of salt, bonito flakes, kelp etc. to Amaterasu Omikami (Japanese Sun goddess) in the morning and the evening, without missing a single day. In addition to offerings prayers, special meals are offered at festivals such as the Thanksgiving Festival for bountiful harvests.

title: アマと伊勢神宮特別プログラム - 神々と自然の関係について学ぶ
description: アマは、アワビ、ターバン貝、海藻を捕ることで生計を立てる女性の素潜り漁師です。これは素晴らしい漁の方法です。持続可能性と継続性は非常に重要であり、資源が枯渇しないように「捕りすぎない」ための多くの規則が設けられています。アマ小屋は、アマが釣りに行く準備をし、釣りの後に体を温めるために火を灯し、疲れた体を休める場所です。アマ漁師にとって欠かせない場所です。神に捧げられる食事である神饌は、約1,500年間、伊勢神宮が毎朝と毎晩、アマテラス大神に塩、鰹節、昆布などの食事を欠かさず提供してきました。祈りに加えて、豊作感謝祭などの祭りでは特別な食事が捧げられます。

title: Kumano - Kumano Kodo / Swordsmith Workshop / Canyoning
熊野 - 熊野古道 / 刀鍛冶工房 / キャニオニング
description:
【熊野古道と伊勢路】
■世界遺産 熊野古道：日本のほぼ中央に位置する紀伊山地には、熊野三山、弘法山、吉野大峰の三つの聖地があります。自然崇拝に根ざした神道、中国から伝わり日本独自に発展した仏教、両者を融合させた修験道など、さまざまな信仰が育まれてきました。2004年7月、これら三つの聖地とそれを結ぶ巡礼路、そして自然と人間の活動によって長い時間をかけて形成された文化的景観が、ユネスコによって人類共有の資産として認識され、「紀伊山地の聖地と巡礼路」として世界遺産に登録されました。

■熊野古道と松本峠：松本峠は、伊勢から熊野へ向かう巡礼者が歩いた熊野古道/伊勢路の最後の峠です。巡礼者たちは、熊野への長い旅を思い、熊野三山や七里御浜の海岸を見渡しながら何を考え、何を祈っていたのでしょうか。ここでは、古の巡礼者たちのように、山と海の景色を楽しむことができます。

【日本刀】
日本刀とは、日本独自の鍛冶法で作られた鉄の刀を指します。武器として使用されるだけでなく、天皇や武士の権威の象徴でもあり、現代では文化財や芸術作品としても見られています。日本刀の材料として使用される玉鋼は、「たたら製鉄」法で生産された鋼です。鉄鉱砂を原料とし、木炭を燃料として、粘土炉で比較的低温で還元して高純度の鉄を生産します。日本では、近世初期までほぼすべての国内鉄生産がこの方法で行われていました。

title: Iga Kumihimo - Traditional Japanese Braiding Technique
description: Kumihimo is a Japanese traditional craft that mainly uses thin silk or cotton threads. Like knitting and weaving, it is considered a type of textile technology, and during the Edo period, it was actively produced as a decoration for samurai swords. Currently, they are developing new Iga kumihimo products such as straps that match the current lifestyle, as well as accessories such as kimono obijime, which is attracting attention from overseas as traditional Japanese culture. The characteristic of Iga Kumihimo is the beauty that each silk thread dyed in various colors shines in the light and intertwines with each other.

title: 伊賀組紐 - 伝統的な日本の編み技術
description: 組紐は、主に細い絹糸や綿糸を使用する日本の伝統工芸です。編み物や織物と同様に、繊維技術の一種と見なされ、江戸時代には武士の刀の装飾品として積極的に生産されていました。現在では、現代のライフスタイルに合ったストラップや、海外から注目を集めている伝統的な日本文化の一部である着物の帯締めなどの新しい伊賀組紐製品が開発されています。伊賀組紐の特徴は、さまざまな色に染められた絹糸が光の中で輝き合い、互いに絡み合う美しさです。

title: Kumiko - Traditional DecorativeWoodcraft
description: Kumiko is one of the traditional Japanese woodworking techniques and is done by assembling wood without using nails and applying geometric patterns. It is said to have developed in the Muromachi Period, along with Shoin-zukuri, and is used for Fusuma(sliding doors) that divide rooms in Japanese houses and for decorating rooms. A piece of lumber is cut into pieces as small as 1.5mm, and cuts and projections are made to join the pieces together to create a pattern. More than 100,000 pieces of wood may be used for one pattern, and each piece is assembled by hand by craftsmen. In Addition, there are hundreds of types of patterns and by combining them, beautiful and unique works can be created.

title: 組子 - 伝統的な装飾木工
description: 組子は、日本の伝統的な木工技術の一つで、釘を使わずに木を組み立て、幾何学模様を施す技法です。室町時代に発展したと言われており、和室の間仕切りである襖や部屋の装飾に使用されます。木材は1.5mmの小さな部品に切り分けられ、部品を組み合わせるために切り込みや突起が作られ、模様が形成されます。1つの模様には10万以上の木片が使用され、各部品は職人によって手作業で組み立てられます。また、数百種類の模様があり、それらを組み合わせることで美しくユニークな作品が作り出されます。

title: Seki Post Town & Okeju Workshop - The Curved Beauty of Traditonal Japanese Woodcraft Oke
description: An 'Oke' is a wooden non-sealed container widely used in Japan during the Edo Period, as it was closely connected to people's daily lives. A barrel, which is often thought to be the same thing, refers to a 'sealed wooden container' and is used in places such as Europe for the purpose of transporting food and storing (aging) wine. The lumber used is around 100 years old and the Oke itself is said to have a service life of 100 years. In recent years it has been replaced by plastics which can be mass-produced, thus Oke craftsman who do all of the more than 30 processes by hand are becoming rare, and it has become a very valuable existence.

title: 関宿と桶樽工房 - 伝統的な日本の木工の曲線美
description: 「桶」とは、江戸時代に日本で広く使用されていた木製の非密封容器であり、人々の日常生活と密接に関連していました。バレルは、しばしば同じものと考えられますが、「密封された木製容器」を指し、ヨーロッパでは食品の輸送やワインの保存（熟成）に使用されます。使用される木材は約100年前のもので、桶自体は100年の耐用年数があると言われています。近年、量産可能なプラスチックに取って代わられ、手作業で30以上の工程を行う桶職人は珍しくなり、非常に貴重な存在となっています。

title: Learning About Pearl Culture in Mie - Mikimoto pearl island / Pearl Miki
description: Since Kokichi Mikimoto invented a method of culturing pearl oysters in 1893, pearl farming in Mie prefecture has developed around Ago Bay and has gained a reputation as the birthplace of pearl farming. Pearl farming requires cultivating grounds with different conditions depending on the process, but during the period when the oysters grow their pearls, the water temperature should be above 13 degrees Celsius, plankton be abundant and the tides flow well. As well the waves must be calm which matches well with the conditions of Ago Bay. As such there are many pearl farms around the area.

title: 三重県の真珠文化について学ぶ - ミキモト真珠島 / パールミキ
description: 1893年に御木本幸吉が真珠貝の養殖法を発明して以来、三重県の真珠養殖は阿児湾を中心に発展し、真珠養殖の発祥地としての評判を得ています。真珠養殖には、プロセスに応じて異なる条件の養殖場が必要ですが、貝が真珠を育てる期間中は水温が13度以上で、プランクトンが豊富で、潮の流れが良い必要があります。また、波が穏やかであることが求められ、これは阿児湾の条件とよく合っています。そのため、この地域には多くの真珠養殖場があります。

title: Senjuji Temple - Spiritual Experience with Temple Monks
description: Senjuji is the head temple of the Takada sect of Shinshu Buddhism, with more than 600 temples nationwide. It is a temple that directly inherits the teachings of founder Shinran Shonin, and his remains are protected in the mausoleum within the precincts. In addition to Mie prefecture’s first National Treasure buildings, Nyorai-do Hall and Miei-do Hall, there are many national treasures and nationally designated important cultural properties. In the precincts, you can enjoy more than 100 pots of 35 kinds of lotus flowers, which are said to bloom in the Pure Land, from the beginning of summer to the end.

title: 千寿寺 - 僧侶との精神的体験
description: 千寿寺は、全国に600以上の寺院を持つ高田宗の本山で、創始者親鸞聖人の教えを直接受け継いでいる寺院です。境内には彼の遺骨が納められた霊廟があります。三重県初の国宝建築である如来堂と三重堂の他にも、多くの国宝や国指定重要文化財があります。境内では、初夏から晩夏にかけて、浄土に咲くと言われる35種類の蓮の花が100鉢以上楽しめます。

title: Akame 48 Falls - Retreat Program at the Historical Training Grounds of Ninjas
description: Akame 48 Waterfalls is a deep mountain valley created by the clear stream of the Taki River and deep forests. The approximately 3.3km circuit path that connects the waterfalls is a promenade where you can see the waterfalls in the vivid scenery of the four seasons, such as cherry blossoms, fresh greenery and autumn leaves. It has been selected as one of the best waters of the Heisei Period, 100 top waterfalls in Japan, 100 of the best forests for forest therapy, and 100 of the best walking trails, so you can enjoy nature in multiple ways such as hiking, strolling and forest therapy. Also, even if you take in all Akame 48 Waterfalls, you can easily enjoy it in around 3 hours round trip.

title: 赤目48滝 - 忍者の歴史的訓練場でのリトリートプログラム
description: 赤目48滝は、滝川の清流と深い森によって作られた深い山の谷です。滝をつなぐ約3.3kmのサーキット道は、桜の花、新緑、秋の葉など、四季の鮮やかな景色の中で滝を見ることができる散策路です。平成時代の名水、全国の滝100選、森林療法のための名森100選、歩道100選の一つに選ばれており、ハイキング、散策、森林療法など、さまざまな方法で自然を楽しむことができます。また、赤目48滝をすべて楽しんでも、往復約3時間で簡単に楽しむことができます。
