title: 平櫛田中の庭  - Japanese garden of Hirakushi Denchū  -
description: 今年も春がやってきました。彫刻家・平櫛田中がこの地に移り住んできたのは、九十八歳の時でした。それから先、二十年、三十年と彫刻を掘るために、クスノキを買って、周囲を驚かせました。もしかしたら、平櫛田中は、今でもこの庭を眺めながら、彫刻を掘り続けているのかもしれません。その優雅で且つ、力強いこの景色から、何にも屈することのない平櫛田中の息遣いが聞こえるような気がします。

title: Japanese garden of Hirakushi Denchū - 平櫛田中の庭
description: Spring has come again this year. The sculptor Hirakushi Denchū moved to this place at the age of ninety-eight. Since then, for twenty or thirty years, he surprised those around him by buying camphor trees to carve sculptures. Perhaps Hirakushi Denchū is still continuing to carve sculptures while gazing at this garden. From this elegant yet powerful scenery, I feel as if I can hear the breath of Hirakushi Denchū, who does not succumb to anything.

title: 【絶景茨城】神磯の鳥居-茨城県大洗町磯前神社｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description: 神が降り立った地・神磯に立つ鳥居は海岸沿いの高台にある大洗磯前神社の鳥居の一つです。大洗磯前神社は856年創建とされる由緒ある神社で古くから家内安全・海上交通の守り神として信仰を集めています。鳥居が朝日に照らされた太平洋の荒波が岩礁に当たり白く砕ける瞬間はまさに神々しい光景です。

title: 【Scenic Ibaraki】Torii at Kamiso - Isozaki Shrine in Oarai Town, Ibaraki Prefecture
description: The torii gate standing in Kamiso, the land where gods descended, is one of the torii gates of Isozaki Shrine located on a high ground along the coast. Isozaki Shrine, believed to have been founded in 856, has long been revered as a guardian deity for family safety and maritime traffic. The moment when the torii gate is illuminated by the morning sun and the rough waves of the Pacific crash against the reefs, creating white foam, is truly a divine sight.

title: 【絶景茨城】鹿島神宮 | VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description: Kashima Shrineは、日本建国・武道の神様である武甕槌大神を御祭神とする、神武天皇元年創建の由緒ある神社です。現在の社殿は徳川二代将軍の秀忠により、また奥宮は徳川家康、楼門は水戸初代藩主徳川頼房により奉納されたもので、いずれも重要文化財に指定されています。奥参道を進むと奥宮、鹿園、要石、御手洗池なども見ることが出来ます。

title: Kashima Shrine | VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: Kashima Shrine is a historic shrine founded in the first year of Emperor Jinmu, dedicated to the deity Takemikazuchi no Kami, the god of Japan's founding and martial arts. The current shrine buildings were donated by Tokugawa Ieyasu, the second shogun Tokugawa Hidetada, and the first lord of Mito, Tokugawa Yorifusa, and are all designated as important cultural properties. As you proceed along the inner approach, you can also see the inner shrine, deer park, key stone, and purification pond.

title: 御岩神社【絶景茨城】
description: 常陸国最古の霊山と言われている御岩山の麓に鎮座する御岩神社。鳥居から少し歩くと日立市一の大きさと言われている御神木「三本杉」が現れます。また、縄文時代から人々の信仰の地であった御岩山には188の神々が宿るとされており、今も多くの人々が訪れます。

title: Oiwa Shrine【Scenic Ibaraki】
description: Oiwa Shrine is located at the foot of Oiwa Mountain, said to be the oldest sacred mountain in Hitachi Province. A short walk from the torii gate leads to the sacred tree 'Sanbon-sugi', which is said to be the largest in Hitachi City. Oiwa Mountain has been a place of worship since the Jomon period, and it is believed to house 188 deities, attracting many visitors even today.

title: 【絶景茨城】雨引観音［4K］茨城県桜川市｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:

title: Kashima Rinkai Industrial Zone | VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: Shooting date: 2016.02.08 / 2016.02.25. The Kashima Rinkai Industrial Zone spreads across the southeastern tip of Ibaraki Prefecture. I captured the landscape of the massive factory clusters from various angles. Enjoy the breathtaking views that change from day to night.

title: 【絶景茨城】水郷桜イルミネーション｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
撮影日 2015.12.10
茨城県内の代表的なイルミネーションの一つ、土浦市の霞ヶ浦総合公園で行われる「水郷桜イルミネーション」。冬の透き通った空気の中で輝く土浦ならではの光のアートをお楽しみください。

title: Ibaraki's Scenic View: Water City Cherry Blossom Illumination
description:
Date of shooting: December 10, 2015
One of the representative illuminations in Ibaraki Prefecture, the 'Water City Cherry Blossom Illumination' held at Kasumigaura Comprehensive Park in Tsuchiura City. Enjoy the light art unique to Tsuchiura shining in the clear winter air.

title: 【絶景茨城】里美の星空｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
撮影日 2015.10.13／2015.12.16
茨城県常陸太田市の里美地区。高原に位置しているため、空気が澄み、天気が良く月の無い夜には満天の星空を見る事ができます。天体観測施設を備えた宿泊施設「プラトーさとみ」にて星の絶景を収めました。

title: Ibaraki's Spectacular Starry Sky | VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
Shooting date: 2015.10.13 / 2015.12.16
The Satomi area in Hitachiota City, Ibaraki Prefecture. Located on a plateau, the air is clear, and on clear nights without the moon, you can see a sky full of stars. Captured the spectacular stars at the accommodation facility 'Plateau Satomi' equipped with an astronomical observation facility.

title: 【絶景茨城】袋田の滝 氷瀑｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description:
日本三大名瀑のひとつに数えられる「袋田の滝」。寒さの厳しい冬には滝全体が真っ白に凍結する姿を見せてくれます。

さらに、大子町の風物詩となった「大子来人～ダイゴライト～」では、自然と光が作り出す神秘の空間が、「袋田の滝」の新たな魅力を発見させてくれます。

title: 【絶景茨城】袋田の滝 氷瀑｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description:
One of Japan's three great waterfalls, 'Fukuroda Falls' shows its entire frozen form in the harsh winter cold.

Additionally, the 'Daigo Light' event, which has become a local tradition in Daigo Town, reveals a new charm of 'Fukuroda Falls' through the mystical space created by nature and light.

title: 【絶景茨城】牛久大仏 ［4K］茨城県牛久市｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description: Ushiku Great Buddha is a project led by the Higashi Honganji sect of Jodo Shinshu. The founder of Jodo Shinshu is Shinran Shonin (1173-1262). Shinran was exiled to Echigo Province in 1207 due to the anger of Emperor Go-Toba. After being pardoned four years later, he entered Hitachi Province (now Ibaraki Prefecture) and established a base for propagation in the Kanto region. Many temples and historical sites related to Shinran remain in the prefecture, and Ushiku is one of them. The project began in 1983, construction started in 1986, and it was completed in December 1992. The project is led by the Higashi Honganji sect of Jodo Shinshu. Its form is an enlarged version of the Amida Nyorai statue, which is the main object of worship of this sect. It boasts a total height of 120m (100m for the statue and 20m for the pedestal), nearly three times the height of the Great Buddha of Nara (14.98m) and the effective height of the Statue of Liberty in New York, USA (93m total height, 46.05m for the statue in a raised hand position, and 33.86m from feet to top of the head).

description: The 'Hina Matsuri on the Hundred Steps' is held every year on the approach to the Juuniso Shrine in Daigo Town, Ibaraki Prefecture. The hina dolls provided from all over the country are filled with various histories, and each one is full of individuality. In the retro townscape that remains, tiered displays and hina decorations are lined up in front of various shops and houses in the shopping district. On the same day, a bridal procession takes place on the street in front of the station, where newlyweds walk through the town.

title: 【絶景茨城】偕楽園  梅｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: KairakuenはKanazawaのKenrokuen、OkayamaのKorakuenとともに日本三名園のひとつに数えられており、毎年2月から3月にかけて「Mito Plum Festival」が開催されます。園内には約100品種3000本もの梅があり、春の訪れを告げるかのように可憐に咲き競います。様々な品種があるため「早咲き」「中咲き」「遅咲き」と長期間にわたり観梅を楽しむことができるのも魅力です。

title: 【Scenic Ibaraki】Kairakuen Plum Blossoms｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: Kairakuen is counted as one of Japan's three famous gardens along with Kenrokuen in Kanazawa and Korakuen in Okayama, and the 'Mito Plum Festival' is held every year from February to March. The garden has about 3,000 plum trees of approximately 100 varieties, blooming delicately as if to announce the arrival of spring. The variety of types allows visitors to enjoy plum viewing over a long period with 'early bloomers', 'mid bloomers', and 'late bloomers'.

title: 【絶景茨城】山桜｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: In Sakura City, Ibaraki Prefecture, approximately 550,000 mountain cherry trees grow naturally, creating a patchwork landscape of pale pink cherry blossoms and fresh green trees. Around Isobe Sakuragawa Park, you can see about 550 cherry trees. The area including Sakuragawa Isobe Inamura Shrine and the park is designated as a national scenic spot, and the cherry trees in the shrine and park are designated as national natural monuments.

title: 【Scenic Ibaraki】Mountain Cherry Blossoms｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: 茨城県桜川市内の里山には約55万本の山桜が自生しており、淡紅色の桜花ともえぎ色に芽吹く木々が重なり、パッチワークのような風景をみることができます。磯部桜川公園周辺では約550本の桜を見ることができます。櫻川磯部稲村神社や公園を含んだ周辺一帯は国の名勝に指定されており、神社及び公園にある桜が国の天然記念物に指定されています。

title: 【日本三名園】偕楽園 茨城県水戸市｜絶景茨城 -VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN-
description:
撮影日 2016.03.08
日本三名園の一つ「偕楽園」。
水戸藩第九代藩主・徳川斉昭公によって創設されました。

都市公園としては、ニューヨーク市のセントラルパークに次いで世界第2位の面積を誇ります。
早春には約100品種、3,000本の梅の花が咲き誇り、梅の名所としても知られています。

表門から一の木戸を抜けると、孟宗竹利、大杉森、クマザサが茂る幽遠閑寂な「陰の世界」が広がります。
そして、その先に繋がるのは、好文亭が現れ見晴らしが良い「陽の世界」。
「陰」から「陽」へ、正しい順路で歩くと、偕楽園本来の姿を知ることができます。

詳細はこちら
https://ibaraki-kairakuen.jp/

もっと茨城の観光地を見たい方は
http://www.ibakira.tv/archive/visitibaraki/

title: Kairakuen, One of Japan's Three Famous Gardens, Mito City, Ibaraki Prefecture | Stunning Ibaraki -VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN-
description:
Date of shooting: 2016.03.08
Kairakuen, one of Japan's three famous gardens, was established by the ninth lord of the Mito domain, Tokugawa Nariaki.

It boasts the second largest area in the world for an urban park, following Central Park in New York City.
In early spring, about 100 varieties and 3,000 plum trees bloom, making it well-known as a plum blossom spot.

Passing through the main gate and the first gate, you enter a serene 'world of shadows' filled with bamboo, large cedar trees, and kumazasa.
Beyond that lies the 'world of light' with the Kobuntei pavilion offering a great view.
Walking the correct route from 'shadow' to 'light' allows you to understand the true nature of Kairakuen.

For more details, visit
https://ibaraki-kairakuen.jp/

If you want to see more tourist spots in Ibaraki,
http://www.ibakira.tv/archive/visitibaraki/

title: 【絶景茨城】ハス田｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description:
In Ibaraki Prefecture, which boasts the highest production of lotus root in Japan, lotus flowers can be seen blooming around Kasumigaura from July to August. The lotus flowers blooming beside the vast lake captivate people along with the sunlight shining on the lake's surface.

In autumn, the leaves turn brown and begin to wither. During the harvesting of lotus root, a method called 'water digging' is employed to bring the lotus root to the surface. Care is taken to wash off the mud gently after digging it up to avoid damaging the skin of the lotus root. Its plump, dumpling-like shape and soft texture, along with a hint of sweetness, are its charms.

Thanks to the abundant water resources and fertile soil of Kasumigaura, delicious lotus roots loved throughout Japan are cultivated.

description: 2021年4月にリニューアルした「いばらきフラワーパーク」では、県花のバラ900品種をはじめ様々な花を五感で楽しむことができます。バラ、アジサイ、ヒマワリ、ダリア、コスモス、そして冬のイルミネーションまで春夏秋冬それぞれの見どころをご覧ください。

description: At the 'Ibaraki Flower Park', which was renovated in April 2021, you can enjoy various flowers with all five senses, including 900 varieties of the prefectural flower, roses. Please enjoy the highlights of each season: roses, hydrangeas, sunflowers, dahlias, cosmos, and winter illuminations.

title: 【絶景茨城】アクアワールド 茨城県大洗水族館｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description: Ibarakiの海を再現。水量1,300tを誇る「出会いの海の大水槽」では80種類20,000匹の魚たちと出会えます。水族館のシンボルにもなっているサメは飼育種類数、日本一です。国内最大のマンボウ専用水槽でのんびりと泳ぐマンボウたちにも出会えます。

title: 【Breathtaking Ibaraki】 Aqua World Ibaraki Prefectural Oarai Aquarium
description: Recreating the sea of Ibaraki. In the 'Encounter Sea Large Tank' boasting a water volume of 1,300 tons, you can meet 80 species and 20,000 fish. The sharks, which have become the symbol of the aquarium, have the largest number of species in Japan. You can also meet the sunfish swimming leisurely in the largest sunfish tank in the country.

title: 【絶景茨城】ネモフィラ 国営ひたち海浜公園 ｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description: 広大なみはらしの丘で、約530万本のネモフィラが海から吹く風にその身を揺らしています。例年見ごろは4月中旬から5月上旬。一面に広がる青の絶景を楽しむことができます。

title: 【Spectacular Ibaraki】Nemophila Hitachi Seaside Park ｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: On the vast hill of Mihara, about 5.3 million nemophilas sway in the wind blowing from the sea. The best viewing period is from mid-April to early May, where you can enjoy a spectacular view of blue spreading all around.

title: 【絶景茨城】霞ヶ浦（かすみがうら）-帆引き船｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description: 霞ヶ浦（かすみがうら）は国内第2位の湖面積を持つ湖。その流域面積は茨城県全体の1/3以上を占めています。冬には多くの渡り鳥が飛来します。また、深度は平均4mと浅くワカサギ、コイ、ハゼの他最近では外来魚のブルーギル、ブラックバスも生息しており、釣り場としても有名で太公望が全国から訪れます。この他、150種の野鳥や水生植物の宝庫で豊かな自然に恵まれています。夏には観光帆引き船が運航され、湖面を渡る風を受け真っ白な帆をいっぱいに張って進む「帆引き船」の勇壮な姿は霞ヶ浦の風物詩です。

title: 【絶景茨城】竜神峡・竜神大吊橋 ［4K］茨城県常陸太田市｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN

title: 【祝・日本ジオパーク認定／絶景茨城】筑波山 ｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description: 昔から「西の富士、東の筑波」と愛称され、朝夕に山肌の色を変えるところから「紫峰」とも呼ばれている筑波山。男体山と女体山の２つの峰を持ち､古くから信仰の山として栄えてきました。筑波山への登山道には、道標や土蔵造りの町並みなど、江戸時代の面影を残す歴史の町も楽しむことができ、登山・ハイキイングなど年間を通して自然に親しめるのが魅力です。また、ケーブルカー、ロープウェイを使えば簡単に山頂にたどり着くことができ､子どもからお年寄りまで､だれもが美しい眺望を楽しむことができます。

title: 【祝・日本ジオパーク認定／絶景茨城】筑波山 ｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description: Tsukuba Mountain, affectionately known as 'West Fuji, East Tsukuba' and also called 'Purple Peak' for its changing colors at dawn and dusk, features two peaks: Nantai Mountain and Nyotai Mountain. It has long been a revered mountain. The hiking trails to Tsukuba Mountain allow visitors to enjoy historical towns that retain the atmosphere of the Edo period, with signposts and traditional storehouses. The mountain offers year-round opportunities for hiking and enjoying nature. Additionally, with the use of cable cars and ropeways, anyone from children to the elderly can easily reach the summit and enjoy the beautiful views.

title: 【絶景茨城／日本遺産】弘道館［4K］茨城県水戸市｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
【Shooting date: 2015.5.27】
Kodokan, a nationally designated special historic site and important cultural property located in Mito City, Ibaraki Prefecture. Established in 1842 by the 9th lord of the Mito domain, Tokugawa Nariaki, it is the largest domain school in Japan. The last shogun, Tokugawa Yoshinobu, also studied here during his childhood and spent his life in confinement after the restoration of imperial rule. This time, we were able to capture footage of parts that are usually not seen, such as the actual 'bird's-eye view' (choukanzu), the interior of the Confucius Temple, and the Kodokan monument housed in the Hakkeido.

description:
【Shooting date 2015.11.17】
Ibaraki Prefecture's representative autumn foliage spots, Hanakuni Valley (Takahagi City), Ryujin Big Suspension Bridge (Hitachiota City), Eigenji and Fukuroda Falls (Daigo Town), and Hanazono Valley (Kitaibaraki City) are captured in stunning autumn scenery. 【撮影日 2015.11.17】
茨城県の代表的な紅葉スポット、花貫渓谷（高萩市）、竜神大吊橋（常陸太田市）、永源寺・袋田の滝（大子町）、花園渓谷（北茨城市）の秋の絶景を収めました。
鮮やかな赤と黄色で彩られた茨城の秋をご堪能ください。

title: 【絶景茨城】大杉神社 大杉祭（あんばまち）　茨城県稲敷市｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
【Shooting date 2015.10.25】
Far back in history, Oosugi Shrine has been revered as 'Anba-sama' and is still known for its miracles and traditions, recognized as Japan's only 'Yume Musubi Daimyojin'. Please take a look at the lively procession and the traditional performing art 'Anba Bayashi' that the local people cherish during the autumn festival, Oosugi Festival, also known as 'Anbamachi'.

title: 【Spectacular Ibaraki】Oosugi Shrine Oosugi Festival (Anbamachi) Ibaraki Prefecture Inashiki City
description:
【撮影日 2015.10.25】
はるか昔から「あんばさま」として人々の信仰を集め、今なお語り継がれている奇跡や伝­承から日本唯一の「夢むすび大明神」としても知られる茨城県稲敷市の大杉神社。
「あんばまち」とも呼ばれる秋の大祭、大杉祭での華やかな行列や、伝統芸能「あんば囃子」を­地元の人達が親しんでいる様子をご覧ください。

title: 【絶景茨城】紫陽花 雨引観音 ｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description: 桜川市の雨引観音では、毎年6月10日～7月20日に「あじさい祭り」を行っています。約100種5,000株のあじさいが境内やその周辺を埋め尽くし、色鮮やかに彩ります。期間限定で夜になるとあじさいを池に浮かべ、ライトアップを行っています。

title: 【Scenic Ibaraki】Hydrangea Amabiki Kannon ｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: At Amabiki Kannon in Sakuragawa City, the 'Hydrangea Festival' is held every year from June 10 to July 20. About 5,000 hydrangeas of 100 varieties fill the temple grounds and surrounding areas, creating a colorful spectacle. During the limited period, hydrangeas are floated on the pond at night, and a light-up event is held.

title: 【絶景茨城】コキア｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: 【撮影日 2015.8.12/2015.10.20】国営ひたち海浜公園、コキアの夏と秋の様子を収めました。夏の昼間には爽やかな緑色、夜にはライトアッップ（期間限定）でカラフルに彩られ、秋にはその身を深紅に染める美しいコキアの絶景をお楽しみください。

title: 【絶景茨城】コキア｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: Captured the summer and autumn scenery of Kochia at Hitachi Seaside Park. Enjoy the beautiful Kochia, which is a refreshing green during the day in summer, colorful at night with limited-time lighting, and deep red in autumn.

title: 【絶景茨城／関東三大祭】常陸國總社宮例大祭｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: The Hitachi Kuni Sosha Shrine Grand Festival, also known as the 'Ishioka Festival', is counted among the three major festivals of the Kanto region. It features a large lion head that has become a symbol of Ishioka City. The festival includes the prefecturally designated intangible folk cultural assets 'Sasara' and 'Ishioka Bayashi'. Enjoy the grandeur of this magnificent festival, which attracts hundreds of thousands of tourists from across the country.

title: 【Spectacular Ibaraki】Hitachi Seaside Park | Nemophila
description: A must-visit before you die! One of the world's spectacular views that Japan is proud of is the Nemophila Harmony at the National Hitachi Seaside Park in Hitachinaka City, Ibaraki Prefecture. As the wind from the sea sways the flowers, the blue of the nemophila blends with the blue of the sky, filling your view with a vivid blue. Enjoy the unique blue scenery that can only be found here in the world.

title: 【絶景茨城】潮来祇園祭禮｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: The Itako Gion Festival, with a history and tradition of over 800 years, is held in early August (for three days) every year. The 14 donated floats, which convey the craftsmanship of the Edo and Meiji periods, are carefully managed as treasures of each town. The sight of the young men, floats, and performing arts group coming together in a display called 'Kurubiki' is breathtaking.

"Kamune Park" in Hitachi City, Ibaraki Prefecture, and "Heiwa Street" in front of Hitachi Station have been selected as one of Japan's top 100 cherry blossom spots. 茨城県日立市にある「かみね公園」と日立駅前「平和通り」は日本のさくら名所百選にも選出されています。海と山の間を駆け抜ける風が美しい桜の花を揺らし,その街に生きる人々の生活を彩り,茨城県内外から観光客を魅きつけて街を賑やかにします。毎年春には日立さくらまつりが開催され,ユネスコ無形文化遺産に登録された山車「日立風流物」が桜の景色に迫力を与えます。詳細はこちら

Enjoy the cherry blossom scenery blooming in various places, including the 180-year-old weeping cherry tree at Rokujizō-ji, in 4K. Additionally, the 'Mito Cherry Blossom Festival' will be held at multiple venues, including the cherry blossom spots introduced this time.

description:
【Shooting date: April 2, 2015】

Tsukuba Mirai City is home to one of the three major weirs in Kanto, the Fukuoka Weir. Fukuoka Weir is also famous as a cherry blossom spot, and every year the 'Fukuoka Weir Cherry Blossom Festival' is held. It has been selected as one of the 100 best tourist attractions in Ibaraki, and you can see a tunnel of cherry blossoms with about 600 trees blooming along a 1.8 km promenade.

西塩子の回り舞台【絶景茨城 】
description: 「西塩子の回り舞台」は茨城県の山里に江戸時代から続く農村歌舞伎の舞台で、現存する回り舞台としては日本で最も古い年代に属しています。一度は公演が途絶えた時期もあったものの、地域住民の努力により1997年に半世紀ぶりに復元しました。現在では3年に一度の開催（2025年はコロナ禍を経て6年ぶりの開催）となっています。この舞台は、毎回組み立てては解体する点が最大の特徴。地域住民総出で丸太と竹を組み立て、一夜限りの大舞台を出現させます。

title: Nishi Shio Ko's Rotating Stage【Scenic Ibaraki】
description: The 'Nishi Shio Ko's Rotating Stage' is a rural kabuki stage that has been in existence since the Edo period in the mountainous area of Ibaraki Prefecture, and it belongs to the oldest existing rotating stages in Japan. Although there was a period when performances ceased, it was restored in 1997 after half a century due to the efforts of local residents. Currently, it is held once every three years (the 2025 event will be the first in six years after the COVID-19 pandemic). The biggest feature of this stage is that it is assembled and disassembled each time. Local residents come together to construct a large stage using logs and bamboo for a one-night-only performance.

title: 【ふるさとCM大賞NARA2025】天川村「心の深呼吸」
description:
【Description】
In Tenka Village, a sacred place of Shugendo, we produced a video inviting viewers to a quiet mountain climbing experience that allows for a deep and slow 'deep breathing of the heart.' With each step up the mountain, we aimed to express the feeling of having one's heart cleansed, and the moment of liberation as one gazes at the breathtaking view from the summit. Why not find a special time in Tenka Village to step away from the noise of everyday life, face yourself, and refresh from the depths of your heart?

title: Furusato CM Grand Prize NARA 2025: Tenka Village 'Deep Breathing of the Heart'
description:
【作品概要】
修験道の聖地でもある天川村で、深く、ゆっくりと「心の深呼吸」をするような静寂の登山体験へ誘う動画を制作しました。一歩一歩、山を登るごとに心が洗われていくような感覚、そして山頂から広がる絶景に心が解き放たれる瞬間が表現できるよう心がけました。日常の喧騒を離れ、自分自身と向き合い、心の奥底からリフレッシュできる特別な時間を天川村で見つけてみませんか？

title: 🌸 Edo: The Foundation of Modern Tokyo
description: Edo, the predecessor of Tokyo, grew into one of the world’s largest cities of its time. From the daily lives of its people blossomed a rich and unique culture—both tangible and intangible. Edo embraced elegance, flourished its culture, and welcomed diverse ideas and values. Arising from its openness, limitless imagination and daring ambition to take on challenges breathed life into the city. The heart of Edo flows continuously through Tokyo today. Shining its present and its future.

title: 🌸 江戸：現代東京の基盤
description: 江戸は東京の前身であり、当時の世界最大の都市の一つに成長しました。人々の日常生活から、豊かで独自の文化が花開きました—有形無形の両方で。江戸は優雅さを受け入れ、文化を栄えさせ、多様なアイデアや価値観を歓迎しました。その開放性から生まれた無限の想像力と挑戦する大胆な野心がこの街に命を吹き込みました。江戸の心は今日の東京を通じて流れ続けています。現在と未来を輝かせています。

title: The Sento Spirt since Edo Period.

title: 江戸時代からの銭湯の精神
description: 銭湯の説明。

title: Tokyo's Green Urban Development since Edo Period
description: Tokyo is always evolving. For over 400 years since the Edo period, the city has preserved its green spaces. I research urban design by observing pedestrians and speaking with residents and business owners. These green spaces are important for a happy city life. This mindset hasn’t changed since the Edo period. They help foster an enjoyable life where people can thrive. 100 years from now, we'll still make sure Tokyo is sustainable and exists in harmony with nature.

title: 江戸時代以来の東京の緑の都市開発
description: 東京は常に進化しています。江戸時代以来400年以上にわたり、都市は緑地を保護してきました。私は歩行者を観察し、住民や事業主と話すことで都市デザインを研究しています。これらの緑地は、幸せな都市生活にとって重要です。この考え方は江戸時代から変わっていません。人々が繁栄できる楽しい生活を育むのに役立ちます。100年後も、東京が持続可能で自然と調和して存在し続けることを確実にします。

title: Enchanting Tokyo  - Is this really Tokyo? -  Volcano Island OSHIMA  (Full ver.) / 絶景！大島 三原山火口をドローン空撮
description:
大島島
東京都心から高速ジェット船で最短1時間45分。間近で見ることのできる三原山の火口、広大な「砂漠」、海面から突き出た岩「筆島」などのダイナミックな景観と、自転車、キャンプなど豊かな自然の中で楽しむアクティビティ。魅力あふれる大島でお待ちしています。

title: 魅惑の東京 - これは本当に東京ですか？ - 火山島大島（フルバージョン） / 絶景！大島三原山火口をドローン空撮
description:
OSHIMA Island
1 hour 45 minutes (minimum) from central Tokyo by high-speed jet ferry. Enjoy the island’s dynamic scenery, with views such as Mt. Mihara, the volcanic crater you can see close, a vast ‘desert’ and ‘Fudeshima’, the brush-like rock protruding from the sea surface. Be it camping or cycling, there are activities for you to immerse yourself in the rich nature of the island. Full of charm, Oshima Island is waiting to enchant you.

title: Enchanting Tokyo HACHIJOJIMA Island (Full ver.)／八丈島
description: Hachijojima Island, which is less than an hour’s flight from Tokyo, is an island where you can enjoy the great outdoors. With one of the highest precipitation rates in Japan, Hachijojima has its own unique environment including giant ferns and potholes carved into the rock by ever-flowing spring water. On the island, you can enjoy hiking as well as running and fishing. After enjoying physical activities, visitors can relax in a natural hot spring surrounded by rich nature, making it the perfect environment for a refreshing weekend getaway.

title: Enchanting Tokyo HACHIJOJIMA Island (Full ver.)／八丈島
description: 八丈島は、東京から飛行機で1時間弱で到着する、大自然と向き合える島です。日本でも降水量がトップクラスとなる八丈島は、巨大なシダ植物や、枯れることのない湧水によって岩盤が削られたポットホールなど独自の自然を育んでいます。島ではトレッキングはもちろんランニングや釣りなども楽しめます。身体を動かすアクティビティを楽しんだ後は、豊かな自然に囲まれた天然温泉でリラックスすることができ、週末のリフレッシュには最適な環境です。

title: Enchanting Tokyo AOGASHIMA Island (Full ver.)／青ヶ島
description: 青ヶ島は、東京の都市部から南に358キロメートル（222マイル）離れた太平洋上に位置し、アメリカのNGOによって「死ぬまでに見るべき世界の絶景13選」に日本で唯一選ばれ、世界中から注目を集めています。動画「魅惑の東京 青ヶ島」では、世界的に有名な二重カルデラや地熱による「ひんぎゃ」蒸気噴出など、独特の景観を紹介しています。また、自然と調和して共存する島の生活や信仰についても探ります。

title: 魅惑の東京 青ヶ島（フルバージョン）
description: Aogashima Island, located 358 kilometers (222 miles) south of urban Tokyo in the Pacific Ocean, was the only Japanese location selected as the “World’s Top 13 Most Beautiful Views to See Before you Die” by a US-based NGO, thereby attracting attention from around the world. The video “Enchanting Tokyo AOGASHIMA Island” introduces the unique landscape of the island, including the world-famous double caldera and geothermic “hingya” steam eruptions. The video also explores the island’s way of life and beliefs that coexist in harmony with nature.

title: Enchanting Tokyo　7-Minute Miracle/7分間の奇跡
description: Dateline Tokyoのジャーナリスト、チャーリー・ジェームズが新幹線の清掃クルーの舞台裏に潜入し、彼らの「7分間の奇跡」のターンアラウンドを撮影しました。

title: Enchanting Tokyo 7-Minute Miracle/7分間の奇跡
description: An American video journalist, Charli James, who came to Japan for work, reported on what he found 'amazing and interesting' in Tokyo. One of them, Izu Oshima, is located about 120 km from Tokyo and features sea and air-port facilities, so you can arrive by a superyacht or by a private jet from Japan’s mainland to enjoy a private cruise. Izu Oshima is a volcanic island. Visitors can enjoy the crater of Mt.Mihara, Japan's only desert 'Ura-sabaku,' diving in crystal-clear waters and various other natural activities. Please experience the distinctive luxuries of Izu Oshima.

title: 【高画質】阿蘇山観音まつり
description:
On April 13, 2023, the 'Aso Mountain Kannon Festival' was held at the Saigandaji Temple in Kurokawa, Aso City, where many worshippers gathered to participate in the ascetic practices 'fire walking' and 'yudate' performed by practitioners in Yamabushi attire.

When the fire was lit on the goma altar made of cypress leaves, the practitioners solemnly chanted sutras and threw goma wood with written wishes into the fire to pray for good health. Then, the 'fire walking' was conducted, where participants walked barefoot over the burning flames.

After the fire's intensity diminished, general worshippers followed the practitioners and walked barefoot over the ashes, and finally participated in the ascetic practice 'yudate,' where they were splashed with boiling hot water to pray for a year of good health.

This Aso Mountain Kannon Festival is held annually on April 13, the anniversary of the death of the temple's priest, Churi Ryoshun, who died in the Seinan War.

description: A series of 4K camera captures of the rich natural scenery of Aso. Volume 7 features the spring delicacy 'Aso Takana'. Aso Takana is a variety of mustard plant from the Brassicaceae family, grown in Aso's unique nature with significant temperature differences and volcanic ash-rich soil. Seeds are sown in October, overwinter under snow, and harvested in March to April. The harvesting method, where each stem is bent by hand, is called 'Takana-ori'. On beautiful spring days, scenes of Takana-ori in the Takana fields are common in the Aso region. After harvesting, it is immediately pickled. By kneading salt and chili peppers, the new pickles can be enjoyed with a sharp spiciness and crunchy texture after about a week. Enjoy the sounds of the Takana-ori and the kneading process.

In Kuji City, Iwate Prefecture, the only bullfighting tournament in the Tohoku region is held. Historically, during the Edo period, salt produced in the coastal area was transported to the inland Morioka area using the native 'Nanbu Cattle' (Salt Road). It is said that bullfighting began to determine the leading bull (Wagasa) of the convoy, which led to the start of bullfighting. The event became a tourist attraction in its current form from 1983. (From Kuji City HP)

* Nanbu Cattle underwent crossbreeding with foreign breeds due to the opening of Japan in the Meiji era and was registered as the fourth Japanese beef breed, 'Nihon Tankaku-shu', in 1957.

description: 「SADO NO KIWAMI」、またはアルティメット佐渡は、佐渡に住み、佐渡を愛し、佐渡を極めた人々を通じて、佐渡の冒険観光を紹介します。滝のガイドである石塚博之は滝をよく知っており、ツアーを通じてその魅力を紹介します。彼を通じて、他では味わえない佐渡での究極の体験をお届けします！ * 冒険観光は、自然、アクティビティ、文化の3つの要素のうち少なくとも2つを含む体験を通じて、場所の魅力をより深く楽しむことができる観光の一形態です！

description: Introducing the charm of Sado's adventure tourism through people who live, love, and master Sado. description: The Shina district in the northern part of the Osado mountain range is home to uniquely shaped giant cedars. title: 【Tokyo Chuo City tourism introduction movie】歩（Walk）version (English/3min. version）
description: This is a promotional video to introduce various tourist attractions of Tokyo Chuo City. The 'Walk' version of the video shows a day in Chuo City from the perspective of a visitor, walking around and seeing the sights. It captures areas representative of Chuo City, including Nihonbashi, Ningyocho, Ginza, Tsukiji, Tsukuda and Tsukishima, from the perspective of a pedestrian on the street. Take a stroll through the varied scenes of Chuo City, feel the traditions of history and touch upon the latest trends.

title: 【東京中央区観光紹介ムービー】歩（Walk）バージョン（日本語/3分バージョン）
description: これは東京中央区のさまざまな観光名所を紹介するプロモーションビデオです。「歩」バージョンのビデオは、訪問者の視点から中央区での一日を示し、街を歩きながら景色を楽しむ様子を捉えています。日本橋、人形町、銀座、築地、佃、月島など、中央区を代表するエリアを歩行者の視点で捉えています。中央区の多様なシーンを散策し、歴史の伝統を感じ、最新のトレンドに触れてみてください。

title: 【Tokyo Chuo City tourism introduction movie】遊（Activity）version (English/3min. version）
description: This is a promotional video to introduce various tourist attractions of Tokyo Chuo City. The 'Activity' version of the video is based on the concept of special experiences, such as festivals and unique activities, that can only take place in this moment, in this place. From the festivals of the summer and fall to traditions such as paper making or Japanese lettering, the video introduces appealing content that you can only experience in this moment, in this place in such a way as to make you feel you've participated in them firsthand.

title: 【東京中央区観光紹介ムービー】遊（Activity）バージョン（日本語/3分バージョン）
description: これは東京中央区のさまざまな観光名所を紹介するプロモーションビデオです。「遊」バージョンのビデオは、今この場所でしか体験できない祭りやユニークなアクティビティなど、特別な体験のコンセプトに基づいています。夏と秋の祭りから、和紙作りや書道などの伝統まで、ビデオはこの瞬間、この場所でしか体験できない魅力的なコンテンツを紹介し、まるでそれに直接参加したかのように感じさせます。

title: 【Tokyo Chuo City tourism introduction movie】食（Food）version (English/3min. version）
description: This is a promotional video to introduce various tourist attractions of Tokyo Chuo City. The 'Food' version of the video is based on the concept of 'everything you may want to eat in Japan can be found in Chuo City.' Centered on 'Japanese food,' now registered as UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage, enjoy dishes that have existed since the Edo period, including sushi, eel, soba and tempura. The theme of food continues with the tastes of the people, such as ramen noodles and local bars, and a selection of Japanese confections. With beautiful shots of delicious food, chefs showing off their talents and sweets that'll have you salivating at just a glance, you can enjoy everything aside from actually eating the food! In Chuo City, one of the greatest gourmet cities in the world, experience a rich variety of Japanese food.

title: 【東京中央区観光紹介ムービー】Food（食）バージョン（日本語/3分バージョン）

Although it is nearing completion, it was in a no-entry state during the video shoot on October 25. This is likely a preparation period to firmly establish the works. title: うわじま牛鬼祭り 海上打上花火(2023.7.23)
description: I went to see the fireworks of the Uwajima Ushi Oni Festival. It was about 40 minutes of fireworks from 8:30 to 9:10, but during that time, the main camera had trouble and stopped recording due to overheating, making for a frustrating 40 minutes. However, I managed to stitch together the footage I captured into a video of just under 9 minutes. As for the fireworks, I thought they were generally low in position, but then they shot up to a height that far exceeded the frame, which seemed to be a challenge for those filming. I was using a 360° camera, so I didn't miss the frame, but there were many parts I had to crop in editing. The overall composition was also a bit lacking. Since it was held for the first time in several years, there might be some understandable reasons for that. I look forward to next year.

description: On the last day of April, I went to the terraced rice fields of Yuko Mizunagura. If you drive about 20 minutes from the city towards the Miura Peninsula, you will see the magnificent terraced fields. I think Uwajima City is quite promoting it, but it seems that it hasn't led to an increase in tourists. On weekends and holidays, the 'Dandan Chaya' at the bottom of the terraced fields is open, where you can enjoy meals such as Uwajima Tai Meshi (sea bream rice) (please check separately for business hours). How about feeling the eternal time in the magnificent terraced fields carved into the mountainside? At 'Dandan Chaya', they have been playing music created by the Meekan Channel as in-store music since before the creation of the CD 'KISAIYA Uwajima', so I support them.

title: 宇和島闘牛５月場所(2025.5.3)
description: One of the four big stages of the year. The Uwajima Bullfighting May Tournament took place on May 3, 2025. The rules of bullfighting are simple: bulls fight each other with no time limit, and the one that runs away loses. The weather was fine, and it was Golden Week, so the event was a huge success, with over 2,400 attendees. It was a long event lasting two and a half hours, but we have summarized the main fights. We hope that we have been able to convey at least a little of the appeal of bullfighting.

title: Uwajima Bullfighting May Tournament (2025.5.3)
description: 年に4回の晴れ舞台のひとつ。宇和島闘牛5月場所が2025年5月3日に行われました。闘牛のルールは制限時間なしで牛同士が戦い、逃げた方が敗けというシンプルなものになっています。お天気も良くゴールデンウィークということで入場者数は2400人を超える大入満員大盛況のうちに幕を閉じました。2時間半に渡る長丁場でありましたが主な戦いの箇所をまとめました。闘牛の魅力が少しでも伝われば良いかなと思っています。

title: 伊達なうわじまお城まつり(2025.5.4)
description: 宇和島市は５月４,５日と「伊達なうわじまお城まつり」が行われています。お休みが４日だけなんで「秀宗公入部伊達五十七騎大武者行列」を見に出かけて来ました。混雑が大嫌いなYoutuberなんでお城まつりは初参戦となります。GW真っ只中ということで観光客でごった返す中ワサワサと走り回って撮れ高が十分だしたのでお城山までの行列はパスして曲作りをするために帰宅しました。今回の姫は「塩見きら」さんでした。

title: The Date Uwajima Castle Festival (2025.5.4)
description: The Date Uwajima Castle Festival is being held on May 4th and 5th in Uwajima city. As I only have the 4th off, I went to see the Procession of 57 Date Knights and Lord Hidemune's Warriors. As a YouTuber who hates crowds, this was my first time taking part in a castle festival. As it was the middle of Golden Week, I was able to run around in the midst of the throngs of tourists and took enough photos, so I skipped the procession up to Shiroyama and went home to work on writing a song. The princess this time was Shiomi Kira.

title: 天空の城-宇和島城-(AI Music 2025.5.11)
description: Today, the 'Uwajima EXPO' is being held at Kisaiahira, but I dislike crowds, so I went to Uwajima Castle. I climbed up to complete the lyrics of the original song 'Sky Castle - Uwajima Castle.' How to express the compact yet atmospheric image of Uwajima Castle? For now, I went back in time and felt like a samurai... and created it. Initially, the preview on X was sung by a woman, but after coming up here, I thought a male vocal would be better, so I changed it.

title: 宇和島市 津島町 南楽園(2025.5.29)
description: 小雨の中、宇和島市津島町の日本庭園「南楽園」へ行ってきました。 ただいま夜間延長開園中で21:00まで園内を見ることができます。「竹灯籠の夕べ」ということで灯籠が飾られていたり花菖蒲がライトアップされています。開花状況ですが園のXによると3割程度とありますが29日時点で5割ほどではないかと感じました。週末が見ごろになるでしょう。

title: Uwajima City Tsushima Town Nanrakuen (2025.5.29)
description: I visited the Japanese garden 'Nanrakuen' in Tsushima Town, Uwajima City, in light rain. The garden is currently open until 21:00 for extended night hours. It is decorated with lanterns for the 'Bamboo Lantern Evening' and the irises are illuminated. According to the garden's X, the blooming status is about 30%, but I felt it was around 50% as of the 29th. It should be in full bloom by the weekend.

title: 天空の城 - 宇和島城 - (2025.8.6)
description: I climbed Uwajima Castle. In this heat, I regretted it while climbing, but I just wanted to see the castle. It was too hot, I lost weight, and I was tired... lol. While climbing, I was thinking about cuts to match a song, but after the museum, I couldn't think about that anymore. It was too hot. Since I was there, I arranged the BGM for 'Sky Castle - Uwajima Castle -' in a Mugen Castle Mix. The first half imagines the tension leading up to the sortie. The song starts a cappella and the orchestra gradually joins in. The summer Uwajima Castle was... a private experience without other tourists. title: Türkiye-Japonya zamanı aşan dostluk ～ Ertuğrul Fırkateyni ile başlayan dostluk bağı ～
description: 1890年（明治23年）9月16日に、オスマン帝国から日本へ初めて友好使節として「エルトゥールル艦」が送られました。任務を終えた艦は帰路の途中で和歌山県の大島地域（現在の串本）で岩に衝突し、沈没しました。この悲劇的な事故で587人の海軍士官が命を落としました。大島の人々の救助活動により69人が救出されました。この「エルトゥールル事故」は、その後、日本とトルコの友好関係の始まりとなりました。この事故から1年後、トルコの記念碑が建立され、その前で式典が行われました。それ以来、トルコ大使館と串本町の共催で5年ごとに大規模な式典が行われています。2015年6月6日には125周年の追悼式典が行われ、串本と和歌山はトルコとの関係をさらに深めました。

title: Turkey-Japan Friendship That Transcends Time ～ The Bond of Friendship Begun with the Ertuğrul Frigate ～
description: On September 16, 1890 (Meiji 23), the 'Ertuğrul Frigate' was sent from the Ottoman Empire to Japan as the first friendship envoy. After completing its mission, the frigate sank after hitting rocks in the Oshima region of Wakayama Prefecture (now Kushimoto) on its return journey. In this tragic accident, 587 sailors lost their lives. Thanks to the rescue efforts of the Oshima people, 69 individuals were saved. This 'Ertuğrul Accident' later became the catalyst for the formation of friendship ties between Japan and Turkey. A year after this incident, a Turkish monument was erected, and a ceremony was held in front of it. Since then, large ceremonies have been held every five years in collaboration with the Turkish Embassy and Kushimoto Municipality. On June 6, 2015, the 125th-anniversary memorial ceremonies were held, further developing the relationship between Kushimoto and Wakayama with Turkey.

title: Places to Visit in Nikko Japan | Yudaki Falls | Travel Guide
description: Yudaki Falls is a waterfall in the Oku-Nikko area of Nikko City, Tochigi Prefecture. Measuring 50 meters (164 feet) high and 25 meters (82 feet) wide, it is one of the three major waterfalls in Oku-Nikko along with Kegon Falls and Ryuzu Falls. It flows down from the south shore of Lake Yuno-ko, which is located at the foot of Mt. Nikko-Shirane, one of Japan's 100 Major Mountains. There is Nikko Yumoto Onsen on the banks of Lake Yuno-ko, and the entire Yuno-ko area has hot springs all over the place, but it is not hot water but cold water that flows down the Yudaki despite of its name Yudaki aka Yutaki (Yu=hot water, daki/taki=waterfall). The water from the waterfall becomes the River Yukawa, which flows through one of Japan's most prominent wetland of high elevation, Senjo-gahara Marshland, then flows down the Ryuzu Falls to Lake Chuzenji-ko. A promenade is provided on the side of the Yudaki Falls, from where you can watch three points of the waterfall such as its mouth, basin and side. Watching the waterfall basin up close from the observation deck is especially significant.

Mount Takao (高尾山, Takao-san) is a mountain in the city of Hachiōji, Tokyo, Japan. It is protected within Meiji no Mori Takao Quasi-National Park.

Standing 599 metres (1,965 ft) tall and located within an hour of downtown Tokyo, it is a popular hiking spot, with eight hiking courses and more than 2.5 million annual visitors. The Tama Forest Science Garden is also located at the mountain's base.

THE CHAIR LIFT RIDE

The ride time is about 12 minutes so why not enjoy an aerial trip through the mountains? The distance from “Sanroku Station” at the foot of the mountain to “Sanjo Station” in the middle is about 872m, which is shorter than the distance the cable car travels (The cable car travels a total of 1,020m).

title: Autumn at Shinobazu Pond | Boat Ride | Ueno Park | 不忍池　上野公園
description: Come and join us as we show you the relaxing view of autumn at Shinobazu Pond. Shinobazu no Ike which is found within the Ueno Park in Taito Ku Tokyo, is historically prominent and usually appears in Japanese history and works of art. If you wanna ride a boat on the boat pond, make sure to wear a mask, sanitize your hands and let the staff check your temperature. Ticket machine is available at the entrance. The price of boat ride varies with the type of boat you wanna ride on to. A Cycle boat costs 700 yen, maximum of 2 adults for 30 mins. Swan boat costs 800 yen maximum 3 adults for 30 mins. While a row boat costs 500 yen maximum of 3 adults for 30mins. Situated in the south of Ueno Park, the pond is divided in three sections. The Lotus Pond (蓮の池, Hasu no Ike), the Boat Pond (ボートの池, Bōto no Ike) and the third called Cormorant Pond (鵜の池, U no Ike). The pond has a circumference of about 2 km and a surface area of about 1,100,000 sq meters. It hosts several dozens of types of migratory and stationary birds, whose number at times is over ten thousand. Among them particularly numerous are tufted ducks, pochard, and northern pintails. The pond also contains numerous species of fish, and the lotuses of Lotus Pond, which are grown fully in summer, cover the entire surface of the water, hiding it almost completely.

title: Fujikawaguchiko Autumn Leaves Festival 2021 | 富士河口湖紅葉まつり 2021 | Mt Fuji Bound
description:
#fujikawaguchikoautumnleavesfestival2021 #fujikawaguchiko #autumnfestival #japan #富士河口湖紅葉まつり #mtfuji #mybestjapanmoments #visitjapanjp #falfoliage #autumninjapan #viaggiatotravelservices

Fuji Kawaguchiko Autumn Leaves Festival (富士河口湖紅葉まつり) is one of the most popular autumn events in Japan which is annually held at the northern shore of Lake Kawaguchi, one of the Fuji Five Lakes. This year’s festival is held from Oct.30 to Nov.23 2021.

The event features colourful autumn leaves which stretch around Lake Kawaguchi area, and during daytime, the beautiful scenery can be enjoyed with the amazing view of Mt Fuji on the background.

The festival is centered around the “Momiji Corridor” or Momiji Kairo and is held from 9:00 in the morning. While the light up starts from sunset to 10:00 at night.

The most popular autumn leaves spot is the Momiji Kairo (もみじ回廊) a.k.a. the Maple Corridor.

This is a walkway lined by over 60 maple trees with autumn colour leaves. The trees with red, yellow and orange leaves stretch for about 2km, displaying the stunning scenery.

During the festival, there will be food stalls selling seasonal foods and drinks, as well as small stores selling local products and souvenirs. oh and by the way, most of these souvenirs are hand painted and handmade.

description:
#fujikawaguchikoautumnleavesfestival2021 #fujikawaguchiko #autumnfestival #japan #富士河口湖紅葉まつり #mtfuji #mybestjapanmoments #visitjapanjp #falfoliage #autumninjapan #viaggiatotravelservices

富士河口湖紅葉まつり（Fujikawaguchiko Autumn Leaves Festival）は、日本で最も人気のある秋のイベントの一つで、毎年富士五湖の一つである河口湖の北岸で開催されます。今年の祭りは2021年10月30日から11月23日まで行われます。

このイベントでは、河口湖周辺に広がる色とりどりの秋の葉を楽しむことができ、昼間は美しい景色とともに富士山の素晴らしい眺めを楽しむことができます。

祭りは「もみじ回廊」を中心に行われ、午前9時から開催されます。ライトアップは日没から夜10時まで行われます。

最も人気のある紅葉スポットは、もみじ回廊（Momiji Kairo）で、60本以上のもみじの木が並ぶ遊歩道です。赤、黄色、オレンジの葉を持つ木々が約2kmにわたって伸び、見事な景色を展示します。

祭りの期間中、季節の食べ物や飲み物を販売する屋台や、地元の製品やお土産を販売する小さなお店もあります。ちなみに、これらのお土産のほとんどは手描きで手作りです。

description:

The Tokyo Imperial Palace (皇居, Kōkyo, literally 'Imperial Residence') is the main residence of the Emperor of Japan. It is a large park-like area located in the Chiyoda district of the Chiyoda ward of Tokyo and contains several buildings including the main palace (宮殿, Kyūden), some residences of the Imperial Family, an archive, museums and administrative offices.

It is built on the site of the old Edo Castle. The total area including the gardens is 1.15 square kilometres (0.44 sq mi). During the height of the 1980s Japanese property bubble, the palace grounds were valued by some to be more than the value of all of the real estate in the state of California.

東京皇居（皇居、Kōkyo、文字通り「皇帝の住居」）は、日本の天皇の主な住居です。これは、東京の千代田区に位置する広大な公園のようなエリアで、主な宮殿（宮殿、Kyūden）、皇族の住居、アーカイブ、博物館、行政オフィスなど、いくつかの建物が含まれています。

それは旧江戸城の跡地に建てられています。庭園を含む総面積は1.15平方キロメートル（0.44平方マイル）です。1980年代の日本の不動産バブルの最盛期には、宮殿の敷地はカリフォルニア州のすべての不動産の価値を超えると評価されていました。

description:
Today we’re gonna explore the Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome.

The Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome was created to cover this broad theme of “the relationship between tropical plants and our lives.” Enjoy the exotic scenery created by the wide variety of tropical plants in the large greenhouse. Learn about the plants and the tropics in the Movie Theater, Information Gallery, and Exhibition Hall. Take a full tour of the museum and learn about the relationship between tropical plants and human life without even realizing it. Guided tours are offered on Saturdays, Sundays, national holidays, and during long vacations. Enjoy a fun tour while learning in detail about the plants in the greenhouse.

"The Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome (夢の島熱帯植物館, Yumenoshima Nettai Shokubutsukan), also sometimes called the Yumenoshima Tropical Plant Dome, is a botanical garden located at 3-2, Yumenoshima, Kōtō, Tokyo, Japan. It is operated by the Tokyo Metropolitan Park Association and open daily except Mondays; an admission fee is charged.

The greenhouse was established in 1988 in Yumenoshima ("Dream Island") Park, a reclaimed landfill and dumping ground in Tokyo Bay. Its three domes currently contain about 1,000 species of tropical and semitropical plants. The A Dome features rain forest with ferns and waterfall, B Dome represents a tropical village, and C Dome contains vegetation of the Ogasawara Islands. There is also a small carnivorous plant room.

The domes' plant collections include palms, orchids, aquatic plants, Pandanus, Hevea brasiliensis, Samanea saman, Barringtonia racemosa, Satakentia liukiuensis, Cyathea lepifera, C. mertensiana, C. spinulosa, and Dicksonia antarctica." -Wikipedia

Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome is celebrating their annual Halloween Pumpkin Month from end of September to First of November. You will see their Halloween theme all around the area, inside the museum and on their front lawn or garden are giant pumpkins where you and your kids can play around. Enjoy and shoot lovely Autumn and Halloween photos which will be a great memorabilia for you and your kids!

10 minute walk from Shin-Kiba Station, which is 10 minutes from Tokyo Station on the Keiyo Line. Also accessible on the Yurakucho Line.

description:
#koishikawakorakuengardens #autumnfoliage #autumncolors

皆さん、こんにちは。このビデオでは、東京の最高の日本庭園の一つ、小石川後楽園をご紹介します。

江戸時代初期の1629年、水戸徳川家の創始者である頼房は、別の江戸の邸宅を維持し、その庭は二代目の藩主である光圀の治世中に完成しました。この庭は中央の池と丘を特徴としており、散策に最適です。光圀が庭を造る際には、明代の中国の儒学者・朱舜水の概念を取り入れ、清湖（中国）の庭の再現や「満月橋」など、中国に起源を持つ他の特徴を含めました。庭の名前「後楽園」は、光圀が賞賛した漢詩の「学遊録」に由来し、「権力を維持することを心配し、その後に権力を楽しむ必要がある」という意味です。したがって、「後楽園」という名前が選ばれました。

文化財保護法の下で、小石川後楽園は重要文化財および特別史跡に指定されています。この二重指定は、小石川後楽園、浜離宮、金閣寺などの重要な場所にのみ与えられています。

title: Shiraito no Taki | Shiraito Falls | 白糸の滝 | Mt. Fuji Tour
description: Shiraito Falls (白糸の滝, Shiraito no taki) is a waterfall in Fujinomiya, Shizuoka Prefecture, near Mount Fuji, Japan. It is part of Fuji-Hakone-Izu National Park and has been protected since 1936 as a Japanese Natural Monument. The falls were regarded as sacred under the Fuji cult. Another waterfall, the Otodome Falls is approximately a five-minute walk away. The Shiraito Falls is listed as one of 'Japan’s Top 100 Waterfalls', in a listing published by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment in 1990. It was also selected by the Tokyo Nichi Nichi Shimbun and Osaka Mainichi Shimbun as one of the 100 Landscapes of Japan in 1927. In 2013 the waterfall was added to the World Heritage List as part of the Fujisan Cultural Site.

title: Narusawa Ice Cave | Mt. Fuji Tour | 鳴沢氷穴 | Narusawa Hyōketsu
description: The Narusawa 'Hyoketsu' Ice Cave is located at the east entrance to the Aokigahara Jukai 'sea of trees' forest, and is regarded as one of the tourist spots within the Fuji Five Lakes area that can be visited throughout the year. Over 1150 years ago, during year 6 of the Jogan era (864 a.d.), Nagaoyama, a flank volcano of Mt. Fuji erupted. The red hot lava flow (Aokigahara Maruo) descended between ancient parasitic volcanoes, creating this two-tunnel type cave. After being designated by the Ministry of Education as a natural monument in 1929, it was introduced to the world as a geological wonder. By the way, the tree-type lava bed is said to have the most spiracles in the world. Since the cave is situated in a ring-like manner, visitors can view its various features by making one circular loop. The average temperature inside the cave is 3degC, that's why it is called an Ice Cave. The total length of the cave is 150m and requires 6-7 mins to have a complete view inside the cave.

description:
At the foot of Mt. Fuji lies this enormous animal park. Divided into 2 major zones, the Safari Zone and Fureai Zone.

Safari Zone is a 50min drive through where you can find 7 zones of different animals from all over the world. Riding on your own car, you cannot open your windows or doors as it could be too dangerous. But there is an option of riding the Jungle Bus where you can feed the animals yourself. these huge animals come to the jungle bus seeking for food, as close as 20cm apart from you, with just steel mesh in between. You can also opt to try their 4WD vehicle and experience the same as the jungle bus, feed the animals as they come near you and wait to be fed.

The fureai zone on the other hand is extremely different as you can have a friendly contact with the animals. you can feed them upclose, hold them in your arms and caress them as long as you want. Great for kids and animal lovers.

富士サファリパーク

富士山のふもとに位置するこの広大な動物公園は、サファリゾーンとふれあいゾーンの2つの主要ゾーンに分かれています。

サファリゾーンは、世界中のさまざまな動物がいる7つのゾーンを見学するための50分のドライブです。自分の車に乗って、窓やドアを開けることはできませんが、危険すぎるためです。しかし、ジャングルバスに乗るオプションもあり、自分で動物に餌を与えることができます。これらの巨大な動物は、あなたからわずか20cmの距離で食べ物を求めてジャングルバスに近づいてきます。4WD車を試して、ジャングルバスと同じ体験をし、近くに来た動物に餌を与えることもできます。

一方、ふれあいゾーンは、動物と親しく接することができる全く異なる体験です。動物に近づいて餌を与えたり、抱きしめたり、好きなだけ撫でたりすることができます。子供や動物好きには最適です。

title: 元気になりに、いらっしゃい。【宮崎市】宮崎食堂ムービー｜一人旅編
description:
●Miyazaki Shokudo Homepage
https://www.city.miyazaki.miyazaki.jp/miyazaki-shokudo/

A movie has been created to promote the charm of Miyazaki City through the project "Miyazaki Shokudo." Visitors can experience the rich nature of the sea and mountains under the blue sky, enjoy local foods loved by the community, and connect with people, all of which contribute to their revitalization.

<Solo Travel Edition>
A business person, overwhelmed by work, unexpectedly encounters the "Miyazaki Shokudo" noren (shop curtain) at a café where they were working. As they are naturally drawn in by the noren, they find themselves in a beach burger house doing telework, learning about local food and the "dareyami" culture from the warm people of Nishitachi, and suddenly riding waves in the blue sea after being invited by a surfer they met at a snack bar. After finishing work under the bright sun, they enjoy a relaxing time on the beach... Surrounded by the openness of Miyazaki, they can spend fulfilling time connecting with the warmth of people and the richness of food and nature at Miyazaki Shokudo.

●Music
The song "Tsutsu Uraraka" was written for "Miyazaki Shokudo" by SAKANAMON, a three-piece rock band led by Motoki Fujimori from Miyazaki City. The song, themed around "local pop," is set to a lively rhythm that transitions through various scenes in the movie.

"Tsutsu Uraraka Miyazaki Shokudo Ver."
Lyrics: Motoki Fujimori
Composition: Motoki Fujimori
Artist: SAKANAMON

●What is Miyazaki Shokudo?
Miyazaki City promotes the "Miyazaki Shokudo" project, which envisions the charm of Miyazaki City—its food, nature, and warmth of people—as a "feast" and the entire city as a "place where feasts gather = a dining hall." With the slogan "Come to Get Energized," we will enhance the project with the cooperation of local residents.

●Miyazaki Shokudo Brand Statement
Miyazaki City is a large dining hall.
Casually, without hesitation.
Seasonal and locally exceptional
Delicious food can be enjoyed easily and affordably.
The sea, mountains, sky, and wind
Are all a feast,
Where anyone can relax and regain their energy.
Come to visit anytime.
Always welcome back.

description: 歴史PR動画第４弾。滝山寺鬼祭り（国の重要無形民俗文化財）は、滝山寺を舞台に、天下泰平・五穀豊穣を祈念して行われる祭りです。祭りのクライマックスとなる火祭りに、３匹の鬼面（祖父面(じじめん)・祖母面(ばばめん)・孫面）が登場することから「鬼祭り」と呼ばれています。起源は鎌倉時代、源頼朝の祈願に始まると伝えられ、現在は旧正月７日に近い土曜日に行われています。冬が極まり春の気配が立ち始める頃に催されることから、「三河路に春を告げる祭り」ともいわれ、長く人々に親しまれてきました。

title: Okazaki City (Official) / History PR 'Taki Yamadera Oni Festival Announcing Spring in Mikawa Road'
description: This is the fourth installment of the history PR video. The Taki Yamadera Oni Festival (Important Intangible Folk Cultural Asset of Japan) is held at Taki Yamadera to pray for peace and bountiful harvests. It is called the 'Oni Festival' because three demon masks (Grandfather mask, Grandmother mask, and Grandchild mask) appear during the climax fire festival. Its origin is said to date back to the Kamakura period, starting with a prayer by Minamoto no Yoritomo, and it is currently held on a Saturday close to the 7th day of the old lunar calendar. It is also known as 'the festival that announces spring in Mikawa Road' as it is held when winter is at its peak and the signs of spring begin to appear, and it has been cherished by people for a long time.

title: 北九州市内眺望スポット
description: 北九州市内には市街地を眺望できるスポットがたくさんあります。その中から、日本夜景遺産認定の小倉北区足立山、若松区高塔山、八幡東区皿倉山からの眺望（昼・夜）をご紹介。

title: Kitakyushu City Viewpoints
description: There are many spots in Kitakyushu City where you can enjoy views of the city. Among them, we introduce the views (day and night) from Adachi Mountain in Kokura Kita Ward, Takato Mountain in Wakamatsu Ward, and Sarakura Mountain in Yahatanihon Ward, which are certified as Japan Night View Heritage.

title: 小倉城周辺エリア
description: Kokura North Ward's city center features Kokura Castle, Kitakyushu City Hall, and Katsuyama Park. Additionally, the 'Murasaki River' flowing through the city center has ten bridges designed with nature as a theme, symbolizing the natural regeneration of the Murasaki River, blending into the urban landscape.

title: Kokura Castle Area
description: 小倉北区の中心部には、小倉城、北九州市役所、勝山公園などがあります。また街の中心部を流れる「紫川」には紫川自然再生のシンボルとして自然をテーマにしてデザインされた橋が10本かかっており、都心部の風景に溶け込んでいます。

title: 平尾台
description: Hiraodai in Kokura Minami Ward is one of Japan's three major karsts designated as a national monument, and the landscape scattered with limestone reminds one of a flock of sheep playing in a grassland. In addition, you can enjoy nature at the large park 'Hiraodai Nature Village,' which offers a panoramic view of the magnificent scenery of Hiraodai, as well as limestone caves.

title: Hiraodai
description: Hiraodai in Kokura Minami Ward is one of Japan's three major karsts designated as a national monument, and the landscape scattered with limestone reminds one of a flock of sheep playing in a grassland. In addition, you can enjoy nature at the large park 'Hiraodai Nature Village,' which offers a panoramic view of the magnificent scenery of Hiraodai, as well as limestone caves.

title: 若戸大橋周辺エリア
description: The red Wakato Bridge spanning Dokai Bay and the nostalgic 'Wakato Ferry' are in this area. Once flourishing as Japan's largest coal shipping port, the Wakamatsu South Coast Road features modern architecture such as the Coal Hall and the old Furukawa Mining Building, which still retain traces of its former prosperity.

title: Wakato Bridge Area
description: 洞海湾にかかる赤色の若戸大橋、市民の足「若戸渡船」は懐かしさだ漂うエリア。かつて日本一の石炭の積出港として栄えた若松南海岸通りには、石炭会館、旧古河鉱業ビルなどの近代建築があり、かつての繁栄の面影が今も残っています。

title: 八幡東田エリア
description: 八幡東田エリアには、日本初の銑鋼一貫製鐵所・官営八幡製鐵所の第一高炉の第10次改修高炉がモニュメントとして残っており、見学できます。また博物館ゾーンには、モノづくりについて学べる‘北九州イノベーションギャラリー’、北九州市が環境都市となるまでの歴史・取組が分かる「北九州市環境ミュージアム」、西日本最大級の自然史・歴史博物館「いのちのたび博物館」などがあります。

title: Yahata Higashida Area
description: The Yahata Higashida area features the first integrated iron and steel works in Japan, with the 10th renovation of the first blast furnace of the government-operated Yahata Steel Works remaining as a monument that can be visited. The museum zone includes the 'Kitakyushu Innovation Gallery' where you can learn about manufacturing, the 'Kitakyushu City Environmental Museum' which explains the history and efforts of Kitakyushu City to become an environmental city, and the 'Museum of Natural History and History of Life', one of the largest in western Japan.

title: 皿倉山
description: Height 622m of Mount Sarakura. It takes about 10 minutes to reach the summit station from the base station by transferring from the cable car to the slope car. One of the New Japan's Three Great Night Views, the spectacular view overlooking the city and industrial areas is said to be the '100 Billion Dollar Night View.'

title: Mount Sarakura
description: 標高622mの皿倉山。山麓駅から山頂駅まででケーブルカー、スロープカー乗継いで約10分で登ることができます。新日本三大夜景の1つで、市街地や工場群を一望できる絶景は「100億ドルの夜景」と言われています。

title: 工場夜景クルーズ
description: 全国十大工場夜景の一つとして数えられる北九州市の工場夜景。煌びやかな工場の灯りを船上から楽しむ「工場夜景クルーズ」は人気。毎週土曜・日曜に運行しています。

title: Factory Night View Cruise
description: One of the top ten factory night views in Japan, the factory night view of Kitakyushu. The 'Factory Night View Cruise' allows you to enjoy the dazzling lights of the factories from the boat and is popular. It operates every Saturday and Sunday.

title: 関門海峡
description: 潮の流れが速いことで知られる関門海峡。本州と九州を結ぶ「関門橋」、和布刈神社、宮本武蔵と佐々木小次郎の決闘の地「巌流島」など…海峡の自然や歴史を感じられるエリア。

title: Kanmon Strait
description: The Kanmon Strait is known for its fast tidal currents. It features the 'Kanmon Bridge' connecting Honshu and Kyushu, the Wakaebari Shrine, and the site of the duel between Miyamoto Musashi and Sasaki Kojiro, 'Ganryu Island'... an area where you can feel the nature and history of the strait.

title: 門司港レトロ
description: Moji Port, which flourished as an international trading port from the late Meiji period, still retains many retro buildings that reflect its past, making it one of the top tourist spots in Kitakyushu City, attracting many visitors. The sightseeing train 'Kitakyushu Bank Retro Line Shiofukugo' runs between Moji Port Retro and Wabukari from spring to autumn, covering the shortest distance in Japan (2.1 km) at the slowest speed (15 km/h).

title: Moji Port Retro
description: Moji Port, which flourished as an international trading port from the late Meiji period, still retains many retro buildings that reflect its past, making it one of the top tourist spots in Kitakyushu City, attracting many visitors. The sightseeing train 'Kitakyushu Bank Retro Line Shiofukugo' runs between Moji Port Retro and Wabukari from spring to autumn, covering the shortest distance in Japan (2.1 km) at the slowest speed (15 km/h).

title: 白野江植物公園、部埼灯台ほか
description: 周防灘を望む小高い丘にある「白野江植物公園」は四季折々の自然を楽しむことができる公園で、桜の名所としても知られています。部埼灯台（へさきとうだい）は明治5年建設のに九州で3番目に建てられた洋式灯台。その近くには、海難防止のため、火を焚き続けた僧清虚の偉業をたたえ復元された火焚場跡や、海岸沿いには僧清虚の像も立っています。

title: Shiranoue Botanical Park, Hesasaki Lighthouse and others
description: Shiranoue Botanical Park, located on a small hill overlooking Suo-nada, is a park where you can enjoy nature throughout the four seasons and is also known as a cherry blossom spot. Hesasaki Lighthouse, built in the 5th year of the Meiji era, is the third Western-style lighthouse built in Kyushu. Near it, there is a restored site of the fire pit commemorating the achievements of the monk Seikyo, who kept a fire burning to prevent maritime disasters, and a statue of the monk Seikyo stands along the coast.

title: 長崎街道
description: The Nagasaki Kaido connects Buzen Kokura and Nagasaki. At its starting point, 'Kokura Castle Town', there is 'Tokiwa Bridge', 'Matsunamiki of Kyokuri' which retains the traces of Nagasaki Kaido, 'Tachiba Chaya Ginkgo' which was used as a resting place by various feudal lords and Nagasaki magistrates during the Sankin-kotai between Kurosaki-juku and Kiyase-juku, and 'Kiyase-juku Memorial Hall' which preserves materials from the prosperous post town of Kiyase.

title: Nagasaki Kaido
description: The Nagasaki Kaido connects Buzen Kokura and Nagasaki. At its starting point, 'Kokura Castle Town', there is 'Tokiwa Bridge', 'Matsunamiki of Kyokuri' which retains the traces of Nagasaki Kaido, 'Tachiba Chaya Ginkgo' which was used as a resting place by various feudal lords and Nagasaki magistrates during the Sankin-kotai between Kurosaki-juku and Kiyase-juku, and 'Kiyase-juku Memorial Hall' which preserves materials from the prosperous post town of Kiyase.

title: 藍島（北九州市）
description: 青くきれいな海に囲まれた小倉北区藍島（あいのしま）。 小倉～藍島を結ぶ市営渡船に揺られて約35分で行くことができます。

title: Ainoshima (Kitakyushu City)
description: Ainoshima, located in Kokura Kita Ward, is surrounded by beautiful blue seas. It takes about 35 minutes to get there by municipal ferry from Kokura.

title: 到津の森公園
description: 北九州市都心部近くにある「到津の森公園」にはゾウ、キリン、ライオン、ヤギなど約１００種の動物がいます。動物とのふれあい体験、観覧車などの遊具、芝生広場、サクラやミモザなど四季折々の花などがあり家族連れに人気のスポット。

title: Itozu no Mori Park
description: Itozu no Mori Park, located near the city center of Kitakyushu, is home to about 100 species of animals, including elephants, giraffes, lions, and goats. It is a popular spot for families, featuring animal interaction experiences, amusement rides like a Ferris wheel, a grassy area, and seasonal flowers such as cherry blossoms and mimosa.

title: 河内・合馬周辺エリア
description: Kawachi Reservoir, located in Yahatanihonmachi, is a reservoir built over eight years starting in 1919 to secure the supply of iron for steelmaking. The red 'Minamikawachi Bridge' in the background is designated as an important cultural property of the country. The Goma area in Kokura Minami Ward has many spots to enjoy nature, such as Goma Bamboo Grove Park, Suga Falls, and Mitake Plum Grove Park.

title: Kawachi and Goma Area
description: Kawachi Reservoir, located in Yahatanihonmachi, is a reservoir built over eight years starting in 1919 to secure the supply of iron for steelmaking. title: 若松響灘地区
description: 環境未来都市北九州市。若松響灘地区には太陽光発電、風力発電などのエネルギー関連施設、リサイクル工場が集まった北九州エコタウン、日本最大級の「響灘ビオトープ」などがあります

title: Wakamatsu Hibikinada Area
description: The environmental future city of Kitakyushu. The Wakamatsu Hibikinada area is home to energy-related facilities such as solar power and wind power generation, a recycling plant, Kitakyushu Eco-Town, and one of Japan's largest 'Hibikinada Biotope'.

title: 若松北海岸・グリーンパークほか
description: Wakamatsu Ward's North Coast features the popular Waita Beach for swimming, Marine Park, and Tonda Reservoir. The Hibikinada Green Park, where you can enjoy animals and seasonal flowers, and the Hibiki Animal World, which houses about 300 kangaroos, attracts many families.

title: Wakamatsu North Coast and Green Park, etc.
description: Wakamatsu Ward's North Coast features the popular Waita Beach for swimming, Marine Park, and Tonda Reservoir. The Hibikinada Green Park, where you can enjoy animals and seasonal flowers, and the Hibiki Animal World, which houses about 300 kangaroos, attracts many families.

title: 遠見ケ鼻（妙見崎灯台）
description: 若松区には、眺望が素晴らしい「遠見ヶ鼻」、白い灯台「妙見崎灯台」、畳を敷いたような岩礁「千畳敷（せんじょうじき）」、御㟢神社（みさきじんじゃ）があります。遠見ヶ鼻は美しい夕日の名所としても知られています。

title: Tohmi Cape (Myokenzaki Lighthouse)
description: In Wakamatsu Ward, there are the scenic 'Tohmi Cape', the white lighthouse 'Myokenzaki Lighthouse', the rock formation that looks like tatami mats called 'Senjo-jiki', and Misaki Shrine. Tohmi Cape is also known as a beautiful sunset spot.

title: 旧松本家住宅ほか
description: Kyushu Institute of Technologyの創設者の一人、松本健次郎が暮らした洋館「旧松本家住宅」は国の重要文化財。毎年春と秋の２回特別公開されています。八幡東区・小倉北区・戸畑区の３区にまたがる広大な公園「中央公園」は桜の名所としても有名です。

title: Former Matsumoto Residence and Others
description: The former Matsumoto Residence, where Kenjiro Matsumoto, one of the founders of Kyushu Institute of Technology, lived, is an important cultural property of the country. It is specially opened twice a year in spring and autumn. The vast park 'Chuo Park', which spans the three districts of Yahatanihonmatsu, Kokura Kita, and Tobata, is also famous as a cherry blossom spot.

title: 紫川SUPドローン
Purple River SUP Drone

description: A guide on how to use Japanese Onsen and Hot Springs. A Tokyo Hot Spring Day Trip to this Private Hot Springs and public bath onsen Hotel. This Luxury onsen hotel has a private rotenburo on the room's balcony. Plus Hot Spring Hotel has 2 hot springs public baths and 2 private onsen baths. If you stay overnight, you can get dinner and breakfast served at your room. If you come to Japan for the first time, an Onsen trip would be an awesome experience. I also provide info on onsen etiquette and simple onsen rules so you don't feel overwhelmed in your experience.

title: プライベート日本の温泉ホテル | 東京日帰り旅行 | 温泉公共浴場の使い方
description: 日本の温泉と日本の温泉の使い方ガイド。東京の日帰り温泉旅行で、このプライベート温泉と公共浴場の温泉ホテルを訪れます。この豪華な温泉ホテルには、部屋のバルコニーにプライベート露天風呂があります。さらに、温泉ホテルには2つの公共浴場と2つのプライベート温泉があります。宿泊すると、夕食と朝食が部屋に提供されます。初めて日本に来る方には、温泉旅行は素晴らしい体験になるでしょう。温泉のマナーや簡単なルールについての情報も提供するので、体験に圧倒されることはありません。

title: Kyoto Machiya Hotel - What to Expect if you Stay
description: Kyoto Machiya, also known as Kyo-Machiya, are traditional Japanese wooden townhouses, and if you are visiting Kyoto, you may want to consider staying in a Kyo-Machiya. This Japan Guide explores what it is like to stay in an authentic Kyo Machiya and what you can expect in these types of Kyoto hotels. Machiyas are built using interlocking wooden parts and were popular with Kyoto Merchants before WWII. Since Kyoto was saved from air raids during the war, many of the Machiyas are still around to this day, but once torn down, these Machiyas will likely never be rebuilt. Walking inside, you truly feel like you’re a part of history.

title: 京都町家ホテル - 滞在時の期待
description: 京都町家、または京町家は伝統的な日本の木造町家で、京都を訪れる際には京町家に宿泊することを検討したいかもしれません。この日本ガイドでは、authentic Kyo Machiyaに宿泊することがどのようなものか、そしてこれらの京都ホテルで何を期待できるかを探ります。町家は、相互に組み合わされた木材で作られており、第二次世界大戦前は京都の商人に人気がありました。京都は戦争中に空襲から守られたため、現在でも多くの町家が残っていますが、一度取り壊されると、これらの町家は再建されることはほぼありません。内部に入ると、まるで歴史の一部になったように感じます。

title: World's ONLY Hello Kitty Wooden Igloo Hotel in Japan
description: This Hello Kitty Hotel in Japan is nearby Naruto Theme Park in Nijigen No Mori on Awajishima Island in the Kansai Area. Those visiting the Naruto & Boruto Theme Park or Shin Chan Theme Park may want to consider staying in the World's only Hello Kitty wooden Igloo hotel room. In fact, I went to the Naruto Theme Park just before staying at the Hello Kitty theme hotel. The Hello Kitty Room is one of a kind and is part of the Grand Chariot Hotel in Nijigen No Mori Park. This unique Hello Kitty hotel room experience is housed in wooden igloo like structure also known as the hello kitty cocoon.

title: 日本にある世界唯一のハローキティ木製イグルーホテル
description: このハローキティホテルは、関西地方の淡路島にある二次元の森のナルトテーマパークの近くにあります。ナルト＆ボルトテーマパークやしんちゃんテーマパークを訪れる方は、世界唯一のハローキティ木製イグルーホテルに宿泊することを検討してみてはいかがでしょうか。実際、私はハローキティテーマホテルに宿泊する前にナルトテーマパークに行きました。ハローキティルームはユニークで、二次元の森公園にあるグランドシャリオホテルの一部です。このユニークなハローキティホテルルーム体験は、ハローキティコクーンとも呼ばれる木製のイグルーのような構造に収容されています。

description: Okinawa Grand Mer Resort Hotel is an awesome Okinawa Hotel in Japan. This is where to stay in Okinawa if you are looking for a budget hotel or cheap hotel for families with great service and facilities. This is my Okinawa Hotel recommendation for families. It is a great place to stay in Okinawa for kids since there is an indoor pool.

title: 沖縄のベストファミリーリゾート | 沖縄グランドメルリゾートホテルレビュー
description: 沖縄グランドメルリゾートホテルは、日本の素晴らしい沖縄ホテルです。家族向けの予算ホテルや安価なホテルを探しているなら、ここが沖縄での宿泊先です。素晴らしいサービスと施設があります。これは家族向けの沖縄ホテルのおすすめです。屋内プールがあるので、子供たちにとって素晴らしい滞在場所です。

title: What a 100 Year Old Machiya Hotel stay in Kyoto is like
京都の100年の町家ホテルに宿泊するとは
description:
私の東京からのプレミアム雷辛ソースを手に入れよう - https://paolofromtokyohotsauce.com

私たちは、ホテルに改装された伝統的なスタイルの京都の町家に滞在しています。家族で京都に滞在する場所を探しているなら、これがあなたの基準を満たす良い選択肢かもしれません。ビデオで述べたように、Rinnが私たちを彼らの町家に招待してくれました。伝統的な京都の木造町家です。京都の町家は、1000年代から1200年代にかけて日本の首都であった頃に最初に建てられた自然の木製の町家で、独特の細長いデザインと、ウナギが眠る場所を意味する狭い入口（うなぎのねどこ）で知られています。これは、入口の幅に基づいて不動産所有者に課税する法律の直接的な結果です。したがって、伝統的なスタイルの町家は狭くて長いことが多いです。これが私たちの町家滞在体験と京都周辺の旅行です。

title: TOKYO Japan's 5 Busiest Tourist Traps to WATCH OUT for
東京 日本の5つの最も混雑する観光地に注意
description: これは東京で最も混雑する通り、いわゆる観光地です。私たちは東京の最も混雑した通りをカメラで歩きながら、観光客の群れを避けるための地元のヒントやコツを紹介します。もし東京の混雑した通りを歩くのが好きなら、観光客で賑わう時間帯に訪れても良いですが、もし人混みに押しつぶされるのを避けたいなら、このビデオは役立つヒントがあるでしょう。築地市場は日本の旅行者にとっておそらく最も人気のある目的地で、日本の文化やストリートフードを楽しむ素晴らしい場所ですが、特に土曜日はかなり混雑するので注意が必要です。この点はアメ横にも似ていますが、アメ横は特に週末の午後に混雑します。浅草は東京で最も観光客が集まる場所で、冬でも非常に混雑しています。浅草は夜に訪れることをお勧めします。この魔法のようなエリアを静かに楽しむことができます。原宿は若者向けの目的地で、美味しいスイーツがありますが、学生のラッシュに注意が必要です。最後に、新大久保、いわゆる東京のコリアタウンは素晴らしいストリートフードの目的地ですが、時には駅の出口が閉まるほど混雑することがあります。この観光地には十分に注意してください。週末は最も混雑する時間ですが、平日も混雑することがありますが、東京の混雑した通りをうまくナビゲートする手助けになることを願っています。

description: Japanese Street Food Guide for new Tokyo Tsukiji Fish Market and new Toyosu Fish Market after moving. The Tokyo Street Food in the Jogai Tsukiji Market remains intact. All the Tsuji street food vendors are still there. We take a look inside the new Toyosu Market and show you what the fish market auction section is like. If you love Japanese street food, then this Tsukiji market is a Tokyo Street Food spot you should visit. description: 新しい東京築地市場と豊洲市場の移転後の日本のストリートフードガイド。築地市場のジョガイエリアのストリートフードはそのまま残っています。すべての築地のストリートフードの屋台はまだそこにあります。新しい豊洲市場の内部を見て、魚市場のオークションセクションがどのようになっているかをお見せします。日本のストリートフードが好きなら、築地市場は訪れるべき東京のストリートフードスポットです。築地場内市場が閉鎖された後、現在は魚のオークション用のエリアと観光客やストリートフード用のエリアの2つの東京魚市場があります。私たちは2018年10月13日の豊洲市場のオープン初日に訪れました。豊洲市場のツアーは素晴らしいですが、私のお気に入りはまだ築地市場の日本のストリートフードです。築地市場での私のトップ10の食べ物については、以下の築地市場ガイドをご覧ください。

神戸日本のトップ10の観光スポットと神戸牛の名店 | 行く前に見るべき
description: 神戸日本旅行ガイド - 神戸市での観光と食事、特に神戸牛について。神戸の全エリアを探索し、神戸牛レストラン、中華街南京町、旧居留地、六甲山、メリケンパーク、さらには有馬温泉を訪れます。これらは私の神戸旅行のヒントであり、神戸のストリートツアーのビデオも含まれています。神戸の観光スポットはたくさんあるので、すべてを分かりやすくまとめました。また、視聴者が一緒にフォローできる神戸の地図も含めています。この神戸旅行ガイドは、神戸エリアの究極の参考資料となるでしょう。日本の神戸市は訪れる価値のある素晴らしい場所で、私にとっては混雑の少ない横浜のように感じられます。神戸の観光を楽しみたい方にはぜひ訪れてほしい場所です。神戸牛を食べる場所も紹介しています。ヤザワで神戸牛ラーメンを食べるのを忘れないでください。これは2020年のオリンピックや2019年のラグビーワールドカップのための完璧なガイドでもあります。

description: 日本横浜旅行ガイド - 横浜でのトップ10のアクティビティと食事の場所。これらの横浜旅行のヒントは、横浜で遊んだり、横浜スタジアムで野球の試合を観たり、2020年のオリンピックのために訪れる場合に備えるのに役立ちます。横浜の人気の観光地や、私のお気に入りの地元のスポットを紹介します。横浜ラーメンのヒントもあります。横浜は美しい公園とともに海のすぐそばにあり、食べ物好きには最高の旅行先です。日本最大の中華街での素晴らしいストリートフードの選択肢があります。この日本ガイドは、東京や日本のさまざまな地域でのトップ10のアクティビティや食事を紹介するガイドシリーズの一部です。これらは私の日本旅行のヒントであり、横浜のストリートビューの視点を楽しんでいただければ幸いです。初めて日本を訪れる方にも横浜には行くべき場所がたくさんあります。横浜の観光名所をお楽しみください。

description: 日本旅行ガイド - 名古屋で絶対に見逃せない名古屋の食ツアーのお気に入りを含むトップ10のアクティビティ。名古屋は見落とされがちな旅行先ですが、探索する時間を取れば素晴らしいエリアです。名古屋の食べ物もたくさんあり、名古屋の食の特産品だけに専念した動画を作ることができるほどですが、名古屋の食べ物を含む全体的な名古屋旅行ガイドを作りたかったのです。2019年のラグビーワールドカップのために来る方々のために、トヨタスタジアムもこの動画に含めています。これらの名古屋旅行のヒントは、名古屋の観光体験を始める前に知っておくべき必須情報であり、観光客に名古屋の地元の視点を提供できることを願っています。オススメの名古屋のホットスポット、オスショッピング街、名古屋城、長島リゾート、そして名古屋の食特産品である味噌カツを提供する有名な名古屋のレストラン、矢場とんを訪れます。

description: Japan Guide - Top 10 things to do in Chofu and Ajinomoto Tokyo Stadium for 2020 Olympics. Tokyo Stadium Chofu Area is host to many sporting events for Tokyo Olympics would not be complete without including this area. This Chofu Guide will show you what things to do in the Chofu Tokyo area as well where to eat in the Chofu area. The Ajinomoto Stadium itself is located close to Tobitakyu station, but it's only a 5 minute train ride away from Chofu Station. description: 京都 日本旅行ガイド - 初めての観光客に特におすすめの美しい必見スポット8選。京都でどこに行くべきか知りたいなら、これはあなたの京都ガイドです。最も素晴らしく風光明媚なスポットを巡るガイドツアーです。花見小路、嵐山の竹林、鴨川などの人気スポットや、九条大宮や蹴上インクラインなどのあまり知られていない場所を訪れます。これらの京都のスポットは、京都でのアクティビティのアイデアにもなります。京都の観光が増えるにつれて、これらの観光スポットは昼間に混雑することがあるので、早朝に訪れることをお勧めします。

title: Secret Tourist Spot Japanese DON’T want Foreigners to know about
description: The hidden secret Tokyo Day Trip to a Japanese Winery in Katsunuma Yamanashi is something that SOME Japanese don't want Foreign Travelers to know about. Not ALL Japanese feel this way as you can see from the video, Maruki Winery was very welcoming. Japan Winery Tours & Japanese Wine Tasting are seldom offered as tours to foreign travelers and are a hidden tourist spot because SOME Japanese Wine owners feel that they are ill-equipped to provide what they consider hospitality to foreign travelers. This is known in Japanese as Omotonashi. It's NOT that Japanese dislike foreigners, it is simply that Japanese are not able to provide service at the highest quality because of the language barrier. Despite this, I want to take you inside a Japanese Winery and Japanese vineyard to show you what it's like inside and show you what this awesome experience is like. If you are looking for a Tokyo day trip or things to do outside of Tokyo, this may be a great opportunity since it is so close by and easy to get to from Shinjuku station.

title: 外国人が知らない日本の秘密の観光スポット
description: 隠れた秘密の東京日帰り旅行、勝沼の日本のワイナリーは、ある日本人が外国旅行者に知られたくないと思っている場所です。すべての日本人がそう思っているわけではなく、ビデオからもわかるように、マルキワイナリーは非常に歓迎してくれました。日本のワイナリーツアーや日本のワインテイスティングは、外国旅行者に対してほとんど提供されておらず、隠れた観光スポットとなっています。これは、ある日本のワインオーナーが外国旅行者に対して、彼らが考えるホスピタリティを提供する準備ができていないと感じているためです。これは日本語で「おもてなし」として知られています。日本人が外国人を嫌っているわけではなく、単に言語の壁のために最高のサービスを提供できないのです。それにもかかわらず、私は日本のワイナリーと日本のブドウ畑の内部をお見せし、どのような体験ができるのかをお見せしたいと思います。東京の日帰り旅行や東京の外でのアクティビティを探しているなら、これは素晴らしい機会かもしれません。新宿駅からも非常に近く、簡単にアクセスできます。

title: 世界最大のナルトとボルトのテーマパーク in Japan

title: 『City in Blue』 "OUR STORIES : from OTARU"
description: Distant echoes of the tide. Blue waves lap the shore and the cloudy sky stretches out beyond the horizon. The blue color of the landscape, like a jewel, is a mirror that absorbs the seasons. The people of the port town, living in the seasons as they turn. Those tranquil moments day to day the passing of generations linked together by the town of Otaru. The silhouettes that emerge from the crowd are the truth of this city and its allure. Everything is connected to the ocean.

title: 『青の街』
description: 潮の遠い響き。青い波が岸に打ち寄せ、雲の多い空が地平線の向こうに広がっている。風景の青色は宝石のようで、季節を吸収する鏡である。季節が移り変わる中で生きる港町の人々。世代を超えてつながる穏やかな日々の瞬間、これが小樽の町である。群衆から浮かび上がるシルエットは、この街とその魅力の真実である。すべては海とつながっている。

title: Okinawa from Day0
description: This is a digest video that condenses the charm of traveling in Okinawa. Focusing on a way of traveling called 'Day0', which allows you to spend a relaxed time by arriving in Okinawa half a day earlier, it picks up seven islands (Okinawa Main Island, Tokashiki Island, Ie Island, Aguni Island, Miyako Island, Ishigaki Island, Kohama Island). It focuses on different ways to enjoy 'Day0' on each island, such as the different expressions of nature at different times of the day, like sunsets and starry skies, and activities like early morning yoga and beach cycling. The music used is an original tie-up song by the producer unit Jazzin'park [Symphobia - Okinawa from Day0 Ver. - ].
